events.title_zh: Hermes 0.22.3 正式版汇总约 620 项合并变更，扩展插件与 MCP 进度支持
events.title_en: Hermes 0.22.3 stabilizes about 620 merged changes with plugin and MCP progress improvements
events.summary_zh: Hermes 发布 0.22.3，汇总自 0.22.2 起约 620 个合并 PR，供 CLI、Microsoft Store、Docker 与 Hermes Cloud 使用；完整整理后的说明将随 0.23.0 提供。
events.summary_en: Hermes released 0.22.3, rolling up about 620 PRs merged since 0.22.2 for the CLI, Microsoft Store, Docker and Hermes Cloud. Fully curated notes are planned for 0.23.0.
key_points_zh: 本次窗口包括 MCP 实时工具进度、插件 OAuth 登录与刷新、插件更新，以及桌面端排队提示的编辑。
安装器版桌面应用本次不更新，将随下一次打包版本更新；CLI 可运行 hermes update。
key_points_en: The release window includes live MCP tool progress, plugin OAuth sign-in and refresh, plugin updates, and editing queued desktop prompts.
The installer-based desktop app is unchanged this release and updates with the next bundle; CLI users can run hermes update.
events.importance_reason_zh: 为多个分发渠道提供稳定更新，并明确桌面安装器与其他渠道的差异。
events.importance_reason_en: Provides a stable release across distribution channels while clarifying the installer desktop exception.

events.title_zh: Mistral 与 NVIDIA 合作开发面向工程的 AI 工作流
events.title_en: Mistral and NVIDIA collaborate on AI engineering workflows
events.summary_zh: Mistral 官方订阅宣布与 NVIDIA 合作，以 NVIDIA 加速计算开发新一代 AI 原生工程工作流；现有简介没有给出具体产品或上线日期。
events.summary_en: Mistral’s official feed announces a collaboration with NVIDIA on a new generation of AI-native engineering workflows powered by NVIDIA accelerated computing. The summary specifies no product or launch date.
key_points_zh: 合作方向为工程场景中的 AI 工作流。
材料范围为官方 RSS 简介，不据此推断已推出具体服务。
key_points_en: The collaboration targets AI workflows for engineering.
Evidence is limited to the official RSS summary and does not establish a specific service launch.
events.importance_reason_zh: 是模型厂商向工程应用扩展的一手产品方向预告。
events.importance_reason_en: A first-party preview of a model vendor’s expansion into engineering applications.

events.title_zh: OpenAI 宣布模型与 Codex 工作流将接入 Google Cloud
events.title_en: OpenAI announces models and Codex workflows for Google Cloud
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 的官方订阅宣布，将与 Google Cloud 把前沿模型及 Codex 工作流引入 Gemini Model Garden，通过 Google Cloud Marketplace 提供。现有材料仅为公告简介。
events.summary_en: OpenAI’s official feed announces that frontier models and Codex workflows are coming to Gemini Model Garden with Google Cloud, through Google Cloud Marketplace. The available material is the announcement summary.
key_points_zh: 该公告涉及 Google Cloud 上的模型与 Codex 工作流接入。
订阅简介未列出型号、价格、地区或具体开放时间。
key_points_en: The announcement concerns access to models and Codex workflows on Google Cloud.
The feed summary does not list model IDs, prices, regions or a precise availability date.
events.importance_reason_zh: 扩展模型与 Agent 工作流的云端分发渠道，具体条件仍待公布。
events.importance_reason_en: Expands cloud distribution for models and agent workflows, with detailed terms still unspecified.

events.title_zh: NVIDIA 公布本地 Agent 平台更新：八机 DGX Spark 与 Model Launcher
events.title_en: NVIDIA announces local-agent updates with eight-system DGX Spark clusters and Model Launcher
events.summary_zh: NVIDIA 在 GTC Berlin 公布本地 AI 更新：DGX Spark 已支持手动配置最多八机集群，Underdog 本地桌面 Agent 已面向 RTX Spark 提供；另预告新的硬件与模型启动工具。
events.summary_en: At GTC Berlin, NVIDIA announces local-AI updates: DGX Spark supports manually configured clusters of up to eight systems, and Underdog’s local desktop agent is available for RTX Spark. Additional hardware and model-launching tools are previewed.
key_points_zh: DGX Spark 64GB 预计 10 月 23 日由合作伙伴陆续提供，Sync Model Launcher 计划本月推出，可下载适配模型和容器并连接 OpenCode。
DGX Station 的 Windows 版本预计 12 月推出；不能把这些计划日期写成已经可用。
key_points_en: DGX Spark 64GB is expected to start rolling out October 23; Sync Model Launcher is planned this month to download matched models and containers and connect OpenCode.
The Windows version of DGX Station is expected in December; these planned releases are not already available.
events.importance_reason_zh: 涉及本地 Agent 的模型运行、集群容量与部署入口的重要变化。
events.importance_reason_en: Changes model execution, cluster capacity and deployment access for local agents.

events.title_zh: NVIDIA Factory Operations Blueprint 在 GitHub 开放早期访问
events.title_en: NVIDIA Factory Operations Blueprint enters early access on GitHub
events.summary_zh: NVIDIA 宣布 Factory Operations Blueprint（FOX）在 GitHub 开放早期访问，帮助开发者部署持续运行的工厂管理 Agent，并协调视觉检查、根因分析、报告和车队管理等专门 Agent。
events.summary_en: NVIDIA announces early access to Factory Operations Blueprint (FOX) on GitHub for always-on factory-manager agents coordinating specialists for visual inspection, root-cause analysis, reporting and fleet management.
key_points_zh: 可连接 Cosmos、Nemotron 及 CAD、产品生命周期、仿真、IT 和运营技术系统。
借助 Cosmos 上下文学习，Agent 可根据示例和文档适应任务，无需微调；当前为早期访问。
key_points_en: Can connect Cosmos, Nemotron and CAD, product-lifecycle, simulation, IT and operational-technology systems.
Cosmos in-context learning lets agents adapt from examples and documents without fine-tuning; access is currently early.
events.importance_reason_zh: 提供可获取的工业 Agent 参考实现，涉及真实工作流和系统集成。
events.importance_reason_en: Provides an accessible industrial-agent reference implementation for operational workflows and integrations.

events.title_zh: NVIDIA 扩展机密计算，新增 Confidential Bare Metal 部署选项
events.title_en: NVIDIA adds Confidential Bare Metal to its confidential-computing options
events.summary_zh: NVIDIA 宣布 Confidential Bare Metal，让前沿模型开发者在第三方独享裸金属基础设施运行敏感工作负载，同时管理自有软件栈并保护模型与数据；它与机密容器、机密虚拟机组成三类部署选项。
events.summary_en: NVIDIA announces Confidential Bare Metal for frontier-model builders running sensitive workloads on dedicated third-party infrastructure while managing their own software stack and protecting models and data. It joins confidential containers and virtual machines as three deployment options.
key_points_zh: 新增传输保护、平台完整性度量与硬件访问限制。
Cohere 计划用于 Model Vault；Google Cloud 正将支持扩展至采用 GB300 NVL72 的 A4X Max 实例。
key_points_en: Adds transport protection, platform-integrity measurements and hardware access restrictions.
Cohere plans integration with Model Vault; Google Cloud is extending support to GB300 NVL72-powered A4X Max instances.
events.importance_reason_zh: 扩展敏感模型训练与推理可选择的安全基础设施模式。
events.importance_reason_en: Expands secure infrastructure choices for sensitive model training and inference.

events.title_zh: NVIDIA 扩展 Agent Toolkit，引入企业知识基础与 Kumo 模型
events.title_en: NVIDIA expands Agent Toolkit with enterprise knowledge tools and Kumo models
events.summary_zh: NVIDIA 扩展开源 Agent Toolkit，加入 Agent Knowledge Foundation，将 CUDA-X 数据处理库、Nemotron Retriever 与 Kumo 结构化数据模型用于企业检索、预测和决策；OpenShell 提供运行边界，NemoClaw 提供安全 Agent 参考设计。
events.summary_en: NVIDIA expands its open-source Agent Toolkit with Agent Knowledge Foundation, combining CUDA-X data libraries, Nemotron Retriever and Kumo structured-data models for enterprise retrieval, prediction and decisions. OpenShell provides runtime boundaries and NemoClaw provides secure-agent reference designs.
key_points_zh: 新 Auto-Ontology 库把企业原始数据映射为客户、产品、订单等业务概念及关系。
Kumo Structured 包含表格、关系、时间序列与预测模型；NemoClaw 新增 Agent 优化蓝图。
key_points_en: The new Auto-Ontology library maps raw company data into business concepts and relationships such as customers, products and orders.
Kumo Structured includes tabular, relational, time-series and forecast models; NemoClaw adds an agent-optimization blueprint.
events.importance_reason_zh: 扩展企业 Agent 的知识接入、结构化预测与安全运行工具。
events.importance_reason_en: Expands enterprise agents’ knowledge access, structured prediction and secure runtime tooling.

corrections.reason_zh: 核对原文后将 CUDA-X libraries 准确表述为数据处理库，避免误读为独立数据库产品；英文表述不变。
corrections.reason_en: Clarifies CUDA-X libraries as data-processing libraries rather than a standalone database product; the English statement is unchanged.

events.title_zh: NVIDIA 扩展开放模型：Kumo、Cosmos、BioNeMo 与 Alpamayo 分阶段提供
events.title_en: NVIDIA expands open models across Kumo, Cosmos, BioNeMo and Alpamayo
events.summary_zh: NVIDIA 在 GTC Berlin 公布开放模型扩展，包括结构化企业数据的 Kumo、检索模型、Cosmos 世界模型与数据工具，以及 BioNeMo 蛋白质设计模型。各产品的开放状态和时间不同。
events.summary_en: At GTC Berlin, NVIDIA announces an expanded open-model portfolio including Kumo for structured enterprise data, retrieval models, Cosmos world models and data tooling, and BioNeMo protein design. Availability and timing differ by product.
key_points_zh: Kumo、Nemotron Retriever 与 RFD4-Proteina 已通过公告列出的官方或合作渠道提供；Cosmos Data Factory 提供数据策展、标注、生成与评估蓝图。
Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB 预计 10 月 23 日提供，Alpamayo 2 Edge 计划本月稍后开放下载，不能视为均已上线。
key_points_en: Kumo, Nemotron Retriever and RFD4-Proteina are available through the listed official or partner channels; Cosmos Data Factory provides data curation, labeling, generation and evaluation blueprints.
Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB is expected October 23, and Alpamayo 2 Edge is planned for download later this month; they are not all already available.
events.importance_reason_zh: 新增开放模型和开发工具，且需区分现有可用与计划开放的组件。
events.importance_reason_en: Adds open models and developer tools while distinguishing current availability from planned access.

events.title_zh: Kimi Code 2.3.0：插件技能改用限定名称，远控传输上限增至 100 MiB
events.title_en: Kimi Code 2.3.0 requires qualified plugin skill names and raises remote transfers to 100 MiB
events.summary_zh: Kimi Code 2.3.0 将插件技能按 <pluginId>:<skillName> 展示和调用，不再支持仅用技能短名；远控支持流式传输大请求与响应，上限由 10 MiB 提升至 100 MiB。
events.summary_en: Kimi Code 2.3.0 displays and invokes plugin skills as <pluginId>:<skillName>; bare skill names no longer work. Remote control streams large requests and responses, raising the limit from 10 MiB to 100 MiB.
key_points_zh: 切换有历史记录会话的模型时，可按云端配置显示新建、压缩继续、直接继续或取消选项。
修复 Gemini 4 请求的 400 错误；dangerous_command_guard = false 现在同时关闭危险命令、敏感文件与 Git 控制路径的内置确认。
key_points_en: Cloud configuration can enable a model-switch dialog offering a new session, compact-and-continue, direct continuation or cancellation.
Fixes Gemini 4 request failures with HTTP 400; dangerous_command_guard = false now disables built-in confirmations for dangerous commands, sensitive files and Git control paths.
events.importance_reason_zh: 包含破坏旧调用方式的插件兼容性变化及权限开关行为变化。
events.importance_reason_en: Includes a breaking plugin invocation change and a material change in permission-guard behavior.

events.title_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.102-1 修复子代理审批继承与非交互模型选择
events.title_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.102-1 fixes inherited subagent approvals and headless model selection
events.summary_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.102-1 让子代理遵循自定义工具和 MCP 工具审批，避免重复询问并使继承工作流可运行；-p 与管道输入现在遵循管理员管理的 Auto 模型选择。
events.summary_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.102-1 makes subagents honor custom and MCP tool approvals, avoiding duplicate prompts and allowing inherited workflows to run. Prompt mode and piped stdin now honor managed Auto model selection.
key_points_zh: 审批规则可正确传递给子代理。
非交互运行遵循托管的 Auto 选择。
key_points_en: Approval rules propagate correctly to subagents.
Noninteractive runs respect managed Auto selection.
events.importance_reason_zh: 修复自动化工作流的权限继承和组织模型策略执行。
events.importance_reason_en: Repairs permission inheritance and organizational model policy in automated workflows.

events.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.306 修复云会话登录误报和 MCP 错误遮蔽
events.title_en: Claude Code 2.1.306 fixes cloud sign-in errors and misleading MCP failures
events.summary_zh: Claude Code 2.1.306 修复云会话中缺少会话环境变量时 claude -p 误报未登录的问题，也修复大量 MCP 工具会话中 API 错误被替换为提示词过长并触发多余压缩的问题。
events.summary_en: Claude Code 2.1.306 fixes claude -p reporting “Not logged in” inside cloud sessions started without their environment variables. It also prevents API errors from being replaced by prompt-length errors and unnecessary compaction in sessions with many MCP tools.
key_points_zh: 修复云会话非交互运行的登录状态识别。
保留原始 API 错误，避免无必要的上下文压缩。
key_points_en: Fixes sign-in detection for noninteractive runs inside cloud sessions.
Preserves the underlying API error and avoids unnecessary context compaction.
events.importance_reason_zh: 修复会阻断云端自动化或掩盖真实故障的行为。
events.importance_reason_en: Fixes behavior that can block cloud automation or obscure the actual failure.

events.title_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.102-0 修复长命令提前中断与沙箱代理配置
events.title_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.102-0 fixes long-running commands and sandbox proxy settings
events.summary_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.102-0 修复沙箱命令运行超过 10 秒后的可靠性问题；沙箱网络继承主机代理时遵循 NO_PROXY 与 ALL_PROXY。供应商过载导致回复截断时，会退避重试并显示原始错误与请求 ID。
events.summary_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.102-0 fixes reliability for sandboxed commands running longer than 10 seconds. Sandboxed networking honors NO_PROXY and ALL_PROXY inherited from the host, and provider-overload interruptions retry with backoff while showing the provider message and request ID.
key_points_zh: 组织插件准备不再阻塞聊天发送；插件市场支持 git-subdir 来源。
修复 Fish 补全中选项别名的处理。
key_points_en: Organization plugin preparation no longer blocks sending chats; marketplaces accept git-subdir sources.
Fixes option-alias handling in Fish completions.
events.importance_reason_zh: 改善长任务、企业网络和插件环境下的运行可靠性。
events.importance_reason_en: Improves reliability for long tasks, enterprise networks and plugin setups.

events.title_zh: Gemini CLI 10 月 21 日夜间版支持可选的私网 MCP OAuth 端点
events.title_en: Gemini CLI October 21 nightly supports opt-in private-network MCP OAuth endpoints
events.summary_zh: Gemini CLI 0.67.0-nightly.20261021 支持选择性启用私网 MCP OAuth 端点，保留 shell 和 Git 环境中的用户级 ~/.gitconfig，并修复认证错误误判。
events.summary_en: Gemini CLI 0.67.0-nightly.20261021 supports opt-in private-network MCP OAuth endpoints, preserves user-level ~/.gitconfig in shell and Git environments, and fixes authentication-error false positives.
key_points_zh: 私网端点需要显式启用。
夜间构建不等于稳定发布。
key_points_en: Private-network endpoints require explicit opt-in.
A nightly build is not a stable release.
events.importance_reason_zh: 提供企业私网认证与 Git 环境兼容性的预览修复。
events.importance_reason_en: Previews fixes for private-network authentication and Git environment compatibility.

events.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.305：Linux 嵌套命名空间开关与组织 MCP 策略调整
events.title_en: Claude Code 2.1.305 adds a Linux namespace setting and changes managed MCP policy behavior
events.summary_zh: Claude Code 2.1.305 新增 sandbox.allowNestedUserNamespaces，允许 Linux 沙箱命令创建用户命名空间以运行 Chromium 或 rootless podman，官方同时提醒这可绕过沙箱的文件保护。组织管理的 MCP 与插件权限规则也有变化。
events.summary_en: Claude Code 2.1.305 adds sandbox.allowNestedUserNamespaces for Linux sandboxed commands to create user namespaces for Chromium or rootless podman; the notes warn that this can bypass sandbox file protections. Managed MCP and plugin permission rules also change.
key_points_zh: allowedMcpServers 不再过滤仅在 env 中使用变量的 managed-mcp.json stdio 服务；需通过 deniedMcpServers 明确禁用。
组织设置 allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly 时，按路径挂载的桌面插件不再保留自身 allowed-tools；代码复审仍有阻断问题时不再以 LGTM 开场。
key_points_en: allowedMcpServers no longer filters managed-mcp.json stdio servers using variables only in env; use deniedMcpServers to keep them disabled.
With allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly, path-mounted desktop plugins lose their own allowed-tools; re-reviews no longer open with LGTM while blocking findings remain.
events.importance_reason_zh: 涉及组织安全策略与沙箱边界，升级后需要了解实际权限变化。
events.importance_reason_en: Changes organizational security policy and sandbox boundaries that affect upgrade behavior.

events.title_zh: 硅基流动将 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 升级到 1017 版本，模型 ID 不变
events.title_en: SiliconFlow upgrades DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash to 1017 without changing its ID
events.summary_zh: 硅基流动公告确认，平台于 10 月 21 日将 deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 升级至 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017。现有请求自动由新版服务，无需更改模型名称或调用代码。
events.summary_en: SiliconFlow confirms that deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash was upgraded to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 on October 21. Existing requests automatically use the new version without model-name or client-code changes.
key_points_zh: 平台模型 ID 保持不变。
此次是硅基流动渠道升级，与 DeepSeek 上游首次发布分别记录。
key_points_en: The platform model ID is unchanged.
This is a SiliconFlow channel upgrade, recorded separately from DeepSeek’s original release.
events.importance_reason_zh: 现有平台用户会直接切换到新的底层模型版本。
events.importance_reason_en: Existing platform users are switched directly to a new underlying model version.

events.title_zh: Gemini CLI 0.65.0 修复不受信任目录设置与恢复会话丢失
events.title_en: Gemini CLI 0.65.0 fixes untrusted-folder settings and resumed-session loss
events.summary_zh: Gemini CLI 0.65.0 在不受信任目录强制工作区设置只读，修复恢复会话后快速退出删除历史、重复工具响应与快速 Ctrl+C 造成会话异常等问题，并修复认证循环。
events.summary_en: Gemini CLI 0.65.0 enforces read-only workspace settings in untrusted folders and fixes resumed history deletion on quick exit, duplicate tool responses and session poisoning during rapid Ctrl+C interruptions, along with authentication loops.
key_points_zh: OAuth 回调 iss 校验与 RFC 9207 元数据一致。
支持遥测自定义 OTLP 请求头；一个扩展未通过允许列表时仍加载其他扩展。
key_points_en: OAuth callback iss validation aligns with RFC 9207 metadata.
Supports custom OTLP telemetry headers and continues loading other extensions when one fails the allowlist.
events.importance_reason_zh: 包含信任边界、会话持久性与登录可靠性的关键修复。
events.importance_reason_en: Contains important fixes to trust boundaries, session persistence and sign-in reliability.

events.title_zh: Gemini CLI 0.66.0 预览版加入私网 MCP OAuth 选项并改善终端与认证
events.title_en: Gemini CLI 0.66.0 preview adds private-network MCP OAuth options and terminal fixes
events.summary_zh: Gemini CLI 0.66.0-preview.0 改进终端同步输出和滚动记录，支持显式启用私网端点的 MCP OAuth 流程，并保留 shell 与 Git 环境中的用户级 ~/.gitconfig。该版本仍为预览。
events.summary_en: Gemini CLI 0.66.0-preview.0 improves synchronized terminal output and scrollback, supports opt-in private-network endpoints for MCP OAuth flows, and preserves user-level ~/.gitconfig in shell and Git environments. It remains a preview.
key_points_zh: 验证更新后的活动二进制，防止 PATH 遮蔽导致误报更新成功。
加入 Gemini CLI 未针对 Gemini 4 优化的提示；修复认证错误误判与 Windows diff 参数引用。
key_points_en: Verifies the active binary after updating to prevent false success caused by PATH shadowing.
Adds a notice that Gemini CLI is not optimized for Gemini 4, and fixes authentication-error false positives and Windows diff argument quoting.
events.importance_reason_zh: 预览版改变 MCP 认证与更新校验行为。
events.importance_reason_en: The preview changes MCP authentication and update verification behavior.

events.title_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.101 正式版加入结构化子代理输出与可配置审批指引
events.title_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.101 stabilizes structured subagent output and assisted-approval guidance
events.summary_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.101 正式版为受支持模型的动态工作流子代理加入原生结构化输出，并提供 assistedApprovalInstructions。它还整合跨模型切换、MCP 登录、Windows 恢复会话与组织插件的修复。
events.summary_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.101 brings native structured output for dynamic workflow subagents on supported models and assistedApprovalInstructions into a stable release. It also includes fixes for model switching, MCP sign-in, restored Windows sessions and organizational plugins.
key_points_zh: 从 GPT 切换 Gemini 时可处理历史自定义工具调用；组织团队可分配插件。
未选择模型时保留首条提示并请求 /model 选择；权限卡显示升级原因和诊断命令。
key_points_en: Switching from GPT to Gemini handles earlier custom tool calls, and organizational teams can assign plugins.
With no selected model, the first prompt is retained and /model selection is requested; approval prompts explain escalation causes and provide a diagnosis command.
events.importance_reason_zh: 将此前预发布的工作流功能带入正式版本。
events.importance_reason_en: Brings previously previewed workflow features into a stable release.

events.title_zh: Kilo 限时免费提供 MiniMax M3.1 Flash
events.title_en: Kilo offers MiniMax M3.1 Flash free for a limited time
events.summary_zh: Kilo 官方博客宣布 MiniMax M3.1 Flash 已上线，并在限时活动中免费提供。公告未公布确切截止日或固定免费额度；模型能力与性能数据应分别按其来源理解。
events.summary_en: Kilo’s official blog announces that MiniMax M3.1 Flash is live and free for a limited time. It gives no precise end date or fixed free allowance; capability and performance figures must be interpreted according to their sources.
key_points_zh: 免费仅适用于 Kilo 此次活动，不代表 MiniMax 官方 API 普遍免费。
公告未说明绑卡要求，也未提供固定的 tokens 或请求额度。
key_points_en: The free access applies to this Kilo promotion and does not make the MiniMax API universally free.
The announcement does not specify card requirements or a fixed token or request allowance.
events.importance_reason_zh: 提供可实际使用的限时免费模型渠道。
events.importance_reason_en: Adds a usable limited-time free model channel.

events.title_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.101-1 改进团队插件分配、MCP 登录与本地连接
events.title_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.101-1 improves team plugins, MCP authentication and local connections
events.summary_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.101-1 支持安装团队从团队 GitHub 市场分配的插件，扩展能力请求改为显式审批；macOS 沙箱在允许本地访问且没有主机过滤时可直连 localhost TCP。
events.summary_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.101-1 installs team-assigned plugins from team GitHub marketplaces and requires explicit approval for extension capabilities. macOS sandboxed commands can reach localhost TCP when local access is enabled and no host filters apply.
key_points_zh: 无 OAuth 处理器的无头与 SDK 会话跳过必须重新登录的 MCP 连接，可续期授权仍可连接。
仅改变推理强度不再强制压缩超预算会话；组织权限卡解释升级原因。
key_points_en: Headless and SDK sessions without an OAuth handler skip MCP connections needing sign-in, while renewable grants still connect.
Changing only reasoning effort no longer forces compaction in over-budget sessions; approval cards explain escalation causes.
events.importance_reason_zh: 直接影响企业插件分发、无头会话认证和沙箱兼容性。
events.importance_reason_en: Affects enterprise plugin distribution, headless authentication and sandbox compatibility.

events.title_zh: Mistral 发布 Voxtral 3 实时语音 Agent SDK
events.title_en: Mistral introduces Voxtral 3 for real-time voice agents
events.summary_zh: Mistral 的官方 RSS 将 Voxtral 3 描述为支持 50 多种语言的实时语音 Agent SDK，包含转录、情感语音合成与深度工具使用，支持欧盟托管或自行部署。当前证据范围为公告简介。
events.summary_en: Mistral’s official RSS describes Voxtral 3 as a real-time voice agent SDK for over 50 languages, with transcription, emotional TTS and deep tool use, available with EU hosting or self-deployment. Evidence is limited to the announcement summary.
key_points_zh: 覆盖实时语音交互与工具调用。
简介未给出具体价格、许可证或部署要求。
key_points_en: Covers real-time speech interaction and tool use.
The summary does not specify prices, licensing or deployment requirements.
events.importance_reason_zh: 是语音 Agent 能力与部署选择的重要发布。
events.importance_reason_en: A material release of voice-agent capabilities and deployment options.

events.title_zh: ZCode 3.16.2：远程进程持久化、插件市场与本地文件安全修复
events.title_en: ZCode 3.16.2 adds persistent remote processes, a plugin marketplace and local-file security fixes
events.summary_zh: ZCode 3.16.2 新增远程会话持久进程，断开本地连接后可继续运行；加入插件市场、按需工具搜索及 MiMo 的 API / Token Plan 两种接入方式，并修复 Windows 本地文件越界读取和连接日志敏感信息泄露问题。
events.summary_en: ZCode 3.16.2 adds persistent processes in remote sessions that survive local disconnections, a plugin marketplace, on-demand tool search and API / Token Plan access for MiMo. It also fixes out-of-bounds local-file reads on Windows and sensitive information leaking through connection logs.
key_points_zh: 远程持久进程不再受本地断连影响，移动远程控制加入账号登录和设备管理。
新增插件市场、工具搜索，以及 MiMo API / Token Plan 接入。
修复 Windows 文件越界读取、日志泄露及上下文耗尽后会话无响应等问题。
key_points_en: Persistent remote processes survive local disconnects; mobile remote control gains account login and device management.
Adds a plugin marketplace, tool search and MiMo API / Token Plan access.
Fixes Windows out-of-bounds file reads, log leakage and unresponsive sessions after context exhaustion.
events.importance_reason_zh: 包含远程执行、工具生态与明确安全修复，影响日常 Agent 使用。
events.importance_reason_en: Changes remote execution and tool integration and includes explicit security fixes.

events.title_zh: Google 完成 32 位 Coral NPU 架构并发布编译器 v1.0
events.title_en: Google completes the 32-bit Coral NPU architecture and releases compiler v1.0
events.summary_zh: Google 宣布完成含矩阵执行单元的 32 位 Coral NPU 架构，并发布基于 IREE / MLIR 的开源编译器 v1.0，支持将 JAX、PyTorch 和 TensorFlow 模型导向 Coral NPU。同期公布 Synaptics Astra SR200 系列、Coralboard SR，以及 Coralboard SL 全球正式供货。
events.summary_en: Google announces completion of the 32-bit Coral NPU architecture with a Matrix Execution Unit and releases an open-source IREE / MLIR compiler v1.0 to target Coral NPU from JAX, PyTorch and TensorFlow models. It also announces Synaptics Astra SR200, Coralboard SR and worldwide general availability of Coralboard SL.
key_points_zh: 矩阵单元架构可配置至 1 TOPS；官方给出的平均推理功耗目标为 10mW。
完整 32 位 RTL、编译器、模拟器与参考 FPGA 支持芯片制造前评估。
SR200 MCU 提供 400 GOPS；Coralboard SL 通过 DigiKey 全球供货。
key_points_en: The Matrix Execution Unit architecture is configurable up to 1 TOPS, with a vendor-stated 10mW average inference-power target.
Complete 32-bit RTL, compiler, simulator and reference FPGA support evaluation before fabrication.
SR200 MCUs provide 400 GOPS; Coralboard SL is available worldwide through DigiKey.
events.importance_reason_zh: 开源硬件和编译工具链里程碑改善端侧 AI 模型的可移植性。
events.importance_reason_en: An open hardware and compiler milestone improves edge-AI model portability.

events.title_zh: Kiro IDE 1.4.10 将 Memory 默认关闭并调整工作流反馈
events.title_en: Kiro IDE 1.4.10 turns Memory off by default and improves workflow feedback
events.summary_zh: Kiro IDE 10 月 20 日更新将 Memory 设置默认值改为关闭，已批准的工作流步骤会遵循计划反馈；Powers 在某个服务器不可用时仍能工作，并修复聊天、工作流和 MCP 问题。
events.summary_en: Kiro IDE’s October 20 update makes Memory default to Off, makes approved workflow steps follow plan feedback, keeps Powers working when a server is unavailable, and fixes chat, workflow and MCP issues.
key_points_zh: Memory 的默认设置变为 Off。
工作流计划反馈和 Powers 故障恢复行为得到改善。
key_points_en: Memory now defaults to Off.
Workflow plan feedback and Powers resilience improve.
events.importance_reason_zh: 改变跨会话记忆的默认行为，并提升工作流可靠性。
events.importance_reason_en: Changes the default behavior of cross-session memory and improves workflow reliability.

events.title_zh: Google Model Explorer 与 Arm 开源适配器支持边缘编译图调试
events.title_en: Google Model Explorer and Arm adapters enable edge compiler graph debugging
events.summary_zh: Google 介绍 Arm 为 Model Explorer 构建的 TOSA、VGF 与 PTE 开源适配器，开发者可在本地检查编译后的模型图、并排验证 NPU 委派，并叠加逐节点周期级性能数据。
events.summary_en: Google describes Arm’s open-source TOSA, VGF and PTE adapters for Model Explorer, enabling local inspection of compiled graphs, side-by-side NPU delegation checks and per-node cycle-level performance overlays.
key_points_zh: 可发现图降级引入的多余算子及回退 CPU 的子图。
工具及适配器可通过 PyPI 或 GitHub 获取。
key_points_en: Can reveal extra operators introduced by lowering and subgraphs falling back to CPU.
The tools and adapters are available through PyPI or GitHub.
events.importance_reason_zh: 为端侧模型部署提供可用的编译和性能调试能力。
events.importance_reason_en: Provides usable compiler and performance debugging for edge-model deployment.

events.title_zh: Google 发布 TorchTitan TPU 训练方案，支持原生 PyTorch 工作流
events.title_en: Google details TorchTitan TPU training with native PyTorch workflows
events.summary_zh: Google 介绍基于 TorchTPU 的 TorchTitan TPU 分支，以 torch.device("tpu") 和 PyTorch 原生模型定义执行大规模训练；提供 SimpleFSDP、Graph Trainer、Pallas 内核及模型接入指引。
events.summary_en: Google details the TorchTPU-based TorchTitan TPU fork for large-scale training with torch.device("tpu") and native PyTorch model definitions, including SimpleFSDP, Graph Trainer, Pallas kernels and a model-onboarding skill.
key_points_zh: Transformers 后端可将 500 多个 Hugging Face 模型接入同一训练器；MoE 通用路径目前尚无专家并行。
官方的 8,192 芯片结果为固定单芯片批量的弱扩展实验，不是建议的该模型训练配置。
key_points_en: The Transformers backend connects over 500 Hugging Face models to the trainer; the generic MoE path does not yet support expert parallelism.
The reported 8,192-chip result is a weak-scaling experiment with fixed per-chip batch size, not a recommended training configuration for that model.
events.importance_reason_zh: 降低 PyTorch 模型迁移 TPU 的成本，同时保留扩展实验的适用限制。
events.importance_reason_en: Lowers the effort of moving PyTorch models to TPU while preserving the scaling experiment’s limitations.

events.title_zh: vLLM 与 SGLang 发布基于 TorchTPU 的原生 PyTorch 推理后端
events.title_en: vLLM and SGLang launch native PyTorch inference backends on TorchTPU
events.summary_zh: Google 与 Inferact、RadixArk 合作发布 vLLM-TorchTPU 和 SGLang-TorchTPU，使开发者能以原生 PyTorch 在 TPU 上部署模型，并保留框架的调度、KV 缓存与 API 服务结构。
events.summary_en: Google, Inferact and RadixArk launch vLLM-TorchTPU and SGLang-TorchTPU for native PyTorch model serving on TPU, retaining the frameworks’ scheduling, KV-cache management and API-server structure.
key_points_zh: 支持前缀缓存、工具调用、结构化输出、多模态及长上下文；TPU Sync 用于 KV 传输、分层卸载和预填充／解码分离。
既有 vLLM-Jax 与 SGLang-JAX 将继续维护；性能宣称来自官方公告，并非本站独立验证。
key_points_en: Supports prefix caching, tool use, structured output, multimodality and long context; TPU Sync handles KV transfer, tiered offloading and disaggregated prefill/decode.
Existing vLLM-Jax and SGLang-JAX remain maintained; performance claims come from the announcement and are not independently verified here.
events.importance_reason_zh: 为常用开源推理框架增加原生 PyTorch TPU 部署路径。
events.importance_reason_en: Adds native PyTorch TPU deployment paths to widely used open inference frameworks.

events.title_zh: Kilo 7.8.15：客户端自定义自动路由与子代理写入权限修复
events.title_en: Kilo 7.8.15 adds client-side custom auto routing and fixes delegated write permissions
events.summary_zh: Kilo 7.8.15 的 CLI 可将自有 provider 模型注册为自定义自动路由，由路由服务选型后在本地调用；新增 Docker 客户端评估与逐项结果上传。该版也让 browser_open 记住授权选择，并恢复按路径允许编辑的代理所委派子代理的编辑和写入能力。
events.summary_en: Kilo 7.8.15 lets the CLI register its own provider models in custom auto routers, request a routing decision and run the selected model locally. It adds Docker-based client evaluations with incremental result uploads, remembers browser_open permission choices and restores edits and writes for subagents delegated by agents with path-specific edit allowances.
key_points_zh: CLI 新增 kilo auto router add|remove|list 和 kilo auto eval <router>。
browser_open 可为当前 origin 或所有 origins 保存始终允许规则。
子代理按自身编辑 allowlist 执行，修复误继承全面编辑拒绝的问题。
key_points_en: The CLI adds kilo auto router add|remove|list and kilo auto eval <router>.
browser_open can remember always-allow rules for the current origin or all origins.
Delegated subagents use their own edit allowlist instead of inheriting a blanket edit denial.
events.importance_reason_zh: 改善自定义模型路由与多代理权限的实际可用性。
events.importance_reason_en: Improves custom-model routing and practical delegated-agent permissions.

events.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.304：自动模式引导设置、强制人工审批与审查深度
events.title_en: Claude Code 2.1.304 adds guided auto-mode setup, human-only approvals and review levels
events.summary_zh: Claude Code 2.1.304 新增 /auto-mode-setup，支持 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry、Claude apps gateway 和关闭遥测的会话。mod 可用 decider: "person" 强制通过权限对话框或宿主回调审批；Code Review 增加 Quick、Standard、Deep 深度和组织全仓库审查选项。
events.summary_en: Claude Code 2.1.304 adds /auto-mode-setup across Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, Claude apps gateway and telemetry-disabled sessions. Mods can require approval through a permission dialog or host callback with decider: "person". Code Review adds Quick, Standard and Deep levels and an option to cover every repository in an organization.
key_points_zh: tool.check 新增 e.isReadOnly；decider: "person" 在无法询问任何人时按 mod 原因拒绝。
Code Review 默认 Standard，可按仓库覆盖组织级审查深度。
自定义 ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL 默认启用工具搜索，遇到网关 400 / 422 时去除后重试。
key_points_en: tool.check adds e.isReadOnly; decider: "person" refuses with the mod’s reason when nobody can be asked.
Code Review defaults to Standard and supports per-repository overrides of the organization level.
Tool search defaults on for custom ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL connections and retries without it after gateway 400 / 422 errors.
events.importance_reason_zh: 提供新的自动模式配置和可明确强制人工审批的权限接口。
events.importance_reason_en: Adds auto-mode configuration and an explicit human-only approval interface.

events.title_zh: Copilot 模型策略 REST API 正式可用：覆盖企业、团队、应用与组织
events.title_en: Copilot model policy REST APIs reach general availability across four administrative levels
events.summary_zh: GitHub 宣布 Copilot 模型策略的 GET / PATCH REST API 正式可用，可在企业、企业团队、企业应用及组织四个层级读取和修改可用模型策略；企业可按组织模式或企业团队模式下放控制。
events.summary_en: GitHub has made GET / PATCH REST APIs for Copilot model policies generally available at enterprise, enterprise-team, enterprise-app and organization levels. Enterprises can delegate control according to organization mode or enterprise teams mode.
key_points_zh: 四类层级均支持 GET 和 PATCH 模型策略。
企业可按运行模式将模型控制下放给组织，或团队与应用。
key_points_en: GET and PATCH model-policy operations are available at all four levels.
Enterprises can delegate model control to organizations or to teams and apps, depending on their operating mode.
events.importance_reason_zh: 让大规模 Copilot 模型可用性管理可通过 API 自动化。
events.importance_reason_en: Enables API automation of Copilot model availability across enterprises.

events.title_zh: Copilot 停用 Gemini 3.7 Flash、GPT-5.5 等六款模型
events.title_en: Copilot retires six models including Gemini 3.7 Flash and GPT-5.5
events.summary_zh: GitHub 自 2026-10-19 起在多数 Copilot 体验中停用 Gemini 3.7 Flash、GPT-5.5、GPT-5.4、GPT-5.4 mini、GPT-5 mini 与 Grok 4.5。官方分别建议迁移至 Gemini 3.8 Flash、GPT-6.1 Sol、GPT-6 Luna 与 Grok 4.7；企业管理员可能需先启用替代模型策略。
events.summary_en: From October 19, 2026, GitHub retires Gemini 3.7 Flash, GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4, GPT-5.4 mini, GPT-5 mini and Grok 4.5 across most Copilot experiences. Suggested replacements are Gemini 3.8 Flash, GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Luna and Grok 4.7, respectively; enterprise administrators may need to enable replacement-model policies.
key_points_zh: 适用范围包括 Copilot Chat、行内编辑、Ask / Agent 模式及代码补全等多数体验。
GPT-5.5 / 5.4 建议迁移至 GPT-6.1 Sol，两款 mini 建议使用 GPT-6 Luna。
无需手动移除退役模型；工作流和集成应改用受支持型号。
key_points_en: Applies across most experiences, including Copilot Chat, inline edits, Ask / Agent modes and completions.
GPT-5.5 / 5.4 users are directed to GPT-6.1 Sol; both mini models to GPT-6 Luna.
No action is needed to remove retired models; workflows and integrations should use supported alternatives.
events.importance_reason_zh: 退役已生效，直接影响模型选择、集成和套餐权益表。
events.importance_reason_en: The retirement is effective and directly affects model choices, integrations and entitlement lists.

events.title_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.101-0：动态工作流子代理结构化输出与审批指引
events.title_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.101-0 adds structured subagent output and assisted-approval guidance
events.summary_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.101-0 预发布版本为受支持模型的动态工作流子代理加入原生结构化输出，并新增 assistedApprovalInstructions 指导辅助权限确认。它还修复从 GPT 切换 Gemini 时历史自定义工具调用导致的失败，以及启动时没有选择模型造成的静默挂起。
events.summary_en: The Copilot CLI 1.0.101-0 prerelease adds native structured output for dynamic workflow subagents on supported models and assistedApprovalInstructions to guide Assisted Permissions confirmations. It also fixes GPT-to-Gemini switches after custom tool calls and silent startup hangs when no model is selected.
key_points_zh: 结构化输出仅用于受支持模型的动态工作流子代理。
无默认模型时提示 /model 选择并保留首条输入。
修复模型列表刷新和 Windows 恢复会话的 shell 启动问题。
key_points_en: Structured output is for dynamic workflow subagents on supported models.
When no model is selected, /model is requested and the initial prompt is preserved.
Fixes model-list refresh and Windows shell startup in restored sessions.
events.importance_reason_zh: 预发布功能改善工作流自动化和权限确认的可控性。
events.importance_reason_en: The prerelease improves workflow automation and configurable permission confirmation.

events.title_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.100 正式版：遥测开关、单次目录信任与 MCP 卡顿修复
events.title_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.100 stable adds telemetry control, one-off folder trust and MCP hang fixes
events.summary_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.100 正式版加入 --disable-client-telemetry 与单次提示会话的 --trust-folder，可通过 GitHub 安装链接安装已核实 Skills 和插件；并修复 MCP 工具加载长时间卡住、仅推理且耗尽 tokens 的响应无限循环，以及延迟工具定义引发的误报上下文耗尽。
events.summary_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.100 stable adds --disable-client-telemetry and --trust-folder for one-off prompt sessions, plus installation of verified Skills and plugins from GitHub install links. It fixes long stalls while loading MCP tools, infinite loops on reasoning-only max-token responses and false context exhaustion with deferred tool definitions.
key_points_zh: --trust-folder 用于 -p 或管道 stdin 启动的单次提示模式。
统一 Sessions 浏览器成为 /sessions、/session 与 /resume 默认入口。
MCP 加载、沙箱代理和无进展响应循环的可靠性修复进入正式版。
key_points_en: --trust-folder applies to one-off prompt mode started with -p or piped stdin.
The unified Sessions browser becomes the default for /sessions, /session and /resume.
MCP loading, sandbox-proxy and no-progress response-loop fixes reach stable.
events.importance_reason_zh: 与此前预发布阶段分开记录正式版及明确的控制和可靠性改动。
events.importance_reason_en: Records the stable stage separately from prior prereleases, including explicit controls and reliability changes.

events.title_zh: MiniMax M3.1 Flash 发布：面向 Agent 任务，API 输入每百万 tokens $0.15
events.title_en: MiniMax launches M3.1 Flash for agentic tasks at $0.15 per million input tokens
events.summary_zh: MiniMax 正式推出 M3.1 Flash，称其在复杂 Agent 任务、编程、Computer Use 和网络安全上大幅提升，在线推理速度接近前代三倍、整体使用成本降低 70%。模型已通过 MiniMax API、M Plan 和 MiniMax Code 提供，权重将稍后发布，Pro 版本也在后续推出。
events.summary_en: MiniMax officially launches M3.1 Flash, claiming major gains in complex agentic tasks, coding, computer use and cybersecurity, with online inference nearly three times faster and overall usage costs 70% lower than its predecessor. The model is available through the MiniMax API, M Plan and MiniMax Code; weights will be released later, and a Pro version will follow.
key_points_zh: 官方基准：AutomationBench-AA 居前列，BankerToolBench 76.2，DeepSWE v1.1 73.7%，OSWorld V2 61.7，Agents' Last Exam 29.6，CyberGym 82%。
官方称其在 OSWorld V2 与 ALE 上均位列中国模型第一。
通过更激进的稀疏化优化推理，输出速度可达 200+ TPS，P50 稳定在 170+ TPS。
API 统一计价为每百万 tokens 输入 $0.15、输出 $0.60、缓存输入 $0.015。
已通过 MiniMax API、M Plan 与 MiniMax Code 提供；模型权重将稍后发布，Pro 版本也将推出。
key_points_en: Official benchmarks: near the top on AutomationBench-AA, 76.2 on BankerToolBench, 73.7% on DeepSWE v1.1, 61.7 on OSWorld V2, 29.6 on Agents' Last Exam and 82% on CyberGym.
MiniMax says it ranks first among Chinese models on both OSWorld V2 and ALE.
More aggressive sparsity optimization enables output speeds of 200+ TPS, with a median (P50) of 170+ TPS.
Flat API pricing is $0.15 input, $0.60 output and $0.015 cached input per million tokens.
Available through the MiniMax API, M Plan and MiniMax Code; model weights will be released later, and a Pro version will follow.
events.importance_reason_zh: 新模型发布并伴随显著降价，直接影响 Agent 应用的模型选型与 API 成本。
events.importance_reason_en: A new model release with a significant price cut that directly affects model selection and API costs for agent applications.

events.title_zh: Devin Oncall 面向全部组织正式开放，扩展 CI 查询与 Teams 恢复
events.title_en: Devin Oncall becomes generally available to all organizations, with broader CI checks and Teams recovery
events.summary_zh: Devin Oncall 正式向全部组织开放：响应器可监听 Slack、Teams 和 PagerDuty，结合遥测、代码、部署与运行手册调查告警，给出可能根因和后续行动，并维护持续更新的事件报告。同期更新新增按提交、分支或标签查询 CI，以及 Teams 会话崩溃后在原线程回复重试。
events.summary_en: Devin Oncall is now generally available to all organizations. Responders monitor Slack, Teams and PagerDuty, investigate alerts using telemetry, code, deployments and runbooks, suggest likely causes and next actions, and maintain incident reports. The update also adds CI checks for commits, branches and tags and retries of crashed Teams sessions by replying in the same thread.
key_points_zh: 组织管理员在 Oncall 中连接工具并管理响应器；可生成定期调查报告。
CI 查询覆盖 GitHub、GitLab、Azure DevOps 与 Bitbucket Cloud / Data Center。
企业可按 Microsoft 敏感度标签分类 Teams 附件；未标记文件及 SharePoint / OneDrive 链接先请求分类。
key_points_en: Organization admins connect tools and manage responders in Oncall, with recurring investigation reports.
CI checks cover GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps and Bitbucket Cloud / Data Center.
Enterprises can classify Teams attachments by Microsoft sensitivity labels; unlabeled files and SharePoint / OneDrive links request classification first.
events.importance_reason_zh: 将事件响应能力正式开放，并改善跨平台运维和企业数据处理。
events.importance_reason_en: Makes incident response broadly available and improves cross-platform operations and enterprise data handling.

events.title_zh: Google 发布 LiteRT Tensor API：用 C++ 构建可跨平台执行的模型图
events.title_en: Google releases LiteRT Tensor API for portable C++ model graphs
events.summary_zh: Google 发布 LiteRT Tensor API，允许开发者用 C++ 逐算子构建模型与前后处理图、直接读取权重，并通过共享加速器缓冲区串联管线。模型可导出 .tflite 交由 LiteRT 执行，或直接通过 XNNPACK 在 CPU 上运行；官方仍建议多数项目优先采用常规模型转换路径。
events.summary_en: Google releases the LiteRT Tensor API to build model and pre/post-processing graphs op by op in C++, ingest weights directly and chain pipelines through shared accelerator buffers. Graphs can export to .tflite for LiteRT or run directly on CPU through XNNPACK. Google still recommends conventional conversion for most projects.
key_points_zh: 面向需要底层图控制的新架构和优化，也可供编程 Agent 构造及调优模型。
当前支持 LiteRT 执行或直接 XNNPACK 路径；直接 GPU 后端、Python 编写和更广动态形状支持仍在开发。
官方开源 SAM 2 示例展示端侧浏览器分割；性能数据属于其特定测试。
key_points_en: Targets new architectures and optimizations requiring graph-level control, including model construction and tuning by coding agents.
Supports LiteRT execution or direct XNNPACK today; direct GPU backends, Python authoring and wider dynamic shapes remain in development.
An open SAM 2 sample demonstrates on-device browser segmentation; performance results belong to the vendor’s specific tests.
events.importance_reason_zh: 为端侧推理和 AI 编程工具提供新的底层模型编写接口。
events.importance_reason_en: Provides a new low-level model-authoring interface for edge inference and coding agents.

events.title_zh: Kiro IDE 1.4.0 引入跨会话 Memory
events.title_en: Kiro IDE 1.4.0 introduces cross-session Memory
events.summary_zh: Kiro IDE 1.4.0 引入 Memory，可将仓库约定、用户更正及已排除的方案带入后续会话。用户可在 Memory 视图审阅记忆，并通过 Use only 模式使用记忆而不修改它。
events.summary_en: Kiro IDE 1.4.0 introduces Memory to carry repository conventions, corrections and ruled-out approaches into later sessions. Users can review memories in the Memory view and use the Use only mode without changing them.
key_points_zh: 聊天会显示 Kiro 何时访问或修改记忆。
修复长 Markdown Review 查找、登录取消及 Ubuntu 24.04 .deb 安装后无法启动的问题。
key_points_en: Chat indicates when Kiro accesses or changes memory.
Fixes search in long Markdown Review documents, sign-in cancellation and startup after a .deb install on Ubuntu 24.04.
events.importance_reason_zh: 跨会话上下文记忆改变 Agent 的连续工作方式，用户可审阅和控制。
events.importance_reason_en: Cross-session context changes how the agent continues work, with user inspection and controls.

events.title_zh: DeepTutor 1.6.15：引导式学习支持改组问题、受限辅导记忆与原生 Gemini 语音
events.title_en: DeepTutor 1.6.15 adds grouped questions, bounded tutoring memory and native Gemini speech
events.summary_zh: DeepTutor 发布 1.6.15，改进 Guided Learning 的大纲调整、独立评分题组与受限辅导记忆，增强流式会话恢复和文档解析隔离，并新增检索对比实验、工作区指令与原生 Gemini 语音。
events.summary_en: DeepTutor releases 1.6.15, improving Guided Learning with outline revisions, independently graded question groups and bounded tutoring memory, strengthening stream recovery and document-parsing isolation, and adding retrieval comparison experiments, workspace instructions and native Gemini speech.
key_points_zh: Guided Learning 支持提交前预览模块重排、跨模块协同修改；导师可按 2 至 4 题一组呈现问题，保留部分提交并独立评分。
受限记忆保留教学偏好、未解决误解和来源锚点；用量总计纳入准备与记忆压缩调用，压缩单独计费。
流式内容定期保存以便恢复，未发送消息在服务端确认前保留可恢复副本，设置草稿在目录写入失败后仍保留。
可选查询改写层生成单一搜索查询并在失败时回退原文；新增 kb eval 与 eval-diff 记录改写来源并比较指标。
Gemini TTS 改用原生 generateContent 语音；onomeo 加入 OpenAI 兼容 provider 目录；可选 guard 附加组件默认关闭。
升级方式为 pip install -U deeptutor 或拉取最新 Docker 镜像，升级后需重启服务。
key_points_en: Guided Learning lets users preview module reordering before committing and apply coordinated changes across modules; tutors can present two to four questions as a group, retain partial submissions and grade each answer independently.
Bounded memory retains teaching preferences, unresolved misunderstandings and source anchors; usage totals now include preparation and memory-compression calls, with compression billed separately.
Streamed content is saved periodically for recovery, unsent messages keep recoverable copies until the server acknowledges their dismissal, and settings drafts survive failed catalog writes.
An optional query-rewrite layer produces one search query and falls back to the original on failure; new kb eval and eval-diff commands record rewrite provenance and compare metrics.
Gemini TTS uses native generateContent speech; onomeo joins the OpenAI-compatible provider catalog; the optional guard extra is disabled by default.
Upgrade with pip install -U deeptutor or pull the latest Docker image, then restart running services.
events.importance_reason_zh: 学习型 Agent 的功能与可靠性更新，并改变了用量统计与压缩计费口径。
events.importance_reason_en: A feature and reliability update for a learning agent that also changes usage accounting and compression billing.

events.title_zh: Anthropic 设立公共福利基金：初期承诺 5% 股份，随估值增长追加
events.title_en: Anthropic creates Public Benefit Fund with an initial 5% share commitment that grows with valuation
events.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布将部分公司股份投入新设的 Anthropic Public Benefit Fund。在股东批准的前提下，初期承诺 5% 股份；公司估值每较设定基准增长 50%，董事会可酌情追加 2%。基金为全资 LLC，所持股份不用于游说或政治捐赠。
events.summary_en: Anthropic announces that it will commit part of its shares to the newly created Anthropic Public Benefit Fund. Subject to stockholder approval, it will initially commit 5% of shares, with an additional 2% at the board's discretion for every 50% increase in company value above a set baseline. The fund is a wholly owned LLC, and its shares will not be used for lobbying or political giving.
key_points_zh: 初期承诺 5% 股份；公司估值每较基准增长 50%，董事会可酌情追加 2%。
基金为 Anthropic 全资 LLC，而非 501(c)(3)；所持股份不用于美国或海外游说与政治捐赠。
官方称基金可用于向传统非营利组织大额捐赠或向特定人群直接分配，并提到 AI 对劳动力市场的影响；Anthropic 此前已承诺 2 亿美元研究应对该问题。
结合联合创始人与员工已有的股权捐赠承诺，官方称约 20% 的 Anthropic 股份将用于公共利益，另加未来估值里程碑可能追加的部分。
未来数月将公布基金结构、治理和估值里程碑，并发布公共利益进展报告。
key_points_en: An initial 5% share commitment, with the board able to add 2% for every 50% increase in company value above a set baseline.
The fund is a wholly owned Anthropic LLC rather than a 501(c)(3); the shares it holds will not be used for lobbying or political giving in the US or abroad.

Anthropic says the fund could make large donations to traditional nonprofits or distribute directly to specific populations, citing labor-market impacts; the company has already committed $200 million to study and address the issue.

Combined with existing co-founder and employee equity pledges, Anthropic says roughly 20% of its shares will be dedicated to the public good, plus any additional percentage from future valuation milestones.
Anthropic will share more about the fund's structure, governance and valuation milestones in coming months and publish a public benefit report.
events.importance_reason_zh: 公司治理与公共利益承诺的结构性变化，涉及 AI 行业治理与外部监督讨论。
events.importance_reason_en: A structural change in corporate governance and public-benefit commitments relevant to AI-industry governance and external oversight.

events.title_zh: DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2：适配 Flash-1017 与 Search / Fetch API
events.title_en: DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2 adds Flash-1017 and Search / Fetch API support
events.summary_zh: DeepSeek Harness 候选版 0.2.1-rc.2 适配 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017，并接入 DeepSeek Search 与 Fetch API。
events.summary_en: DeepSeek Harness release candidate 0.2.1-rc.2 adds support for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 and the DeepSeek Search and Fetch APIs.
key_points_zh: Search / Fetch 接入可在网页搜索设置中开启；此版本仍为候选版。
key_points_en: Enable Search / Fetch integration in Web Search settings; this remains a release candidate.
events.importance_reason_zh: 为新模型和官方网页检索接口提供可执行的接入入口。
events.importance_reason_en: Provides working integrations for the new model and official web retrieval APIs.

events.title_zh: DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.1 候选版：插件生态、SDK 会话恢复与凭据策略调整
events.title_en: DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.1 candidate: plugin ecosystem, SDK session resume and credential changes
events.summary_zh: DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.1 是 0.2.1 系列首个候选版本，汇总自 v0.2.0-rc.2 以来的用户与开发者变更：插件支持自定义索引源、Agent 创建插件与依赖同步；实验性提供 Claude Code Mods 兼容层、开发者工具组合包、思考过程机器翻译与 Git Worktrees 插件；TypeScript/Python SDK 支持恢复会话；凭据读取优先级与脱敏策略调整；并修复 Windows PowerShell、请求挂起、会话恢复等大量问题。
events.summary_en: DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.1 is the first release candidate for the 0.2.1 series, summarizing user- and developer-facing changes since v0.2.0-rc.2: plugins gain custom index sources, an agent-created-plugin entry and dependency sync; experimental Claude Code Mods compatibility, developer-tools bundle, reasoning translation and Git Worktrees plugins; TypeScript/Python SDKs support session resume; credential precedence and masking change; and many Windows PowerShell, request-hang and session-recovery fixes.
key_points_zh: 插件系统：支持自定义插件索引源与「让 Agent 创建插件」入口；插件启用、停用、卸载与更新同步依赖，热重载时可替换插件直接生效；官方插件列表提供与当前发布对应的 Claude Code 与 Codex 组合包，可用于 headless、SDK 与 ACP profile。
实验性插件：Claude Code Mods 兼容层（官方称主要目的是验证 Mods API 能力大致为 DSH 插件能力的子集，并非完整兼容）；开发者工具组合包（会话原始日志、聊天定位、内嵌 NodeJS DevTools）；思考过程机器翻译插件（Bing、Google 或付费 DeepSeek Flash）；Git Worktrees 插件。
SDK 与工作目录：TypeScript 与 Python SDK 支持 resume 恢复已保存会话并保留原会话 ID 与工作目录；新增 working_directory 工具与 SDK 读写会话工作目录接口；自动化任务成为 Web 内置能力，提醒工具限 Standard、Creator、PTC 模式。
凭据与安全：已发送消息中的 API Key 与令牌自动识别并默认脱敏、按需查看；API Key 读取优先级调整为 Web/桌面优先已保存凭据，headless 默认读取环境变量与 .env、不读取已保存密钥；更新运行时、MCP 协议等依赖纳入兼容安全修复。
Web 与远端：支持 --public-url 反向代理地址（带路径前缀）、--tls-cert/--tls-key 原生 HTTPS 监听与绑定指定 IPv4/IPv6；本机 HTTP 访问可登录 DeepSeek 账号；SSH helper 支持远端文件操作、进程、终端、沙箱与 Node PTC。

兼容性与其他：第三方插件兼容性优先按 engines.dsh 判断；移除 runtime invariant 插件、both 混合工具展示模式与独立 package.json 子路径插件；Azure 提供方名称统一为 azure（旧 azure-openai-responses 需迁移）；自定义模型 API 推理等级可在界面配置；修复 Windows PowerShell 滚屏、模型响应流挂起与会话恢复失败等问题。
key_points_en: Plugins: custom plugin index sources and a “Let Agent create a plugin” entry; enable/disable/uninstall/update now sync dependencies, and replaceable hot-reloaded plugins take effect immediately; the official catalog offers Claude Code and Codex bundles matching the current release for headless, SDK and ACP profiles.

Experimental plugins: a Claude Code Mods compatibility layer (officially aimed at verifying that the Mods API is broadly a subset of DSH plugin capabilities, not full compatibility); a developer-tools bundle (raw session logs, chat navigation, embedded NodeJS DevTools); a reasoning-translation plugin (Bing, Google, or paid DeepSeek Flash); and a Git Worktrees plugin.

SDK and working directory: TypeScript and Python SDKs support resume with original session IDs and working directories; a new working_directory tool plus SDK APIs read and change session working directories; automation tasks become a built-in Web capability with reminder tools scoped to Standard, Creator and PTC modes.

Credentials and security: API keys and tokens in sent messages are detected and masked by default with opt-in reveal; API-key precedence changes so Web/Desktop prefer saved credentials while headless reads environment variables and .env and no longer reads saved keys; runtime, MCP-protocol and other dependency updates include compatible security fixes.

Web and remote access: --public-url for reverse-proxy addresses (with path prefixes), --tls-cert/--tls-key native HTTPS listeners and binding to specific IPv4/IPv6 addresses; DeepSeek account sign-in over local HTTP; SSH helpers cover remote file operations, processes, terminals, sandboxing and Node PTC.

Compatibility and cleanup: third-party plugin compatibility prioritizes engines.dsh; the runtime invariant plugin, both mixed tool-presentation mode and per-subpath package.json reading are removed; the Azure provider is renamed to azure (azure-openai-responses configs must migrate); custom API reasoning levels are configurable in the UI; fixes include Windows PowerShell scrolling, hung response streams and failed session recovery.
events.importance_reason_zh: 0.2.1 首个候选版本汇总大量功能、兼容性与安全相关变更，直接影响 DeepSeek Harness 用户与插件/SDK 开发者。
events.importance_reason_en: The first 0.2.1 release candidate bundles substantial feature, compatibility and security changes affecting DeepSeek Harness users and plugin/SDK developers.

events.title_zh: Cline v0.0.48 / v3.0.73 / SDK v0.0.95：修复 GPT-6 系列 OpenAI 兼容请求，默认模型回到 Claude Sonnet 5.5
events.title_en: Cline v0.0.48 / v3.0.73 / SDK v0.0.95 fix GPT-6 model requests on OpenAI-compatible endpoints and restore Claude Sonnet 5.5 as default
events.summary_zh: Cline 同批次桌面 v0.0.48、CLI v3.0.73 与 SDK v0.0.95 修复 GPT-6 系列模型在 OpenAI 与 Azure OpenAI 兼容端点上因发送 max_tokens 而被拒绝的问题；Cline 推荐列表之首重新为 Claude Sonnet 5.5，自有 provider 默认模型改回该模型；模型目录刷新并新增 CommandCode 与 Reflection providers，多家平台默认模型调整。
events.summary_en: The same Cline batch — Desktop v0.0.48, CLI v3.0.73 and SDK v0.0.95 — fixes GPT-6 models being rejected on OpenAI and Azure OpenAI-compatible endpoints; the Cline recommended list leads with Claude Sonnet 5.5 again and the provider default returns to it; the model catalog refreshes with new CommandCode and Reflection providers and several vendor default-model changes.
key_points_zh: GPT-6 模型（gpt-6-sol、gpt-6.1-sol，SDK 声称含后续 gpt-5 到 gpt-9 系 ID）改发 max_completion_tokens，OpenAI 与 Azure 兼容端点不再拒绝此前所有请求；Azure gpt-35-turbo 仍发送 max_tokens。
Cline provider 在未选模型时再次默认 Claude Sonnet 5.5，该模型回到推荐列表首位。

模型目录刷新（SDK 自 6,952 增至 7,041 模型），新增 CommandCode 与 Reflection providers；默认模型调整：302.AI 为 Gemini 4 Argon，Eden AI 与 Prime Inference 为 Muse Spark Open，CoreWeave 为 Reflection Beam 1.0，NanoGPT 与 Pioneer 为 Nemotron 3.5 Super VL，Scaleway 为 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash。

SDK 版：hub daemon 记录启动客户端身份（CLINE_HUB_LAUNCHER_* 环境变量并以 OTel 资源属性发布，SSH 远程 hub 报告本地客户端与 ssh transport）；OpenCode Go base URL 固定为 https://opencode.ai/inference/go/v1（models.dev 将 provider 级 URL 移到仅 OpenAI 的路径）。
key_points_en: GPT-6 models (gpt-6-sol, gpt-6.1-sol, and in the SDK also later gpt-5 through gpt-9 ids) send max_completion_tokens, so OpenAI and Azure-compatible endpoints no longer reject every request; Azure gpt-35-turbo keeps max_tokens.
With no model chosen, the Cline provider defaults to Claude Sonnet 5.5 again, which is back at the top of the recommended list.

The model catalog refreshes (6,952 → 7,041 models in the SDK) and adds CommandCode and Reflection providers; default models change for 302.AI (Gemini 4 Argon), Eden AI and Prime Inference (Muse Spark Open), CoreWeave (Reflection Beam 1.0), NanoGPT and Pioneer (Nemotron 3.5 Super VL) and Scaleway (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash).

SDK release: the hub daemon records the launching client (CLINE_HUB_LAUNCHER_* variables published as OTel resource attributes, with SSH remote hubs reporting the local client and ssh transport); OpenCode Go keeps its base URL pinned to https://opencode.ai/inference/go/v1 because models.dev moved the provider-level URL to an OpenAI-only path.
events.importance_reason_zh: GPT-6 系列此前在 OpenAI/Azure 兼容端点上全部请求被拒，本次为直接兼容性修复；默认模型与多家平台默认模型变化影响计费口径。
events.importance_reason_en: GPT-6 series requests were entirely rejected on OpenAI/Azure-compatible endpoints before this direct compatibility fix; the default-model changes also affect billing expectations.

events.title_zh: Gemini CLI 夜间版 20261017：更新校验防 PATH 影子成功，按键映射支持 keys 数组
events.title_en: Gemini CLI nightly 20261017 verifies active binary updates and adds keys-array keybindings
events.summary_zh: Gemini CLI 夜间版 v0.66.0-nightly.20261017 校验活跃二进制更新以避免 PATH 影子情况下误报成功，按键映射支持 keybindings.json 的 keys 数组，透传 bootstrap 父进程终止信号到子进程，冲突重现时重置斜杠命令去重，并增加「未针对 Gemini 4 优化」横幅。
events.summary_en: The Gemini CLI nightly v0.66.0-nightly.20261017 verifies active binary updates to prevent false success under PATH shadowing, adds keys-array support in keybindings.json, forwards termination signals from the bootstrap parent to child processes, resets slash-command conflict dedupe when conflicts reappear, and adds a banner noting Gemini CLI is not optimized for Gemini 4.
key_points_zh: 校验活跃二进制更新，避免 PATH 影子下误报更新成功。
keybindings.json 支持以 keys 数组给出按键映射。
bootstrap 父进程向子进程透传终止信号；斜杠命令冲突重现时重置冲突去重。
界面新增横幅说明 Gemini CLI 未针对 Gemini 4 优化。
key_points_en: Active binary updates are verified to prevent falsely reported success under PATH shadowing.
keybindings.json supports mappings via a keys array.
The bootstrap parent forwards termination signals to child processes; slash-command conflict dedupe resets when conflicts reappear.
A banner notes Gemini CLI is not optimized for Gemini 4.
events.importance_reason_zh: 涉及功能、兼容性、计费或可用性的重要变化。
events.importance_reason_en: Material changes to functionality, compatibility, billing or availability.

events.title_zh: DeepSeek 升级 Flash-1017，并开放自研 Search / Fetch API
events.title_en: DeepSeek upgrades Flash to the 1017 version and opens its Search / Fetch APIs
events.summary_zh: DeepSeek 宣布 V4.1 Flash 升级至 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017，官网与 App 同步更新；API 继续使用 deepseek-flash，调用方式和价格不变。同日开放基于自研搜索引擎的 Search / Fetch API。
events.summary_en: DeepSeek announces DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 as an upgrade to V4.1 Flash, also updating its website and app. The API keeps the deepseek-flash name, calling method and prices. It also opens Search / Fetch APIs powered by its in-house search engine.
key_points_zh: 官方称新版本在多项测试中提升性能，同时减少任务运行时间和输出长度；这些结果为厂商报告。
官方报告 Terminal-Bench 4.0 为 42.3、DeepSWE v1.1 为 77.0；两项分别使用 Claude Code 和 Mini-SWE-V2 框架评测。
官方建议升级到 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.1 或以上，以更好适配新模型；同时针对腾讯 CodeBuddy、WorkBuddy 等平台优化。
key_points_en: DeepSeek reports stronger benchmark performance with shorter task runtime and output length; these are vendor-reported results.
Reported scores include 42.3 on Terminal-Bench 4.0 and 77.0 on DeepSWE v1.1, evaluated with Claude Code and Mini-SWE-V2 respectively.
DeepSeek recommends Harness 0.2.1-rc.1 or later for the new model and reports optimizations for platforms including Tencent CodeBuddy and WorkBuddy.
events.importance_reason_zh: 同一调用入口升级模型，并新增官方搜索接口，影响模型与 Agent 接入。
events.importance_reason_en: Upgrades the model behind an existing API name and adds official search APIs for model and agent integrations.

events.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.302：fork 子代理默认开启，桌面与 VS Code 后台运行主会话子代理
events.title_en: Claude Code 2.1.302 turns fork subagents on by default and runs main-conversation subagents in the background
events.summary_zh: Claude Code 2.1.302 将 fork 子代理（subagent_type: "fork"）在 claude -p、Agent SDK、桌面应用与 VS Code 默认开启（CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=0 可关闭），桌面与 VS Code 始终在后台运行主会话子代理；第三方 provider 下无权限模式的 -p 与 SDK 会话以默认模式启动；新增 CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_MODEL 选择客户端侧自动模式分类模型，可在 /config 开关空闲压缩；并提示 Claude Design 独立版将于 2026-12-14 关闭。
events.summary_en: Claude Code 2.1.302 turns fork subagents (subagent_type: "fork") on by default in claude -p, the Agent SDK, the desktop app and VS Code (opt out with CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=0), and the desktop app and VS Code always run main-conversation subagents in the background; sessions with no permission mode start in default mode on third-party providers; CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_MODEL selects the client-side auto-mode classifier model and idle compaction can be toggled in /config; a notice says standalone Claude Design closes on December 14, 2026.
key_points_zh: fork 子代理在 claude -p、Agent SDK、桌面应用与 VS Code 默认开启（CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=0 关闭；claude mcp serve 不提供）。
桌面应用与 VS Code 主会话子代理始终后台运行（与终端一致）；子代理自身的 Agent 调用在 -p、SDK、桌面与 VS Code 默认前台。
第三方 provider 下，未设置权限模式的 claude -p 与 Agent SDK 会话改以默认模式启动（遥测关闭或全新安装时适用）；--permission-mode auto 保持 auto。
新增 CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_MODEL 选择客户端侧 auto 模式分类所用模型；/config 新增空闲压缩开关，压缩后的提示说明关闭方式。
/design-sync 与 /design-login 提示独立版 Claude Design（claude.ai/design）2026-12-14 关闭。
其他：事件级 prompt/agent 钩子最多 12 个并发执行；云会话例行任务页显示未启动原因（如组织并发云会话达到上限）；Claude Tag 管理设置按 Bundles、Connectors、Skills and plugins、Channels 四个标签页组织。
key_points_en: Fork subagents are on by default in claude -p, the Agent SDK, the desktop app and VS Code (CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=0 turns them off; claude mcp serve never offers them).

The desktop app and VS Code always run the main conversation’s subagents in the background, like the terminal; a subagent’s own Agent calls in -p, the SDK, desktop and VS Code run in the foreground by default.
claude -p and Agent SDK sessions with no permission mode start in default mode on third-party providers, with telemetry off or on a fresh install; --permission-mode auto keeps auto.
CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_MODEL chooses the model for the client-side auto-mode classifier; /config adds an idle-compaction toggle and post-compaction notices say how to turn it off.
/design-sync and /design-login indicate standalone Claude Design (claude.ai/design) closes December 14, 2026.

Other changes: at most 12 prompt or agent hooks per event run at once; cloud-session routine pages show why the last run didn’t start such as org limits on concurrent cloud sessions; Claude Tag admin settings reorganize access into Bundles, Connectors, Skills and plugins, and Channels tabs.

events.title_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.100：统一 Sessions 浏览器与会话目录发现上限，修复沙箱代理与 MCP 加载卡顿
events.title_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.100 unifies the Sessions browser and fixes sandbox proxy handling and MCP-tool-load stalls
events.summary_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.100-0/1.0.100-1 将 /sessions、/session 与 /resume 默认使用统一 Sessions 浏览器，会话浏览对账号发现设 500 条上限并遵循 Retry-After 提示；提示更新沙箱代理证书颁发机构，沙箱 host-rule 流量在未配置代理时遵循 HTTPS_PROXY/HTTP_PROXY；修复会话在 MCP 服务器加载工具期间挂起、Gemini 工具调用报告枚举数组参数与语音听写语言标记等问题。
events.summary_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.100-0/1.0.100-1 makes /sessions, /session and /resume use the unified Sessions browser by default, caps account discovery at 500 records during session browsing honoring Retry-After hints; prompts to update the sandbox proxy certificate authority when masked hosts change, and sandbox host-rule traffic honors HTTPS_PROXY/HTTP_PROXY when no sandbox proxy is configured; fixes include sessions stalling while an MCP server loads tools, Gemini tool calls failing on enum array parameters and voice dictation inserting language markers.
key_points_zh: 统一 Sessions 浏览器默认用于 /sessions、/session 与 /resume。
会话浏览将账号发现限制在 500 条记录，自动刷新时遵循 Retry-After 提示。
沙箱：host-rule 流量在未配置沙箱代理时遵循 HTTPS_PROXY/HTTP_PROXY；遮蔽主机名变化时提示更新沙箱代理证书颁发机构；托管插件托管策略变化时在既有会话中更新激活。
修复：MCP 服务器加载工具挂起导致会话停滞；Gemini 工具调用在数组参数定义枚举值时失败；较早工具结果无可读内容后 Gemini 对话失败；语音听写不再在文本中插入语言标记。
key_points_en: The unified Sessions browser is used by default for /sessions, /session, and /resume.
Session browsing caps account discovery at 500 records and respects Retry-After hints for automatic refresh timing.

Sandbox: host-rule traffic honors HTTPS_PROXY and HTTP_PROXY when no sandbox proxy is configured; the CLI prompts to update the sandbox proxy certificate authority when masked hosts change; managed plugins update activation in existing sessions when the managed policy changes.

Fixes: sessions no longer stall when an MCP server hangs while loading tools; Gemini tool calls no longer fail when array parameters define enum values; Gemini chats no longer fail after earlier tool results contain no readable content; voice dictation no longer inserts language markers into transcript text.

events.title_zh: Kilo JetBrains 7.1.11：列出远程 agents 供移动端使用，捆绑 CLI v7.8.13
events.title_en: Kilo JetBrains 7.1.11 lists remote agents for the mobile app and bundles Kilo CLI v7.8.13
events.summary_zh: Kilo JetBrains 7.1.11 新增可供移动端使用的远程 agents 列表，内置 Kilo CLI v7.8.13；修复 JetBrains 插件忽略文件加载阻塞 UI 线程、延迟提示分发等问题，并同步 MCP OAuth 自动刷新、会话状态计时与迟到 OpenRouter 推理细节保留等 CLI 侧改进。
events.summary_en: Kilo JetBrains 7.1.11 adds a list of remote agents for the mobile app and bundles Kilo CLI v7.8.13; fixes include editor context ignore-file loading blocking the JetBrains UI thread and deferred prompt dispatch, alongside the CLI-side MCP OAuth auto-refresh, session status timing and late OpenRouter reasoning retention improvements.
key_points_zh: 新增可供移动端使用的远程 agents 列表。
内置 Kilo CLI v7.8.13，与 CLI 预发布共享 MCP OAuth 自动刷新、会话状态计时与 OpenRouter 推理细节保留修复。
修复编辑器上下文忽略文件加载阻塞 JetBrains UI 线程；对延迟提示分发做防护；升级 Gradle 至 9.8.1、openapi-generator 至 7.26.0。
key_points_en: Adds a list of remote agents for the mobile app to use.
Bundles Kilo CLI v7.8.13, sharing the CLI prerelease fixes for automatic MCP OAuth refresh, session status timing and OpenRouter reasoning retention.
Fixes editor-context ignore-file loading blocking the JetBrains UI thread; guards deferred prompt dispatch; upgrades Gradle to 9.8.1 and openapi-generator to 7.26.0.

events.title_zh: Kilo 7.8.13/7.8.14 预发布：Agent Manager 可指定会话代理，修复 MCP OAuth 过期与权限边界
events.title_en: Kilo 7.8.13/7.8.14 prerelease lets Agent Manager pick session agents and fixes MCP OAuth expiry and permission scoping
events.summary_zh: Kilo v7.8.13 与 v7.8.14 预发布（内容相同）引入 Agent Manager 会话可由主 agent 指定运行代理（含自定义 agent 的编辑/bash/MCP 权限规则）；自定义 agent 可委派文件编辑且自身编辑规则只约束自己，子 agent 保留配置的写权限；自动刷新过期的 MCP OAuth 令牌（含 403 拒绝场景）；显示 provider 加载失败原因；保留 OpenRouter/Gemini 迟到的推理细节供回放；移动端共享项目 agents。
events.summary_en: Kilo v7.8.13 and v7.8.14 prereleases (identical notes) let a primary agent choose which agent runs an Agent Manager session, including custom agents with their edit/bash/MCP permission rules; custom agents can delegate file edits while their own edit rules apply only to themselves, subagents keep their configured write permissions; expired MCP OAuth tokens refresh automatically including 403 rejection; provider load failures are explained; late OpenRouter/Gemini reasoning details are kept for replay; remote-controlled CLIs share project agents with the mobile app.
key_points_zh: Agent Manager：主 agent 将会话分发给远程控制时可指定运行代理，而非始终回落到工作区默认 agent；内部 agent 在按名请求时被拒绝并列出可选代理；重绘 New Worktree 对话框（可选择 base branch、分支名与版本）。
权限：自定义 agent 委派文件编辑时，其编辑规则（含路径级 deny）只约束该 agent 自身，子 agent 保留自身写权限；只读内置模式仍阻止编辑；需会话级编辑限制限制委派写入。
MCP 与 provider：OAuth 令牌过期自动刷新，服务器用 403 拒绝过期令牌时不再卡在 authentication required；provider 加载失败原因（如凭据被拒、网络错误）显示在 CLI/TUI/VS Code 模型选择器，可重新登录。
模型行为：保留 OpenRouter 迟到的 Gemini 思考签名等推理细节，供后续请求回放；OpenAI 兼容的 string 工具内容转归 opt-in，默认格式不变。
CLI 与移动端：远程控制的 CLI 共享 .kilo/agents 项目 agents，移动端启动会话时可选；修复会话状态计时、TUI 依赖库 console 输出叠写界面问题。
key_points_en: Agent Manager: a primary agent can choose which agent runs a fanned-out session instead of always falling back to the workspace default; internal agents are rejected on named requests with selectable agents listed; the New Worktree dialog is redesigned (base branch, optional branch name, versions).

Permissions: when a custom agent delegates file edits, its edit rules (including path-scoped denies) apply only to that agent and no longer constrain its subagent’s configured write permissions; built-in read-only modes still block edits; session-level edit restrictions confine delegated writes.

MCP and providers: expired OAuth tokens refresh automatically, and 403 rejections of expired tokens no longer leave connections stuck on authentication required; provider load-failure reasons (rejected credentials, network errors) surface in the CLI, TUI and VS Code model picker with sign-in offers.

Model behavior: late-arriving OpenRouter reasoning details such as Gemini thought signatures are preserved for subsequent requests; string tool-call content normalization for OpenAI-compatible providers is opt-in.
CLI and mobile: remote-controlled CLIs share .kilo/agents project agents so the mobile app can offer them; fixes include session status timing and stray dependency console writes overwriting the TUI.

events.title_zh: Kilo：Cursor 用户可在 11 月底前申请 Enterprise 最长一年免费
events.title_en: Kilo offers Cursor customers free Enterprise for up to a year when claimed before the end of November
events.summary_zh: Kilo 官方博客宣布：付费使用 Cursor 的公司可在官方优惠页于 11 月底前提交 Cursor 合同证明，换 Kilo Enterprise 至原合同剩余期限的最长一年免费。博客同时称 Cursor 的 $8 Plus 自 10 月 12 日起仅含 Grok 模型，Premium/Super/Ultra 无第三方模型额度，并称 11 月 12 日 OpenAI 将停止向 Cursor 提供其模型（上述 Cursor 变化与 OpenAI 截止时间来自该博客，属转述）。
events.summary_en: A Kilo blog post announces that companies paying for Cursor can claim free Kilo Enterprise for the remainder of their contract, up to one year, by submitting proof of the Cursor contract on the offer page before the end of November. The post also says Cursor’s $8 Plus plan went Grok-only on October 12, Premium/Super/Ultra include no third-party model allowance, and OpenAI will stop providing its models to Cursor on November 12 (Cursor changes and the OpenAI cutoff are relayed from the Kilo blog).
key_points_zh: 官方优惠：持有效付费 Cursor 合同的团队免费使用 Kilo Enterprise 至原合同剩余期限，最长一年。
认领方式与期限：需在优惠页提交 Cursor 合同证明；认领须在 11 月底前提交（博客未给出具体截止时刻）。
博客转述 Cursor 变化：$8 Plus 自 2026-10-12 起仅含 Grok 模型；Premium/Super/Ultra 无第三方模型额度，GPT-6 等按 API 列表价从首 token 计费。
博客转述 OpenAI 截止：11 月 12 日 OpenAI 停止向 Cursor 提供模型；此后个人 OpenAI API key 仅用于本地 Chat 与 Agent。GPT 访问可经 ChatGPT Plan 连接 Kilo（Sign in with ChatGPT，2026-09-29 上线）。
key_points_en: Official offer: teams with an active paid Cursor contract get Kilo Enterprise free for the remainder of that contract, up to one year.
How and by when: submit the claim form with proof of the Cursor contract on the offer page; claims must be submitted before the end of November (the post gives no exact cutoff moment).

The post relays Cursor changes: the $8 Plus became Grok-only on October 12, 2026; Premium/Super/Ultra include no third-party model allowance and GPT-6 requests bill at API list price from the first token.

The post relays the OpenAI cutoff: OpenAI ends Cursor’s access on November 12; afterwards a personal OpenAI API key works only for local Chat and Agent. GPT access can run through a ChatGPT plan connected to Kilo (Sign in with ChatGPT, launched September 29, 2026).
events.importance_reason_zh: 跨产品迁移优惠与模型可用性变化直接影响计费与工具选择，涉及已在目录中的 Cursor X Subscription 条目。
events.importance_reason_en: A cross-product migration offer plus availability changes directly affect billing and tool choices, including Cursor X Subscription entries already in the catalog.

events.title_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.99-3：可关闭客户端遥测，修复沙箱凭据提示
events.title_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.99-3 adds a client-telemetry opt-out and fixes sandbox credential hints
events.summary_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.99-3 新增 --disable-client-telemetry 关闭客户端遥测上传；沙箱命令在凭据代理证书信任失败时给出解释，并可在批准后于沙箱外重跑；另修复 diff 评论保留、插件操作路由与仅推理响应的 max-token 循环。
events.summary_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.99-3 adds --disable-client-telemetry to turn off client telemetry uploads; sandboxed commands explain credential-proxy certificate trust failures and can offer an approved rerun outside the sandbox. It also fixes /diff comment retention, plugin action routing and endless reasoning-only max-token loops.
key_points_zh: --disable-client-telemetry 标志可关闭 CLI 的客户端遥测上传。
沙箱 shell 命令在凭据代理证书信任失败时解释原因，并可在批准后于沙箱外重跑。
同一会话重开未变更 diff 时保留已保存的 /diff 评审评论，并提供显式丢弃操作；插件启用、停用、更新与卸载在清单刷新后可可靠路由。
仅推理的响应达到 max-token 且无进展时不再无限循环，以明确错误结束；会话恢复时若保存的模型被自动替换，会显示警告并同步当前模型显示。
key_points_en: The --disable-client-telemetry flag turns off client telemetry uploads from the CLI.
Sandboxed shell commands explain credential-proxy certificate trust failures and can offer an approved rerun outside the sandbox.

Saved /diff review comments are kept when reopening an unchanged diff in the same session, with an explicit discard action; plugin enable, disable, update and uninstall actions route reliably after inventory refreshes.

Reasoning-only responses that hit max-token without progress end with a clear error instead of looping; when a saved model is automatically replaced on resume, the CLI warns and keeps the active model display in sync.

events.title_zh: OpenCode 1.19.2/1.19.3：1.x 不再接收 2.x 常规更新，推理选项生成模型变体
events.title_en: OpenCode 1.19.2/1.19.3: 1.x installs are no longer offered 2.x updates; reasoning options generate model variants
events.summary_zh: OpenCode 1.x 固定在 1.x 发布线：更新检查只使用 npm opencode-ai 的 latest 版本，1.x 安装不再被作为常规更新提供 2.x 构建，升级到 OpenCode 2 需经 /update 中的 2.0 入口或 opencode upgrade --major 显式选择；安装脚本拒绝安装 2.x。1.19.3 起配置模型推理选项会生成推理变体，替换目录变体并保留用户配置的覆盖。
events.summary_en: OpenCode 1.x now stays on the 1.x release line: update checks use only the npm opencode-ai latest version, so 1.x installs are never offered a 2.x build as a regular update; upgrading to OpenCode 2 remains an explicit choice through the 2.0 offer in /update or opencode upgrade --major, and the install script refuses to install 2.x. From 1.19.3, configuring a model’s reasoning options generates reasoning variants that replace catalog variants while preserving configured overrides.
key_points_zh: 1.x 安装不再被当作常规更新推送 2.x；Homebrew Core 安装跳过 1.x 更新（其已跟踪 OpenCode 2），提供更新前会检查 tap 与 Chocolatey 可用性。
修复 yarn 管理的安装升级；配置模型推理选项生成推理变体，替换目录变体并保留已配置的覆盖。
key_points_en: 1.x installs are never offered a 2.x build as a regular update; Homebrew Core installs skip 1.x updates (they now track OpenCode 2), and tap and Chocolatey availability is checked before offering an update.
Fixes upgrades for yarn-managed installs; configuring model reasoning options generates reasoning variants that replace catalog variants while preserving configured overrides.

events.title_zh: DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-alpha.5：插件模型名称槽位与终端修复
events.title_en: DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-alpha.5 adds a plugin model-label slot and terminal fixes
events.summary_zh: DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-alpha.5 新增 conversation.input.model.label 槽位，插件可按模型渠道自定义输入框模型选择器中的名称展示；修复插件启停后已打开会话的技能菜单不更新、多终端重复查询与界面偏移等问题，并补充 PTC Mode 指引、统一 SDK、Web 与 headless 的模型身份说明。
events.summary_en: DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-alpha.5 adds a conversation.input.model.label slot so plugins can customize model-selector labels by provider, and fixes skill lists not refreshing in open sessions after plugin changes, redundant terminal queries and a Page Up layout shift, while completing PTC Mode guidance and aligning model identity prompts across SDK, Web and headless profiles.
key_points_zh: 新增 conversation.input.model.label 槽位，插件可按模型渠道自定义输入框模型选择器中的名称展示。
修复插件页启停插件后已打开会话的 / 菜单技能列表不更新；减少新建与恢复多个终端时的重复查询，避免失效终端在切换面板后反复重试。
补充 PTC Mode 缺失指引并统一 SDK、Web、headless 的模型身份说明；修复 Windows/Linux 右侧栏收起时在输入框按 Page Up 导致界面左移。
key_points_en: Adds the conversation.input.model.label slot so plugins can customize model labels by provider in the composer’s model selector.

Fixes the skill list in an open session’s / menu not updating after plugins are enabled or disabled; reduces redundant queries when creating or restoring terminals and stops failed terminals from retrying on panel switches.

Completes missing PTC Mode guidance and aligns model identity prompts across SDK, Web and headless profiles; fixes Page Up in a text input shifting the interface left on Windows and Linux with the right sidebar collapsed.

events.title_zh: Cline 推出云上会话：托管沙箱任务在编辑器关闭后继续运行
events.title_en: Cline rolls out Cloud sessions with hosted sandboxes that outlive the editor
events.summary_zh: Cline 渐次推出 Cloud sessions：可在指定的 GitHub 仓库与分支上以托管沙箱运行任务，关闭编辑器后继续执行并通知完成；桌面 0.0.47 修复 Marketplace 插件加载、移除云会话开关。CLI 3.0.72 与 SDK 0.0.94 将插件限定为 worker（默认）或 sandbox 模式，移除 in_process；默认模型改为 Gemini 4 Argon，模型目录刷新至 6,952 个。
events.summary_en: Cline gradually rolls out Cloud sessions: run a task in a hosted sandbox on a chosen GitHub repository and branch, with tasks continuing after the editor closes and notifying on completion. Desktop 0.0.47 fixes Marketplace plugin loading and removes the Cloud sessions toggle. CLI 3.0.72 and SDK 0.0.94 restrict plugins to worker (default) or sandbox modes and remove in_process; the default model becomes Gemini 4 Argon and the catalog grows to 6,952 models.
key_points_zh: Cloud sessions 在 Settings 开启后渐次可用：任务显示在 Recent/History，完成时通知，关闭编辑器后继续运行。

未固定模型时 Cline provider 默认改为 Gemini 4 Argon（OpenRouter 仍为 Claude Sonnet 5.5）；推荐列表加入 Gemini 4 Argon、移除 Grok 4.7，免费列表以 Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 替换 Step 5 Preview，模型目录新增 Boundless 与 Standard Compute 提供商（6,862→6,952）。
CLI 3.0.72 / SDK 0.0.94：插件只允许 worker（默认）或 sandbox，CLINE_PLUGIN_MODE=in_process 不再支持；流式中断的提供商错误最多重试 3 次，且不再叠加整轮重试。
本地模型（LM Studio、Ollama）长请求不再因 5 分钟无输出而失败；OpenAI 兼容 base URL 不再静默追加 /v1，旧地址一次性迁移；回答 Cline 提问时附加的图片与文件现在会传给模型。
key_points_en: Cloud sessions roll out gradually after being enabled in Settings: tasks appear in Recent and History, notify on completion and keep running after the editor closes.

With no model pinned, the Cline provider now defaults to Gemini 4 Argon (OpenRouter stays on Claude Sonnet 5.5); the recommended list adds Gemini 4 Argon and drops Grok 4.7, the free list replaces Step 5 Preview with Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, and the catalog adds the Boundless and Standard Compute providers (6,862 → 6,952 models).

CLI 3.0.72 / SDK 0.0.94: plugins run only as worker (default) or sandbox, with CLINE_PLUGIN_MODE=in_process no longer supported; mid-stream provider errors retry up to three times without also triggering the whole-turn retry.

Long requests to local models (LM Studio, Ollama) no longer fail after five minutes of silence; OpenAI-compatible base URLs are no longer silently given a /v1 suffix, with a one-time migration for older host-only URLs; images and files attached to answers now reach the model.

events.title_zh: Copilot 在 Slack 与 Teams 支持跨仓库对话

events.summary_zh: GitHub Copilot 在 Slack 与 Microsoft Teams 的单次对话可跨多个仓库跟踪 PR、查询合并动态、调查 issue 或汇总项目进展；@GitHub 可在消息任意位置提及，可引用共享消息与 threads 作为上下文，仓库切换更顺畅，任务启动与中断恢复的可靠性也有改进。
events.summary_en: GitHub Copilot in Slack and Microsoft Teams now works across multiple repositories in a single conversation for tracking pull requests, catching up on merged changes, investigating issues or summarizing project activity; @GitHub can be mentioned anywhere in a message and can use shared messages and threads as context, with smoother repository switching and more reliable task startup and recovery from interruptions.
key_points_zh: 可跨仓库提问：汇总自己所有仓库中需要关注的开放 PR、查询本周合并的 PR、调查横跨前后端仓库的 issue、汇总近期活动。
@GitHub 可在消息任意位置提及；Slack 中可引用共享消息与 threads 作为上下文，减少复制粘贴；错误率、任务启动与中断恢复均有改进。
key_points_en: Cross-repository questions: list open pull requests that need attention, retrieve this week’s merged pull requests, investigate an issue spanning frontend and backend repositories, or summarize recent activity.

@GitHub can be mentioned anywhere in a message; shared Slack messages and threads can serve as context to avoid copy-pasting, and error rates, task startup and recovery from interruptions were improved.

events.title_zh: Gemini CLI 夜间版 v0.66.0：同步输出渲染与 Git 凭据提示收紧
events.title_en: Gemini CLI nightly v0.66.0: synchronized output rendering and tighter Git credential prompts
events.summary_zh: Gemini CLI 0.66.0 nightly 实现同步输出并隔离 spinner 渲染，修复调试控制台高度与 terminalBuffer 闪烁、可滚动工具容器右侧边框溢出；getSafeGitEnv 不再发起交互式凭据与 SSH 提示，另修复 Windows diff 参数引用、formatDuration 取整、.env 加载后的设置占位符与 SKILL.md frontmatter 解析。
events.summary_en: Gemini CLI 0.66.0 nightly implements synchronized output with isolated spinner rendering, fixes debug-console height and terminalBuffer flickering plus right-hand border bleed in scrollable tool containers; getSafeGitEnv no longer issues interactive credential or SSH prompts, and the build also fixes Windows diff argument quoting, formatDuration rounding, settings placeholders after .env loading and SKILL.md frontmatter parsing.
key_points_zh: UI：同步输出并隔离 spinner 渲染；修复调试控制台高度计算、terminalBuffer 闪烁与可滚动工具容器的右侧边框溢出。
核心：getSafeGitEnv 禁用交互式凭据与 SSH 提示；openDiff 的 Windows 参数格式化并加引号；SKILL.md frontmatter 单行描述解析加固；.env 加载后解析设置占位符。
key_points_en: UI: synchronized output with isolated spinner rendering; fixes for debug-console height calculation, terminalBuffer flickering and right-hand border bleed in scrollable tool containers.

Core: getSafeGitEnv disables interactive credential and SSH prompts; Windows diff arguments are formatted and quoted in openDiff; SKILL.md frontmatter parsing is hardened for single-line descriptions; settings placeholders resolve after .env files load.
events.importance_reason_zh: 预览构建包含 Git 凭据提示收紧与终端渲染可靠性修复。
events.importance_reason_en: A preview build with tighter Git credential prompts and terminal-rendering reliability fixes.

key_points_en: Native chats can run during optional managed-plugin downloads; CONNECT proxy authentication is reported.

Environments API 提供 Beta，用于程序化创建与管理 Agent 运行的云端环境。

The Environments API is available in beta to programmatically create and manage the cloud environments agents run in.
Cloud environments now support up to 300 repositories; large environments load 5x faster.
