events.title_zh: 智谱 GLM 将标准 API 与 Coding Plan 的密钥分开管理
events.title_en: Z.AI separates Standard API and Coding Plan key management for GLM
events.summary_zh: 自 2026-10-16 起，智谱标准模型 API（按量付费或用量包）与 GLM Coding Plan 的 API Key 分开管理：新建密钥需按用途选择入口，密钥类型决定计费——标准密钥走账户余额或用量包，Coding Plan 密钥走对应套餐额度，切换端点不改变计费类型。存量密钥自动归类，无需替换。
events.summary_en: Starting October 16, 2026, Z.AI manages API keys for the standard model API (pay-as-you-go or usage bundles) and the GLM Coding Plan separately: new keys are created from the entry point matching their use, and the key type determines billing—Standard keys use account balance or usage bundles, Coding Plan keys use the plan quota, and changing endpoints does not change a key’s billing type. Existing keys are classified automatically and need no replacement.
key_points_zh: 标准密钥在编码工具中使用也不消耗 Coding Plan 额度，可能按量计费；Coding Plan 密钥按对应套餐额度计费，端点切换不改变计费类型。
存量密钥自动归类：Team Plan 项目密钥按团队规则；曾购买 Coding Plan 的账号为兼容密钥，保留原有使用与计费规则；从未购买过的按标准计费。
key_points_en: Using a Standard key in a coding tool does not consume Coding Plan quota and may incur pay-as-you-go charges; Coding Plan keys bill against the corresponding plan quota, and switching endpoints does not change the billing type.

Existing keys are classified automatically: keys in a Team Plan project follow team rules; accounts that ever had a Coding Plan get a Compatible key retaining existing usage and billing rules; accounts that never had one use standard billing.
events.importance_reason_zh: 涉及密钥管理与计费路径的使用条件变化。
events.importance_reason_en: Changes the conditions for key management and billing paths.

events.title_zh: 硅基流动 systemone 接口的 diffusiongemma 模型将于 10-17 停止服务

events.summary_zh: 硅基流动公告：systemone 接口（/v1/systemone）中的 diffusiongemma 模型将于 2026-10-17 停止服务，届时 model 指定该模型的请求将无法继续使用；同接口的 Kev-4b 与 SemIf 不受影响。
events.summary_en: SiliconFlow announced that the diffusiongemma model on the systemone endpoint (/v1/systemone) stops serving on 2026-10-17, after which requests setting model to diffusiongemma will fail; the endpoint’s other models, Kev-4b and SemIf, are unaffected.
key_points_zh: 自 2026-10-17 起，model 指定 diffusiongemma 的请求无法继续使用。
systemone 端点的 Kev-4b 与 SemIf 继续可用；官方建议正在使用 diffusiongemma 的用户尽快切换。
key_points_en: From 2026-10-17 onward, requests with model set to diffusiongemma can no longer be served.
Kev-4b and SemIf on the systemone endpoint remain available; users of diffusiongemma are advised to switch promptly.

events.title_zh: 硅基流动上线高速版 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
events.title_en: SiliconFlow launches a high-speed DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
events.summary_zh: 硅基流动宣布上线高速版 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash。平台称该模型为 552B 参数的 MoE 模型，采用 Causal-Encoder-Decoder 结构（输入激活 8B、输出激活 16B），原生支持视觉理解，并称 HBM 与 SSD 需求降至上一代的 1/4 与 1/8；平台还引用其在 DeepSWE v1.1、CyberGym、Automation-Bench 上小幅超过 Claude Opus 5 与 GPT5.6-Sol 的评测结果（平台表述，未经本站验证）。
events.summary_en: SiliconFlow announced a high-speed DeepSeek V4.1 Flash offering. The platform describes it as a 552B-parameter MoE model with a Causal-Encoder-Decoder structure (8B input / 16B output activation) and native vision understanding, saying HBM and SSD requirements fall to a quarter and an eighth of the previous generation; it also cites benchmark results slightly ahead of Claude Opus 5 and GPT5.6-Sol on DeepSWE v1.1, CyberGym and Automation-Bench (platform claims, not independently verified here).
key_points_zh: 平台称模型以 8B/16B 非对称激活与 KV Cache 压缩降低 Agent 场景成本；原生视觉理解可处理参考图、报错截图与业务图表。
公告未列出该平台的新价格；硅基流动称保留 V4 / V3.2 / V3.1 / V3 / R1 等多代 DeepSeek 模型，并称 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、TRAE、OpenCode、Cline、Hermes Agent 等工具均可接入其 API。
key_points_en: The platform says asymmetric 8B/16B activation and KV-cache compression cut costs for agent workloads, and native vision handles reference images, error screenshots and business charts.

The post lists no new platform pricing; SiliconFlow says it retains DeepSeek generations V4 / V3.2 / V3.1 / V3 / R1 and that tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, TRAE, OpenCode, Cline and Hermes Agent can connect through its API.
events.importance_reason_zh: 平台上线与可用性变化；能力与评测表述来自平台方。
events.importance_reason_en: A platform availability update; capability and benchmark claims come from the platform.

events.title_zh: Devin 扩展 GitLab 指令、跨平台 PR 检索与企业集成控制
events.title_en: Devin expands GitLab commands, cross-platform PR search and enterprise integration controls
events.summary_zh: Devin 10 月 16 日更新为 GitLab 合并请求加入 /devin review 与 /devin <prompt>，并扩展仓库工具、Teams 权限和企业身份集成。
events.summary_en: Devin’s October 16 update brings /devin review and /devin <prompt> to GitLab merge requests and expands repository tools, Teams controls and enterprise identity integrations.
key_points_zh: 可在 GitHub、GitLab、Azure DevOps、Gerrit 和 Perforce Swarm 按状态、作者、分支或标题列出与检索 PR；Bitbucket Cloud Review 可显示合并就绪状态。
GitHub 新增 issue、标签、PR 受让人、仓库信息和分支保护工具；GitLab 同时支持 issue 与标签工具，其他平台支持范围以公告为准。
Teams 的私聊与群聊访问设置分离，转发消息作为引用上下文；企业可隐藏旧 MCP 市场入口，已有 MCP 仍可运行。
支持按租户连接个人 Azure DevOps 账号；配置注销 URL 的 SAML SSO 登录可在退出时同步结束身份提供商会话。
key_points_en: List and search PRs by state, author, branch or title across GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps, Gerrit and Perforce Swarm; Bitbucket Cloud Review can display merge readiness.

GitHub gains tools for issues, labels, PR assignees, repository information and branch protection; GitLab also supports issue and label tools, with other platform coverage defined by the announcement.

Teams separates direct-message and group-chat access settings and treats forwarded messages as quoted context; enterprises can hide legacy MCP marketplace entry points while existing MCPs keep working.
Personal Azure DevOps accounts can connect per tenant; signing out of SAML SSO can also end the identity-provider session when a sign-out URL is configured.
events.importance_reason_zh: 扩大 Agent 在代码托管平台上的操作范围，并提供更细的企业接入控制。
events.importance_reason_en: Expands agent actions across code-hosting platforms and adds finer enterprise integration controls.

events.summary_en: Codex adds searchable /config settings with supported live changes. Follow-up messages immediately steer an active response, and interruption stops Code Mode cells and nested tools.
key_points_zh: 恢复会话保留权限和网络授权，同时服从显式覆盖与当前托管策略；网络代理在 DNS 前检查权限。

key_points_en: Resumed threads restore permissions and network approvals subject to explicit overrides and current managed policy; proxy authorization precedes DNS.
/daemon restarts managed background servers. Daybreak is enabled for eligible accounts; API-key access still requires server support.

events.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.301：小窗口模型切换先压缩，重试可限制等待
events.title_en: Claude Code 2.1.301 compacts before smaller-window switches and bounds retry waits
events.summary_zh: 切换到上下文更小的模型时，过长会话先由原模型压缩；无人值守重试新增用量重置等待上限变量。
events.summary_en: When switching to a model with a smaller context window, the previous model first summarizes an overlong conversation. Unattended retries gain a configurable maximum wait for usage resets.
key_points_zh: CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_MAX_USAGE_LIMIT_WAIT_MS 可让重置过远的请求结束；OpenTelemetry 新增权限与分类器决策字段。
mod hook 的 .catch 仅在抛错或超时时运行；长时间子 agent 的进度改为增量渲染。
key_points_en: CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_MAX_USAGE_LIMIT_WAIT_MS ends requests whose reset is too far away; OpenTelemetry adds permission and classifier decision fields.
A mod hook’s .catch runs only on errors or timeouts; long-running subagent progress renders incrementally.

events.title_en: Pi 1.3.0 preserves thinking-change caches and updates provider protocols
events.summary_zh: GPT-6 API Key 会话中更改思考等级可保留提示缓存；Kimi Code 改用 Chat Completions，动态增加工具不再破坏缓存。
events.summary_en: GPT-6 API-key sessions preserve prompt caches when thinking levels change. Kimi Code moves to Chat Completions so adding tools mid-conversation no longer invalidates the cache.
key_points_zh: Kimi models.json 自定义 base URL 必须包含 /v1；OpenCode Go 修复为新 inference 端点并增加 Google 协议支持。
恢复会话保留已激活工具；修复 Code Mode 取消与 worker 累积，以及 Codex Sol 上下文从 272K 修正为 500K。
key_points_en: Kimi models.json base URL overrides must include /v1; OpenCode Go uses new inference endpoints and adds Google protocol support.
Resume restores active tools; fixes Code Mode cancellation and worker accumulation, and corrects Codex Sol context from 272K to 500K.

key_points_zh: 材料支持生命科学研究用途；未列资助额度、名额或保证获批条件。

key_points_zh: 原帖称当天向所有用户逐步推出，API 将稍后提供；不将 API 预告写成当前已可用。

events.summary_zh: 新增 --trust-folder 用于 -p 或管道输入的单次会话，并支持通过 GitHub 安装链接安装已验证 Skills 与插件。
events.summary_en: Adds --trust-folder for one-off -p or piped-input sessions and installation of verified skills and plugins through GitHub install links.
key_points_zh: 修复延迟工具定义导致的虚假上下文耗尽，以及托管 Assisted ask 权限不必要的确认。
沙箱 git 可使用 credentials.envVars 中配置的 GITHUB_TOKEN，Entra 登录保留所选账号。
key_points_en: Fixes false context exhaustion with deferred tool definitions and unnecessary prompts under managed Assisted ask permissions.
Sandboxed git can use GITHUB_TOKEN from credentials.envVars, and Entra authentication preserves the selected account.

events.title_zh: Google Antigravity 加入生物分子结构查看器，支持研究者与 Agent 共享三维视图
events.title_en: Google Antigravity adds a biomolecular viewer with a shared 3D state for researchers and agents
events.summary_zh: Google 展示用 Antigravity 联合 UniProt、ProtNLM 与结构分析寻找抗菌肽候选物的工作流，并推出内嵌的生物分子结构查看器。Agent 可驱动三维视图，研究者对残基的高亮和结合位点的批注也会同步回 Agent。文中候选物仍在进行湿实验验证，不能视为已证实有效的疗法。
events.summary_en: Google demonstrates an Antigravity workflow combining UniProt, ProtNLM and structural analysis to identify antimicrobial peptide candidates, and introduces an embedded biomolecular structure viewer. Agents can control the 3D view, while researchers’ residue highlights and binding-site annotations are synchronized back to the agent. The candidate is undergoing wet-lab validation and is not a proven therapy.
key_points_zh: 内嵌查看器可载入 AlphaFold Database 结构或研究者自己的预测，双方共享视觉上下文。
研究者引导科学策略，Agent 执行跨数据库编排、结构分析与文献综合。
候选物只有计算与结构依据，仍需湿实验验证。
key_points_en: The embedded viewer loads AlphaFold Database structures or researchers’ own predictions into shared visual context.
Researchers guide scientific strategy while agents orchestrate databases, structural analysis and literature synthesis.
The candidate has computational and structural support but still requires wet-lab validation.
events.importance_reason_zh: 新增可双向同步的专业三维工具，扩展 Agent 与研究者共同分析科学对象的能力。
events.importance_reason_en: A new professional 3D tool with two-way state synchronization extends how agents and researchers analyze scientific objects together.

events.title_zh: Kilo 接入 Nemotron 3.5 Super VL，支持图像与视频
events.title_en: Kilo adds Nemotron 3.5 Super VL with image and video input
events.summary_zh: Kilo 宣布 NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 已可在 Desktop、CLI、VS Code 与 JetBrains 使用，提供 1M 上下文与最多 131,072 输出 tokens。
events.summary_en: Kilo announces NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL across Desktop, CLI, VS Code and JetBrains, with 1M context and up to 131,072 output tokens.
key_points_zh: 据平台介绍，模型为 120B 总参数 / 12B 激活参数，支持图像、视频、可配置思考、工具调用和 JSON schema 输出。
KiloBench 的 53% 为平台自己的测评结果，本站未独立验证。
key_points_en: The platform describes 120B total / 12B active parameters, images, video, configurable thinking, tool calls and JSON-schema output.
The 53% KiloBench result is the platform’s own evaluation and has not been independently verified here.

events.summary_en: GitHub makes agentic autofix generally available: it examines relevant code, proposes fixes, reruns CodeQL and iterates before opening a draft pull request for review.
key_points_zh: 面向 Enterprise Cloud 的 Code Security / Advanced Security 客户，含数据驻留；需企业策略、组织或仓库启用及 Copilot 计费方式。
仅默认分支警报，可将最多 25 个警报合并修复；消耗 Code Security 预算中的 AI Credits 与 Actions 分钟。
key_points_en: Available to Code Security / Advanced Security customers on Enterprise Cloud, including data residency; requires enterprise policy, org/repository enablement and a Copilot billing method.
Only default-branch alerts are supported; up to 25 can share a fix. It consumes AI Credits from the Code Security budget and Actions minutes.

key_points_en: Mobile can fork remote CLI sessions at a message; MCP OAuth recovery no longer clears credentials just refreshed by another session.
Fixes stuck subagent permission prompts, Windows job state and MCP leaks when startup is cancelled.

allowed-tools 保留参数内部逗号；存在歧义的无作用域规则改为询问。

allowed-tools preserves commas inside arguments; ambiguous unscoped rules now prompt.

events.summary_en: Hermes says 0.22.1 was built from the wrong commit, included unreleased gateway work and could leave the Microsoft Store app stuck on Connecting. Version 0.22.2 restores the intended release line.
key_points_zh: 修复重启后 PID 复用导致网关无法启动；本地模型长任务支持流式进度、休眠计时排除与恢复重试。
已知问题：在 0.22.1 网关运行过的会话在 0.22.2 中仍不能删除；CLI 可运行 hermes update，Store 通过商店更新。
key_points_en: Fixes recycled PIDs preventing gateway startup; long local-model turns gain streamed progress, sleep-aware stall timers and recovery retries.
Known issue: sessions run under the 0.22.1 gateway cannot be deleted in 0.22.2. CLI installs use hermes update; Store installs update through the Store.

events.title_zh: TRAE 3.4.1–3.4.4：TraeWork 对话迁移、统一 @ 引用与企业云任务策略
events.title_en: TRAE 3.4.1–3.4.4 add TraeWork migration, unified @ references and enterprise cloud-task policy
events.summary_zh: TRAE 发布 3.4.1 至 3.4.4 版本，新增从 TraeWork 一键迁移 Agent 对话、聊天框统一 @ 上下文引用、HTML Artifact 富预览分享与企业版云任务策略，并修复 WSL 附件路径等问题。
events.summary_en: TRAE releases versions 3.4.1 through 3.4.4, adding one-click migration of agent conversations from TraeWork, a unified @ context menu, rich previews for shared HTML artifacts and an enterprise cloud-task policy, while fixing issues such as WSL attachment paths.
key_points_zh: 支持从 TraeWork 一键迁移 Agent 对话数据，包含自动检测安装、迁移进度、失败重试和迁移后可选卸载。
聊天输入框支持 @ 触发统一上下文引用菜单，可按类别浏览或搜索文件、文件夹、文档、规则与历史对话。
HTML Artifact 分享链接可在社交平台和搜索引擎展示标题、描述与缩略图。
企业版管理员可通过组织策略控制云端任务可用性，禁用时阻止远程会话的输入和发送。
新增每日签到抽奖，用户可从账户菜单或侧边栏横幅参与并获得积分或优惠券。
修复 WSL 附件 Windows 路径转换、HTML Artifact 重复显示及长页面图片导出失败提示不清等问题。
key_points_en: Agent conversation data can be migrated from TraeWork in one click, including automatic install detection, migration progress, retry on failure and an optional uninstall after migration.
The chat input supports an @-triggered unified context menu for browsing or searching files, folders, documents, rules and past conversations by category.
Shared HTML artifact links now show a title, description and thumbnail on social platforms and search engines.
Enterprise administrators can control cloud-task availability through an organization policy, which blocks input and sending in remote sessions when disabled.
A daily check-in lottery lets users earn points or coupons from the account menu or sidebar banner.
Fixes include Windows-to-Linux path conversion for WSL attachments, duplicate HTML artifact cards and unclear errors when exporting long pages as images.
events.importance_reason_zh: Agent 应用的功能、企业控制与兼容性更新，影响多版本用户迁移和日常使用。
events.importance_reason_en: Feature, enterprise-control and compatibility updates to an agent application that affect migration and daily use across versions.

events.title_zh: Anthropic 向 METR 开放员工级访问，启动独立评估常驻安排
events.title_en: Anthropic gives METR employee-level access in embedded independent evaluation arrangement
events.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布已开始向非营利评估机构 METR 的一个团队提供类似员工的内部访问权限，用于独立评估前沿模型风险。METR 将发布评估结果；Anthropic 不能否决发布，但可要求隐去预定义类别的信息。
events.summary_en: Anthropic says it has begun giving a team from the nonprofit evaluator METR employee-like access to its internal systems to independently assess frontier-model risks. METR will publish its assessments; Anthropic cannot veto publication but can require redaction of predefined categories of information.
key_points_zh: Anthropic 已为 6 名 METR 员工提供公司硬件、办公空间及与内部风险评估团队大致相当的系统和工具访问。
除客户数据、律师-客户保密信息和模型架构等少数预定义类别外，Anthropic 员工被鼓励像对待同事一样与 METR 分享信息。
Anthropic 不能否决 METR 发布结论，但可要求隐去预定义类别的信息；METR 保留就所获访问级别发表声明的权利。
Anthropic 同时与 SecureBio、Accenture 和 Faculty 等评估方合作，并在与 Hugging Face 等组织初步洽谈；评估方访问分为三级。
key_points_en: Anthropic has given six METR employees company hardware, office space and access to internal tools and systems roughly comparable to its own risk-assessment teams.

Outside a few predefined categories such as customer data, attorney-client privileged information and model architectures, Anthropic employees are encouraged to share information with METR as they would with a colleague.
Anthropic cannot veto METR's publication of its findings but can require redaction of predefined categories; METR reserves the right to make certain statements about the level of access it received.
Anthropic is also working with SecureBio, Accenture and Faculty, and is in early discussions with organizations including Hugging Face; evaluator access is organized into three tiers.

events.summary_zh: Tibo 表示已向 ChatGPT 与 Codex 桌面应用推出磁盘状态存储优化，预计减少约 60% 存储占用，以回应重度用户磁盘空间不足的反馈。
events.summary_en: Tibo says state-storage optimizations have rolled out for ChatGPT and Codex desktop apps and should reduce disk use by about 60%, responding to reports from heavy users running out of space.
key_points_zh: 60% 是负责人给出的预期幅度，原帖未说明测试条件或适用版本。
key_points_en: The 60% figure is the author’s expectation; the post does not specify test conditions or applicable versions.

events.title_zh: Gemini CLI 0.64.0：原子写入与损坏状态恢复进入稳定版
events.title_en: Gemini CLI 0.64.0 stabilizes atomic writes and corrupted-state recovery
events.summary_zh: 稳定版包含文件工具操作串行化与原子写入、状态备份恢复，以及无头模式目录信任状态传递修复。
events.summary_en: The stable release includes serialized file-tool operations, atomic writes, state recovery from backups and resolved folder-trust propagation in headless mode.
key_points_zh: 修复 @ 代码引用造成 CPU 卡死，以及活动操作中 Ctrl+C 无法触达取消处理。
ACP 桥接 usage_update 通知，改善精确会话 ID 解析及失败后的监听器清理。
key_points_en: Fixes CPU hangs on @ references in code and Ctrl+C failing to reach cancellation during active work.
ACP bridges usage_update notifications and improves exact session-ID lookup and listener cleanup after failures.

events.importance_reason_en: Material changes to functionality, compatibility or conditions of use.

events.title_zh: Gemini CLI 0.65 预览：不可信目录只读设置与恢复历史保护
events.title_en: Gemini CLI 0.65 preview enforces untrusted-folder settings and protects resumed history
events.summary_zh: 0.65.0-preview.0 在不可信目录强制工作区设置只读，并修复恢复会话时重复工具响应及快速退出删除历史的问题。
events.summary_en: Version 0.65.0-preview.0 enforces read-only workspace settings in untrusted folders and fixes duplicate tool-response turns and history deletion on quick exit after resume.
key_points_zh: 修复快速 Ctrl+C 导致会话状态污染；OAuth callback iss 验证对齐 RFC 9207 元数据。
避免 @ 引用提前递归读取文件，单个扩展未通过 allowlist 不再阻止其他扩展加载。
key_points_en: Fixes session poisoning on rapid Ctrl+C; OAuth callback iss validation follows RFC 9207 metadata.
Avoids eager recursive reading for @ references; one extension failing its allowlist check no longer stops others loading.

events.title_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.97：agent hooks 与恢复写入保护

events.summary_zh: 稳定版加入自定义 agent 作用域的声明式 hooks，并修复恢复已中断调用、插件 hooks 与配置保留问题。
events.summary_en: The stable release adds declarative hooks scoped to custom agents and fixes interrupted-call recovery, plugin hooks and settings preservation.
key_points_zh: Autopilot 拒绝 preToolUse 的 ask，避免无人处理的权限窗口阻塞。
恢复会话不重放已取消写入；长会话紧急内存释放可绕过冷却时间以避免堆内存崩溃。
key_points_en: Autopilot denies preToolUse ask decisions to avoid unattended permission dialogs.
Resume avoids replaying cancelled writes; emergency memory relief can bypass its cooldown to avoid heap crashes.

events.summary_en: Google launched Gemini 4 Argon through its developer and enterprise APIs, with Gemini app / Search access for AI Pro and Ultra and Antigravity for Ultra. Introductory API rates are $2 input and $10 output per million tokens, with 95% off cached input.

events.title_zh: Cline Desktop 0.0.46：定时任务、推理设置与自动压缩修复
events.title_en: Cline Desktop 0.0.46 fixes scheduled routines, reasoning settings and compaction
events.summary_zh: 修复定时任务永久排队、模型调用失败未标失败及宕机后补跑全部历史任务的问题；改善推理关闭、模型目录及自动压缩。
events.summary_en: Fixes routines stuck pending, failed model calls not marked failed and replay of every missed run after downtime, while improving reasoning controls, model catalogs and compaction.
key_points_zh: 停机后仅补跑最近一次遗漏；任务编辑器使用当前模型。
图片不再抬高 token 估计；自动压缩可使用所选模型上下文，支持 .claude/skills 与符号链接规则。
key_points_en: Only the latest missed run executes after downtime; the editor lists current models.
Images no longer inflate token estimates; compaction can use the selected context window, and .claude/skills and symlink rules are supported.

Fixes inflated image estimates causing early compaction and restores symlink rules and .claude/skills discovery.

events.title_zh: Kilo JetBrains 7.1.10-rc.3：Windows 后台进程与停止确认修复
events.title_en: Kilo JetBrains 7.1.10-rc.3: Windows background-process and stop fixes
events.summary_zh: Kilo JetBrains 候选版改用 Windows job object 跟踪后台进程，避免收养无关进程，并在可信进程检查确认退出前保留停止请求。
events.summary_en: The Kilo JetBrains release candidate tracks Windows background processes with a job object, avoids adopting unrelated processes, and retains stop requests until a trustworthy process walk confirms exit.
key_points_zh: glob 工具支持用户选择的忽略路径允许列表。
退出确认期间保持停止响应，无法确认停止时报告仍存活的主进程。
key_points_en: The glob tool supports an opt-in allowlist of ignored paths.
Stopping remains responsive during exit confirmation and reports a surviving leader when exit is unconfirmed.
events.importance_reason_zh: 预览版修复后台进程控制可靠性。
events.importance_reason_en: The preview improves background-process control reliability.

events.title_zh: Cline CLI 3.0.71 / SDK 0.0.93：进程内插件与定时任务修复
events.title_en: Cline CLI 3.0.71 / SDK 0.0.93: in-process plugins and scheduled-run fixes
events.summary_zh: Cline 默认在 hub 进程内加载插件，不再要求 PATH 中有 Node 或 Bun；插件错误可见，并修复 ACP 思考设置、图像 token 估计和定时任务停滞。
events.summary_en: Cline loads plugins inside the hub by default without requiring Node or Bun on PATH, exposes plugin failures, and fixes ACP reasoning settings, image-token estimates and stalled scheduled runs.
key_points_zh: CLINE_PLUGIN_MODE=sandbox 可保留旧子进程行为；cline hub plugins 可查看状态和重载插件。
--thinking 在 ACP 模式生效；关闭思考按各提供商能力处理。
排队任务可正常启动，模型失败记为失败，停机后的错过任务只运行最新一次；发现 .claude/skills。
key_points_en: CLINE_PLUGIN_MODE=sandbox retains subprocess behavior; cline hub plugins inspects status and reloads plugins.
--thinking works in ACP mode; disabling reasoning respects each provider’s capabilities.
Queued runs start, model errors mark runs failed, and only the latest missed occurrence runs after downtime; .claude/skills is discovered.
events.importance_reason_zh: 影响插件部署、模型兼容性和定时任务可靠性。
events.importance_reason_en: Affects plugin deployment, model compatibility and scheduled-run reliability.

key_points_zh: 超过 100 个定义和深层目录中的代理都可被发现。
key_points_en: Agents beyond 100 definitions and in deeply nested directories are discovered.
events.importance_reason_zh: 解除影响大型代理目录使用的发现限制。
events.importance_reason_en: Removes a discovery limitation affecting large agent catalogs.

events.title_zh: Tibo 发布“Day 8/ Reset”短帖
events.title_en: Tibo posts “Day 8/ Reset”
events.summary_zh: Tibo 发布“Day 8/ Reset”一手状态短帖，未交代重置对象或用量规则。
events.summary_en: Tibo posts the first-hand status note “Day 8/ Reset” without identifying the reset target or usage rules.
key_points_zh: 保留原帖范围，不推断传播完成或套餐变化。
key_points_en: Preserves the post’s scope without inferring completed propagation or plan changes.

events.title_zh: Kilo 7.8.9 预发布：修复权限卡住、MCP 泄漏和模型兼容
events.title_en: Kilo 7.8.9 preview: fixes stuck permissions, MCP leaks and model compatibility
events.summary_zh: Kilo 7.8.9 预发布修复子代理权限提示卡住、取消期间启动的 MCP 服务器堆积，以及 Bedrock GPT-6 / GPT-5.6 图像工具结果兼容性。
events.summary_en: Kilo 7.8.9 is labeled a pre-release and fixes stuck subagent permission prompts, MCP servers accumulating during canceled startup, and Bedrock GPT-6 / GPT-5.6 image tool-result compatibility.
key_points_zh: JetBrains 遵循全局和项目 permission.edit 配置；TUI 切换会话后恢复待回答权限提示。
压缩遇到空摘要或不可恢复上下文溢出时报告错误并保留历史。
Agent Manager 支持项目拖动排序并保存顺序。
key_points_en: JetBrains respects global and project permission.edit settings; TUI session switches restore pending permission prompts.
Compaction reports empty summaries or unrecoverable overflow and preserves history.
Agent Manager supports persistent drag-and-drop project ordering.
events.importance_reason_zh: 涉及权限处理、长会话和工具进程可靠性。
events.importance_reason_en: Affects permissions, long sessions and tool-process reliability.

events.title_zh: Cursor Origin 应用市场开放公开提交
events.title_en: Cursor Origin opens its app marketplace to public submissions
events.summary_zh: Origin 集成超过 20 个部署、CI、审查、安全与项目管理应用，并开放开发团队提交应用供审核上架。
events.summary_en: Origin integrates over 20 deployment, CI, review, security and project-management apps and opens submissions for review and listing.
key_points_zh: 应用使用 JWT 与安装访问 token 认证，接收 webhook，并可写入检查、PR 评论和审查。
提交需 slug、标签与演示视频，审核通过后才公开列出。
key_points_en: Apps authenticate with JWTs and installation tokens, receive webhooks and write checks, PR comments and reviews.
Submissions require a slug, tags and a demo video; listing follows approval.
events.importance_reason_zh: 涉及实际功能、兼容性或使用条件的重要变化。
events.importance_reason_en: Material changes to functionality, compatibility or conditions of use.

events.title_zh: ZCode 3.15.3：修复更新无法退出、登录与并行任务失败
events.title_en: ZCode 3.15.3: fixes stalled updates, sign-in and parallel tasks
events.summary_zh: ZCode 3.15.3 修复更新期间无法正常退出、连接套餐登录失败，以及多个代理并行或快速调用模型时请求失败的问题。
events.summary_en: ZCode 3.15.3 fixes failure to exit during updates, plan-connection sign-in failures and failed requests during parallel agents or rapid model calls.
key_points_zh: 从 3.15.1 升级仍可能因旧版问题卡住，官方建议下载完整安装包；强制退出会中断任务。
修复反复展示引导和慢网络下启动检查卡住。
key_points_en: Upgrading from 3.15.1 can still stall due to the old version; the provider recommends the full installer, and force quitting interrupts tasks.
Fixes repeated onboarding and stalled startup checks on slow networks.
events.importance_reason_zh: 修复升级、认证及并行任务可靠性。
events.importance_reason_en: Improves update, authentication and parallel-task reliability.

events.title_zh: Hermes 0.22：本地模型、应用连接器与签名桌面包
events.title_en: Hermes 0.22 adds local models, app connectors and signed desktop packages
events.summary_zh: Hermes 0.22 引入无 Key 首次设置试用、应用连接器与一键 llama.cpp 本地模型；稳定发布渠道、签名桌面包及统一包管理器共同调整安装与更新流程。说明标注 10 月 13 日发布。
events.summary_en: Hermes 0.22 introduces keyless onboarding trials, app connectors and one-click llama.cpp local models. Stable release channels, signed desktop packages and a unified package manager reshape installation and updates. The notes date the release October 13.
key_points_zh: 官方称插件目录已达 600 项；增加浏览器密码管理器登录、可接管的 Bot Screen 与实时子 agent 控制。
托管安装使用 Python 3.14；Windows 桌面要求 Windows 11 22H2+，默认 macOS 包限 Apple Silicon；90 天未活动的已结束会话默认自动清理，可关闭。
key_points_en: The project reports 600 catalog plugins and adds browser password-manager sign-in, a take-over Bot Screen and live subagent controls.
Managed installs use Python 3.14; Windows Desktop requires Windows 11 22H2+, default macOS packages target Apple Silicon; ended sessions inactive for 90 days are pruned by default, with an opt-out.
events.importance_reason_zh: 涉及实际功能、兼容性或使用条件的重要变化。
events.importance_reason_en: Material changes to functionality, compatibility or conditions of use.

events.title_zh: Google 展示 Gemini 4 Argon 机器人闭环控制
events.title_en: Google demonstrates closed-loop robotics with Gemini 4 Argon
events.summary_zh: Google 展示 Gemini 4 Argon 通过视觉反馈与代码控制机器人，包括手眼相机观察、抓取后复查及动作调整；演示不等于通用机器人产品上线。
events.summary_en: Google demonstrated Gemini 4 Argon controlling robots through visual feedback and code, including wrist-camera observations, grasp checks and action corrections; the demonstrations do not establish a general robotics product launch.
key_points_zh: 还展示通过检查中间帧来迭代引导 Gemini Omni 世界模型。
key_points_en: Also demonstrates iterative steering of the Gemini Omni world model by inspecting intermediate frames.
events.importance_reason_zh: 涉及实际功能、兼容性或使用条件的重要变化。
events.importance_reason_en: Material changes to functionality, compatibility or conditions of use.

events.title_zh: Kiro CLI 2.31.0 向 V3 用户开放本地命令沙箱与自主模式
events.title_en: Kiro CLI 2.31.0 opens local command sandbox and autonomous mode to V3 users
events.summary_zh: Kiro CLI 2.31.0 向所有 V3 用户开放本地命令沙箱与本地自主模式，同时按需加载 MCP 工具，并将 KIRO_HOME 扩展到 V3 配置和状态。
events.summary_en: Kiro CLI 2.31.0 makes the local command sandbox and local autonomous mode available to all V3 users, loads MCP tools on demand and extends KIRO_HOME across V3 configuration and state.
key_points_zh: /sandbox 将 Agent 的 shell 命令及其子进程放入操作系统沙箱；出站网络可禁用、限常见开发主机或开放，本地 stdio MCP 服务器也可使用该沙箱。
Agent 本身、内置文件工具和远程 MCP 服务器在沙箱之外；权限规则仍然生效，不能据此认为所有操作均被隔离。
在本地 V3 会话运行 /autonomous on，会先启用命令沙箱并切换至 Default agent，减少逐条 shell 命令审批。
key_points_en: /sandbox places agent shell commands and child processes in an OS sandbox, with outbound networking blocked, limited to common development hosts or open; local stdio MCP servers can use the same sandbox.
The agent, built-in file tools and remote MCP servers remain outside the sandbox; permission rules still apply, so it does not isolate every action.
Running /autonomous on in a local V3 session first enables the command sandbox and switches to the Default agent, reducing per-command shell approvals.
events.importance_reason_zh: 为本地 Agent 执行加入具体的进程与网络边界，并明确自主模式前提。
events.importance_reason_en: Adds explicit process and network boundaries for local agent execution and defines autonomous-mode prerequisites.

events.title_zh: Kiro IDE 1.3.0：本地命令沙箱、聊天启动工作流与标签状态
events.title_en: Kiro IDE 1.3.0 adds a command sandbox, workflow launch from chat and live tab status
events.summary_zh: Kiro IDE 1.3.0 可限制 Agent shell 命令访问范围，并从聊天启动已保存的 Workflows；同时显示编辑器标签的会话状态、说明模型回退并按需加载 MCP 工具。
events.summary_en: Kiro IDE 1.3.0 can limit agent shell-command access and launch saved Workflows from chat. It also shows session status on editor tabs, explains model fallbacks and loads MCP tools on demand.
key_points_zh: 命令沙箱覆盖 shell 命令、子进程及可选本地 stdio MCP 服务器；网络可禁用、限开发主机或开放。Agent、内置文件工具和远程 MCP 仍在沙箱外。
通过状态栏 Command sandbox 确认是否启用；/workflow-run 可选择配方、填写输入并打开新工作流运行。
key_points_en: The sandbox covers shell commands, child processes and optionally local stdio MCP servers, with blocked, development-host-only or open networking. The agent, built-in file tools and remote MCP remain outside it.
Confirm activation through Command sandbox in the status bar; /workflow-run selects a recipe, collects inputs and opens a new workflow run.
events.importance_reason_zh: 改善 IDE 内任务执行边界及重复工作流的启动方式。
events.importance_reason_en: Improves execution boundaries and reusable workflow launch inside the IDE.

events.title_zh: Pi 1.2.0：按 Key 获取 OpenRouter 模型，调整扩展运行接口
events.title_en: Pi 1.2.0: per-key OpenRouter catalogs and extension-run changes
events.summary_zh: Pi 1.2.0 按 OpenRouter Key 的权限、地域与限制加载模型目录，并发布配置 schema；扩展触发的运行也会执行 before_agent_start，带来接口迁移要求。
events.summary_en: Pi 1.2.0 loads OpenRouter catalogs according to key permissions, regions and limits, publishes configuration schemas, and runs before_agent_start for extension-triggered turns, requiring extension migration.
key_points_zh: 模型目录使用 /models/user，保留对应上下文、输出和价格，缓存可离线复用。
before_agent_start 按 messageType 区分 user / custom；主题 schema 移至 pi.dev/schemas/theme.schema.json。
修复 MCP OAuth 刷新后仍发送已取消调用、issuer 无法校验却接受登录，以及长生成中断。
key_points_en: Catalogs use /models/user with key-specific context, output and pricing; saved lists work offline.
before_agent_start distinguishes user / custom messageType; the theme schema moves to pi.dev/schemas/theme.schema.json.
Fixes canceled MCP calls being sent after OAuth refresh, accepting unverifiable issuers, and interruptions during long generation.
events.importance_reason_zh: 扩展接口有破坏性变更，并改进模型权限与认证可靠性。
events.importance_reason_en: Includes breaking extension changes and improves model permissions and authentication reliability.

events.title_zh: Copilot 企业遥测：身份归属与五类内容独立控制
events.title_en: Copilot enterprise telemetry: identity attribution and separate capture classes
events.summary_zh: 管理员可在 Copilot CLI、桌面应用和使用 Agent Host 的 VS Code 会话中独立控制遥测身份及五类内容采集；所有类别默认关闭。
events.summary_en: Administrators can separately control telemetry identity and five content capture classes in Copilot CLI, the desktop app and VS Code Agent Host sessions; all classes are off by default.
key_points_zh: telemetry.capture.identity 添加 Copilot 登录名、系统账户名和主机名。
prompts、responses、toolArguments、toolOutput、policyDetail 可独立设置；托管设置优先于本地、SDK 和环境变量。
旧 captureContent 简写只控制五类内容，不启用身份采集。
key_points_en: telemetry.capture.identity adds the Copilot login, OS account name and host name.
prompts, responses, toolArguments, toolOutput and policyDetail are independent; managed values override local, SDK and environment settings.
Legacy captureContent controls the five content classes without enabling identity capture.
events.importance_reason_zh: 改变企业审计和内容采集的治理粒度。
events.importance_reason_en: Changes the granularity of enterprise audit and content-capture governance.

events.title_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.97-0：代理 Hook 与无人值守权限修复
events.title_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.97-0: agent hooks and unattended-permission fixes
events.summary_zh: Copilot CLI 新增自定义代理的声明式 Hook，并修复 Autopilot 遇到 ask 决定时停在无人处理的权限对话框，以及恢复会话重放已取消写入等问题。
events.summary_en: Copilot CLI adds agent-scoped declarative hooks and fixes Autopilot stopping at unattended ask dialogs and resumed sessions replaying canceled writes.
key_points_zh: Autopilot 对 preToolUse Hook 的 ask 决定执行拒绝。
/usage 显示按 token 计费会话的 AI Credits，恢复后仍可查看；JSON 输出安全脱敏。
受支持终端默认显示内联图片；修复插件目录技能和代理发现及恢复 Hook 列表。
key_points_en: Autopilot denies a preToolUse hook’s ask decision.
/usage shows billed AI Credits for token-billed sessions, including after resume; JSON output masks secrets safely.
Supported terminals show inline images by default; fixes plugin-directory skill and agent discovery and resumed hook lists.
events.importance_reason_zh: 影响无人值守安全、账单可见性与恢复会话可靠性。
events.importance_reason_en: Affects unattended safety, billing visibility and resumed-session reliability.

events.title_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.96：沙箱目录授权与权限来源正式更新
events.title_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.96: sandbox-directory grants and permission attribution
events.summary_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.96 汇总交互式沙箱凭据设置、/add-dir 当前会话目录授权和权限决定来源显示；此前分别在带后缀版本中提供。
events.summary_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.96 consolidates interactive sandbox credential setup, /add-dir grants for the current session and permission-decision attribution, previously provided in suffixed versions.
key_points_zh: 可在保存凭据前添加 masking hosts；时间线显示用户、Assisted Permissions、策略或无人值守回退。
模型 ID 不区分大小写并保存规范 ID；企业策略解析期间保留 /allow-all。
key_points_en: Masking hosts can be added before saving credentials; the timeline identifies user, Assisted Permissions, policy or unattended fallback decisions.
Model IDs are case-insensitive and saved canonically; /allow-all remains available during enterprise-policy resolution.
events.importance_reason_zh: 正式版本改善沙箱授权、凭据设置与权限可见性。
events.importance_reason_en: The release improves sandbox grants, credential setup and permission visibility.

events.title_zh: 扎克伯格介绍 Muse Wonder 前沿模型系列
events.title_en: Zuckerberg introduces the Muse Wonder frontier-model family

events.summary_en: Zuckerberg introduces Muse Wonder as a frontier-model family for personal and professional agentic work and claims state-of-the-art performance; the post provides no model list or test details.
key_points_zh: 性能保留负责人归属，不写成本站独立验证。

events.title_zh: Tibo 谈 Pro 100 / 200 / 500 用量翻倍与五小时限制调查
events.title_en: Tibo discusses the Pro 100 / 200 / 500 usage-doubling poll
events.summary_zh: Tibo 称调查结果令其困惑，原本预计更多人支持以恢复五小时限制换取 Pro 100 / 200 / 500 用量翻倍，从而平滑需求。
events.summary_en: Tibo says the poll results surprised him: he expected stronger support for doubling Pro 100 / 200 / 500 usage in exchange for restoring five-hour limits to smooth demand.

events.title_zh: Kiro CLI：启动时切换 V3，新增模型回退提示
events.title_en: Kiro CLI: V3 startup migration and model-fallback notices
events.summary_zh: Kiro CLI 在渐进发布中加入启动时切换至 V3 的邀请提示，并提供 V3 模型回退通知。订阅材料为简介。
events.summary_en: Kiro CLI adds an invitation to switch to V3 at startup during a gradual rollout and V3 model-fallback notices. The feed provides an excerpt.
key_points_zh: 升级代理至 V3 时保留更多 V2 代理访问，修复屏幕阅读器、tmux 和知识搜索问题。
key_points_en: Preserves more V2 agent access during V3 upgrades and fixes screen-reader, tmux and knowledge-search issues.
events.importance_reason_zh: 影响 V3 迁移与模型回退可见性。
events.importance_reason_en: Affects V3 migration and visibility into model fallbacks.

events.title_zh: Kiro 宣布纳入美国弗吉尼亚北部 FedRAMP Class C 范围
events.title_en: Kiro announces FedRAMP Class C scope in Northern Virginia
events.summary_zh: Kiro 官方订阅称，该产品已在 US East（N. Virginia）区域纳入 FedRAMP Class C 范围，面向受相应要求约束的机构开展 AI 辅助开发。
events.summary_en: Kiro’s official feed says the product is in FedRAMP Class C scope in US East (N. Virginia) for organizations subject to those requirements.
key_points_zh: 公告列举美国政府机构、承包商及其他受该要求约束的组织；证据范围为简介。
key_points_en: The announcement names US agencies, contractors and other subject organizations; evidence is an excerpt.
events.importance_reason_zh: 扩大受监管机构的产品可用性。
events.importance_reason_en: Expands product availability for regulated organizations.

events.title_zh: ZCode 3.15.1：工作流并发与模型控制，强化浏览器权限
events.title_en: ZCode 3.15.1: workflow concurrency and model controls, plus browser permissions
events.summary_zh: ZCode 增加工作流参数预调、运行中并发调整、回放和逐子代理模型设置，支持 MCP App 与飞书群聊协作，并修复浏览器权限默认允许问题。
events.summary_en: ZCode adds workflow parameter tuning, live concurrency changes, replay and per-subagent models, supports MCP Apps and Feishu group collaboration, and fixes browser permissions being allowed by default.
key_points_zh: Autonomous Mode 执行危险命令前要求确认；浏览器相机等站点权限提供确认提示。
推荐活动 10 月 12 日至 11 月 13 日，具体 Token Boost 资格与额度以 Rewards Center 为准。
修复飞书授权过期后任务不响应、Windows 链接启动安全问题。
key_points_en: Autonomous Mode requests confirmation for dangerous commands; the browser prompts for site permissions such as camera access.
The referral campaign runs October 12–November 13; Token Boost eligibility and allowances follow the Rewards Center.
Fixes unresponsive Feishu tasks after authorization expires and a Windows link-launch security issue.
events.importance_reason_zh: 扩展工作流和协作能力并修复权限安全问题。
events.importance_reason_en: Expands workflow and collaboration capabilities and fixes permission-security issues.

events.title_zh: The X Subscription 整合 Grok、Cursor 与 X，旧套餐可保留
events.title_en: The X Subscription combines Grok, Cursor and X; existing plans can stay
events.summary_zh: SpaceXAI 宣布 The X Subscription，整合 Grok、Grok Bot、Cursor 与 X。新购用户采用新套餐，旧订阅可保留现有价格和权益，也可按账号开放进度迁移。
events.summary_en: SpaceXAI announces The X Subscription combining Grok, Grok Bot, Cursor and X. New customers use the new plans; existing subscribers can retain their prices and benefits or switch as account rollout permits.
key_points_zh: 月费 Free $0、Plus $8、Premium $30、Super $100、Ultra $200；付费档共享 Grok 用量，后面三档为 Plus 的 4×、15×、50×。
新套餐按周刷新；Premium 及以上可在 Cursor 额外按 API 标价购买第三方模型用量，不包含第三方模型额度。
Teams Premium / Super / Ultra 为每席位 $30 / $100 / $200；旧套餐停止新购但已有订阅不立即改变。
key_points_en: Monthly tiers are Free $0, Plus $8, Premium $30, Super $100 and Ultra $200; paid plans share Grok usage, with the top three at 4×, 15× and 50× Plus.
New allowances refresh weekly; Premium and higher can separately buy third-party Cursor usage at API list prices without included third-party allowances.
Teams Premium / Super / Ultra cost $30 / $100 / $200 per seat; older plans close to new sign-ups while existing subscriptions remain unchanged.
events.importance_reason_zh: 实质改变新购定价、共享额度和第三方模型计费边界。
events.importance_reason_en: Materially changes new-purchase prices, shared usage and third-party-model billing.

events.title_zh: Kiro Web 新增模型回退、步骤模型选择与会话恢复预览
events.title_en: Kiro Web adds model fallback, per-step models and session reopen previews
events.summary_zh: Kiro Web 可为模型选择回退模型，为工作流步骤单独选择模型，并在沙箱重启期间预览已保存对话；达到循环次数上限后也可继续运行。
events.summary_en: Kiro Web can assign fallback models, select a model per workflow step and preview saved conversations while a sandbox restarts. Workflow loops can also continue after reaching their iteration cap.
key_points_zh: 原模型暂不可用时，回退仅处理当前轮；若原模型拒绝请求，则后续会话继续使用回退模型。
更换步骤模型前需停止该步骤，再发消息继续；仅影响该步骤，支持时可选择 effort 与 Thinking。
循环暂停后可增加 1–1,000 次迭代，或停止循环并进入下一步；会话恢复后完整历史替换预览。
key_points_en: If the original model is unavailable, fallback handles only that turn; if it refuses a request, fallback remains for the rest of the session.
Stop a step before changing its model, then send a message to continue; the choice affects only that step, with effort and Thinking controls when supported.
After a loop pauses, add 1–1,000 iterations or stop looping and continue to the next step; the complete history replaces the reopen preview once ready.
events.importance_reason_zh: 影响长任务的模型容错、工作流执行控制与恢复体验。
events.importance_reason_en: Changes model resilience, workflow control and recovery for long-running tasks.

events.title_zh: Devin：个人记忆与夜间整理，恢复会话窗口改为 14 天
events.title_en: Devin: personal memory and nightly refinement, with 14-day resume windows
events.summary_zh: Devin 新增跨会话个人记忆和夜间 dreaming 整理，记忆不与组织共享；睡眠会话恢复窗口由 30 天缩短为 14 天。
events.summary_en: Devin adds personal cross-session memory and nightly dreaming refinement without sharing memory with the organization; the resume window for sleeping sessions falls from 30 to 14 days.
key_points_zh: 用户可查看记忆文件并开关；组织可控制，企业可强制开关。
14 天后历史仍可查看，新工作需新建会话；仓库 setup 自动加载根目录 AGENTS.md。
启用 Ultra 预览的零数据保留企业也可使用；新增扫描发现管理权限和按 1、3、9 次失败退避通知。
key_points_en: Users can inspect memory files and toggle memory; organizations can control it and enterprises can enforce it.
History remains available after 14 days but new work requires a new session; repository setup loads root AGENTS.md.
Enterprises with Ultra preview enabled can use it with zero data retention; adds scan-finding management permissions and failure notifications at 1, 3, 9 consecutive failures.
events.importance_reason_zh: 改变长期上下文、会话恢复和企业治理。
events.importance_reason_en: Changes long-term context, session recovery and enterprise governance.

events.title_zh: 硅基流动上线高速版 GLM-5.3-Flash：缓存 ¥0.23、输入 ¥0.8、输出 ¥2.8 每百万 tokens
events.title_en: SiliconFlow launches high-speed GLM-5.3-Flash at CNY 0.23 cached / 0.8 input / 2.8 output per million tokens
events.summary_zh: 硅基流动宣布上线高速版 GLM-5.3-Flash，平台价格为缓存命中 ¥0.23、输入 ¥0.8、输出 ¥2.8 每百万 tokens。平台称其为智谱 GLM-5 系列首款原生多模态模型，支持 1M 上下文与视觉编程，并引用 Artificial Analysis 42 分、与 Claude Opus 4.8 (max) 持平的评价（平台表述，未经本站验证）。
events.summary_en: SiliconFlow announced high-speed GLM-5.3-Flash with platform pricing of CNY 0.23 cached / 0.8 input / 2.8 output per million tokens. The platform calls it the first natively multimodal model in Zhipu’s GLM-5 series, citing 1M context and visual-coding workflows plus an Artificial Analysis score of 42 that it says matches Claude Opus 4.8 (max) (platform claims, not independently verified here).
key_points_zh: 平台价格为缓存命中 ¥0.23、输入 ¥0.8、输出 ¥2.8 每百万 tokens。
平台称其融合稀疏注意力与线性注意力并支持 1M 长上下文，以视觉反馈闭环支持前端、游戏、3D 等编码场景；能力与评测表述来自平台方。
key_points_en: Platform pricing: CNY 0.23 cached / 0.8 input / 2.8 output per million tokens.

The platform says it combines sparse and linear attention with 1M-token context and uses a visual feedback loop for frontend, game and 3D coding; capability and benchmark claims are the platform’s own.
events.importance_reason_zh: 涉及平台定价与可用性的重要变化。
events.importance_reason_en: Material platform pricing and availability changes.

events.title_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.94：Haiku 5.5 与 MCP、权限恢复
events.title_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.94 adds Haiku 5.5 and improves MCP and permission recovery
events.summary_zh: 正式版本接入 Haiku 5.5，并汇集 MCP 初始化、托管权限策略和会话切换修复。
events.summary_en: The stable release adds Haiku 5.5 and consolidates fixes for MCP initialization, managed permission policies and session switching.
key_points_zh: MCP 初始化中断后可恢复；服务器发现前即可启停，不启动服务器。
Assisted Permissions 将可见 Shell 代码交给权限判断；托管策略可禁用此模式。
key_points_en: MCP setup recovers after interrupted initialization; servers can be enabled or disabled before discovery without starting them.
Assisted Permissions sends visible shell code to the permission judge; managed policy can disable the mode.
events.importance_reason_zh: 更新模型可用性并改善权限和 MCP 工作流。
events.importance_reason_en: Updates model availability and improves permission and MCP workflows.

events.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.295：失败 hook 可阻止动作，扩展网关控制
events.title_en: Claude Code 2.1.295 adds blocking failed hooks and gateway controls
events.summary_zh: 命令及 HTTP hook 可设置 onFailure: "block"，在无法启动、超时或异常退出时阻止动作；网关增加上游模型列表和等待首个响应的超时设置。
events.summary_en: Command and HTTP hooks support onFailure: "block" to stop actions on startup failure, timeout or unexpected exit; the gateway adds upstream model allowlists and time-to-first-response limits.
key_points_zh: 支持 OSC 7501 程序状态协议；MCP tool search 的描述截断阈值从 2,048 提升至 16,384 字符。
子 Agent 最多预加载 32 项 skills；WebSocket MCP 超过 16 MiB 的消息关闭连接。
key_points_en: Supports OSC 7501 status reporting; MCP tool-search description limits rise from 2,048 to 16,384 characters.
Subagents preload at most 32 skills; WebSocket MCP closes connections for messages larger than 16 MiB.
events.importance_reason_zh: 增强扩展失败时的动作控制与模型网关配置。
events.importance_reason_en: Strengthens action control on extension failures and model gateway configuration.

events.title_zh: Copilot 代码审查：组织计费与外部许可控制
events.title_en: Copilot code review: organization billing and external-license controls
events.summary_zh: 组织可以将持有 Copilot 许可成员发起的代码审查计入仓库所属组织，避免消耗成员个人额度，并限制外部许可触发审查。
events.summary_en: Organizations can bill code reviews requested by licensed members to the repository-owning organization instead of members’ allowances, and restrict requests using external licenses.
key_points_zh: Member 为默认计费选项，成员额度耗尽时审查失败。
Organization 选项要求启用 AI Credits 付费用量，可设置预算。
可要求使用本组织或企业提供的许可；组织开启后仓库管理员不能关闭。
key_points_en: Member is the default billing option; reviews fail when the member allowance is exhausted.
Organization billing requires AI Credits paid usage and supports an optional budget.
Requests can be restricted to organization- or enterprise-provided licenses; repository admins cannot override an organization restriction.
events.importance_reason_zh: 直接改变团队审查的扣费账户和许可边界。
events.importance_reason_en: Directly changes code-review billing accounts and license boundaries.

events.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.281：扩展 AGENTS.md 支持、网关护栏与 MCP 浏览器授权
events.title_en: Claude Code 2.1.281 expands AGENTS.md support, gateway guardrails and browser-based MCP flows
events.summary_zh: Claude Code 2.1.281 将 AGENTS.md 支持扩展至 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry、LLM 网关和关闭遥测的会话；Claude apps gateway 的 Bedrock 上游新增 STS assume_role 与统一 guardrail 配置，并支持 MCP 2026-07-28 协议的 URL 模式询问。
events.summary_en: Claude Code 2.1.281 expands AGENTS.md support to Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, LLM gateways and telemetry-disabled sessions. Bedrock upstreams in Claude apps gateway gain STS assume_role and guardrail configuration, and MCP connections using the 2026-07-28 protocol gain URL-mode elicitation.
key_points_zh: Bedrock 上游可通过 STS 承担角色，guardrail 必须覆盖全部 Bedrock 上游或全部不配。
自托管 runner 使用私有文件传递大 system prompt；相应 wrapper / hook 需改用文件参数。
自动模式和跳过权限模式中的危险 rm 提示等待两分钟后默认拒绝，并提供重写提示。
key_points_en: Bedrock upstreams can assume roles via STS; guardrails must be configured on all Bedrock upstreams or none.
Self-hosted runners pass large system prompts through private files; affected wrappers and hooks must use file arguments.
Dangerous rm prompts in auto mode and bypass-permission mode deny after two minutes and provide a rewrite hint.
events.importance_reason_zh: 补齐历史待审材料中的云端兼容和权限边界重要变化。
events.importance_reason_en: Resolves an older queued release with material cloud-compatibility and permission-boundary changes.

events.title_zh: Codex 0.162.0：托管工作树、自定义 provider 与沙箱修复
events.title_en: Codex 0.162.0 adds managed worktrees and provider controls with sandbox fixes
events.summary_zh: 受信任的本地项目在启用工作树功能后，可创建和列出托管 Git 工作树；自定义 Responses provider 可配置实时网页访问和远程压缩能力。
events.summary_en: Trusted local projects can create and list managed Git worktrees with the feature enabled; custom Responses providers gain live web-access and remote-compaction settings.
key_points_zh: Command Center 支持置顶任务，/copy 可导航和复制对话块；Code Mode 增加流式 promise 结果与可选排序工具搜索。
apply_patch 保留已有 CRLF；修复 Linux 沙箱启动、可写构造程序和 ripgrep 配置弱化拒绝规则的问题。
恢复 Windows 10 盘符文件访问，并遵循 Responses / WebSocket 的 Retry-After。
key_points_en: Command Center supports pinned tasks and /copy navigates transcript blocks; Code Mode adds streaming promise results and optional ranked tool search.
apply_patch preserves existing CRLF; fixes Linux sandbox startup, writable sandbox-construction programs and ripgrep configurations weakening deny masks.
Restores Windows 10 drive-letter file access and honors Retry-After for Responses and WebSocket failures.
events.importance_reason_zh: 扩展隔离工作流与 provider 能力，并修复沙箱边界。
events.importance_reason_en: Extends isolated workflows and provider capabilities while fixing sandbox boundaries.

events.title_zh: Kilo Desktop 支持原生 Windows on ARM 与本地模型工作流
events.title_en: Kilo Desktop supports native Windows on ARM and local-model workflows

events.summary_en: Kilo describes a native Windows on ARM build with Anaconda environment management and in-app local-model import and serving.
key_points_zh: 可从 environment.yml 重建 Python / conda 环境；已下载的模型可在本机运行。
本地模型服务器提供 OpenAI 兼容 API；原文性能与兼容性描述来自厂商。
key_points_en: Python and conda environments can be recreated from environment.yml; downloaded models run locally.
The local server exposes an OpenAI-compatible API; performance and compatibility descriptions are vendor claims.
events.importance_reason_zh: 新增平台兼容性和本地 AI 开发路径。
events.importance_reason_en: Adds platform compatibility and a local AI development path.

events.title_zh: Hermes 0.21.6：修复登录接管、Git filter 与邮件来源校验
events.title_en: Hermes 0.21.6 fixes login takeover, Git filters and email sender checks
events.summary_zh: 稳定版面向 Docker 与 Hermes Cloud 发布，汇集登录、仓库执行和邮件来源边界修复；桌面应用与 Termux 本轮不更新。
events.summary_en: The stable release ships for Docker and Hermes Cloud with authentication, repository-execution and email-sender boundary fixes; Desktop and Termux do not update in this release.
key_points_zh: 修复 X-Forwarded-For 绕过登录限流、无界审计日志及请求体、非本地重定向导致会话接管。
自动 Git 操作不再执行不受信任仓库配置的 clean / smudge / process filter；修复邮件 From 展示名绕过允许列表。
官方说明该窗口还包含流式转录、插件隔离、本地模型与新模型目录；完整整理说明将随 0.22.0 提供。
key_points_en: Fixes X-Forwarded-For login rate-limit bypass, unbounded audit logs and request bodies, and session takeover through non-loopback redirects.
Automatic Git operations no longer execute clean, smudge or process filters from untrusted repository configuration; fixes email From display names bypassing allowlists.
The release window also includes streaming transcription, plugin isolation, local models and catalog updates; curated notes are planned for 0.22.0.
events.importance_reason_zh: 包含认证与自动执行边界的关键修复，并明确发布渠道。
events.importance_reason_en: Includes critical authentication and automatic-execution fixes with explicit release-channel scope.

自适应思考默认启用并提供五档推理程度；此为平台公告描述。

key_points_en: Improves instruction-style Stop and SubagentStop hook evaluation to reduce premature stopping.

events.summary_en: Aligns the AI SDK on ai 7.0.120 and provider-utils 5.0.50, and stops sending disable-reasoning parameters to OpenAI and Claude models that cannot disable reasoning.
key_points_zh: 处理 stdio MCP 的 EPIPE，避免服务器提前退出导致宿主异常；移除 SAP AI Core 的进程级退出处理。
导出 parseMcpHeaders 并接入 Haiku 5.5。
key_points_en: Handles stdio MCP EPIPE to prevent host errors on early server exit; removes SAP AI Core’s process-wide exit handling.
Exports parseMcpHeaders and adds Haiku 5.5.
events.importance_reason_zh: 改善 SDK 的模型兼容性与进程稳定性。
events.importance_reason_en: Improves model compatibility and process stability in the SDK.

events.title_en: Tibo says an update has landed across all accounts and asks for feedback

events.title_en: DeepTutor 1.6.14 adds source visuals, recoverable indexing and reviewed plugins

events.summary_en: DeepTutor can retrieve original figures and PDF pages, preserve a queryable index when rebuilding fails, and move video learning into Reading.
key_points_zh: 新增论文证据工具和插件权限、回滚及撤销流程；本版官方插件目录为空。
原 Watching 会话重开时兼容迁移；旧知识库需重新解析索引以获得图像记录。
key_points_en: Adds paper evidence tools and plugin permission, rollback and revocation flows; the official plugin catalog is empty in this release.
Existing Watching sessions migrate when reopened; old knowledge bases require parsing and indexing again for figure records.
events.importance_reason_zh: 改变学习、检索与插件管理的主要工作流。
events.importance_reason_en: Changes core learning, retrieval and plugin-management workflows.

events.title_en: Gemini CLI October 8 nightly prevents endless auth and OAuth retries

key_points_zh: 遥测配置可设置自定义 OTLP headers。
key_points_en: Telemetry configuration supports custom OTLP headers.
events.importance_reason_zh: 预览避免认证卡死的关键修复。
events.importance_reason_en: Previews a critical fix preventing authentication stalls.

events.title_zh: Kilo JetBrains 7.1.9：MCP OAuth 登录与恢复
events.title_en: Kilo JetBrains 7.1.9 adds MCP OAuth sign-in and recovery
events.summary_zh: JetBrains 插件支持 MCP OAuth 登录及失效授权恢复，加入提示导航，并修复流式重试丢失推理上下文。
events.summary_en: The JetBrains plugin adds MCP OAuth sign-in and recovery, prompt navigation, and a fix for reasoning-context loss during streaming retries.

events.importance_reason_zh: 扩展认证能力并改善会话恢复。
events.importance_reason_en: Expands authentication support and improves session recovery.

events.title_zh: Anthropic 承诺三年投入 1.5 亿美元支持 Genesis Mission
events.title_en: Anthropic commits $150M over three years to the Genesis Mission
events.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布三年投入 1.5 亿美元，向 Genesis Mission 涉及的 15 个以上机构支持 Claude 使用。
events.summary_en: Anthropic announces a $150 million commitment over three years to support Claude access at more than 15 agencies participating in the Genesis Mission.
key_points_zh: 向数百个研究项目提供 Claude、Claude Code 和 API credits。
支持核聚变、量子计算等研究，并提供培训、接入与技术支持。
key_points_en: Provides Claude, Claude Code and API credits to several hundred research projects.
Supports research including fusion energy and quantum computing with training, onboarding and technical assistance.
events.importance_reason_zh: 扩大科研机构获得模型与编程工具的渠道。
events.importance_reason_en: Expands research access to models and coding tools.

events.title_zh: Anthropic 推出 Cyber Mission 与免费 OSS Scanner
events.title_en: Anthropic launches Cyber Mission and free OSS Scanner
events.summary_zh: Anthropic 推出关键基础设施防御计划 CIDP 与可自愿加入的开源项目周期安全扫描 OSS Scanner。
events.summary_en: Anthropic launches the Critical Infrastructure Defense Program and OSS Scanner, an opt-in service for periodic open-source security scans.
key_points_zh: CIDP 将前沿 Claude 模型、驻场工程师和威胁研究提供给关键基础设施防御服务商。
OSS Scanner 免费提供模型生成的漏洞报告、概念验证和可用时的修复建议，报告未经人工复核且可能有误。
不适合处理大量发现的项目仍可获得人工验证的协调披露；厂商预期真实阳性率超过 90%，不是本站测试结论。
key_points_en: CIDP provides frontier Claude models, on-site engineers and threat research to critical-infrastructure defense providers.
OSS Scanner supplies free model-generated findings, proofs of concept and suggested fixes when available; reports lack human review and may contain errors.
Projects unable to handle large volumes retain human-verified coordinated disclosures; the expected true-positive rate above 90% is a vendor projection, not our test result.
events.importance_reason_zh: 新增防御工具和前沿模型支持渠道，保留自动报告限制。
events.importance_reason_en: Adds defensive tools and frontier-model support with explicit limits of automated reports.

events.title_zh: Anthropic 预告 11 月 12 日生效的使用政策更新
events.title_en: Anthropic previews usage policy updates effective November 12
events.summary_zh: Anthropic 发布新版使用政策，计划 11 月 12 日生效，明确欺骗性活动、高风险用途和自主物理动作的要求。
events.summary_en: Anthropic publishes updated usage policies scheduled to take effect November 12, clarifying deceptive activity, high-risk uses and autonomous physical actions.
key_points_zh: 合并虚假账号和影响力行动限制；取消个性化投票及竞选定向的全面禁令，欺骗及隐私滥用仍受禁止。
连接可能致伤的硬件时，需由合格操作员观察和停止设备，且断开 Claude 后可保持安全状态。
新增极端、持续且无目的的虐待行为限制，官方说明不针对普通沮丧、质疑、创作或模型测试。
key_points_en: Consolidates fake-account and influence-operation restrictions; removes the blanket personalized-voting and campaign-targeting ban while retaining bans on deception and privacy abuse.
For hardware capable of injury, a qualified operator must observe and stop it, and equipment must maintain a safe state if Claude disconnects.
Adds restrictions on extreme sustained purposeless abuse; Anthropic says ordinary frustration, disagreement, creative work and model testing are excluded.
events.importance_reason_zh: 影响模型接入与 Agent 使用条件，尚未到生效日期。
events.importance_reason_en: Affects model access and agent usage conditions and is not yet effective.

events.title_zh: Google 开源 AQuA：从生产 Agent 轨迹诊断质量问题
events.title_en: Google shares AQuA for diagnosing quality failures in production agents
events.summary_zh: AQuA 在用户 Google Cloud 项目内读取生产轨迹，抽样、评估、聚类、核验和跟踪问题，可按需结合部署时源码快照诊断。
events.summary_en: AQuA reads production trajectories inside a user’s Google Cloud project to sample, review, cluster, verify and track issues, with on-demand diagnosis against deployed source snapshots.
key_points_zh: 每次最多随机抽取 1,000 个会话，最多核验 50 个问题簇，每簇检查最多 3 份完整记录。
处于请求链路之外，不自行改写 Agent 或提交 PR；提供可组合参考实现和本地演示。
轨迹、源码和 BigQuery 数据留在用户项目边界内；采样与模型判断仍可能遗漏或误判。
key_points_en: Randomly samples up to 1,000 sessions per run and verifies up to 50 clusters against up to 3 full transcripts each.
Runs outside the request path, does not edit the agent or open PRs itself, and offers composable reference components and a local demo.
Trajectories, source and BigQuery data remain in the user project; sampling and model judgments can still miss or misclassify problems.
events.importance_reason_zh: 提供生产 Agent 质量诊断工具及可用参考实现。
events.importance_reason_en: Provides production-agent quality diagnostics and a usable reference implementation.

events.title_zh: Google 开源 ML Drift：跨平台端侧 GPU 推理引擎
events.title_en: Google open-sources ML Drift for cross-platform on-device GPU inference
events.summary_zh: Google AI Edge 以 Apache 2.0 开源 ML Drift，既作为 LiteRT GPU 加速核心，也可作为独立库使用。
events.summary_en: Google AI Edge releases ML Drift under Apache 2.0 as both the LiteRT GPU acceleration core and a standalone library.
key_points_zh: 统一 OpenGL ES、OpenCL、Metal 和 WebGPU，增加 5D 张量及自定义算子接口。
传统 TFLite GPU delegate 不再接收新功能；官方建议迁移至兼容旧模型的 ML Drift 加速器。
移动与端侧为主要重点，Windows / Linux 桌面推理仍为预览；性能提升为官方测量结果。
key_points_en: Unifies OpenGL ES, OpenCL, Metal and WebGPU with 5D tensors and custom-operation APIs.
The legacy TFLite GPU delegate stops receiving new features; Google recommends migration to the backward-compatible ML Drift accelerator.
Mobile and edge are the main focus, while Windows and Linux desktop inference remains a preview; performance results are vendor measurements.
events.importance_reason_zh: 新增端侧推理基础设施并明确旧 GPU 后端迁移方向。
events.importance_reason_en: Adds on-device inference infrastructure and a migration path from the legacy GPU backend.

events.title_zh: TRAE 3.4.0：全局 Agent 窗口、远端目录与多仓库任务
events.title_en: TRAE 3.4.0 adds a global Agent workspace, remote directories and multi-repository tasks
events.summary_zh: TRAE 正式推出跨项目调度多个智能体的 Agent 窗口，支持云端与定时任务，并统一管理产物。
events.summary_en: TRAE releases an Agent workspace for coordinating multiple agents across projects, with cloud and scheduled tasks and unified artifact management.
key_points_zh: Agent 窗口与 IDE 可自由切换并同步数据；支持直接以远端开发机目录运行任务。
同一项目可挂载多个路径，文件树和全局搜索跨项目打通；新增桌面常驻对话悬浮球。
key_points_en: Agent and IDE windows can switch and synchronize data; tasks can run directly against remote development directories.
Projects can mount multiple paths with cross-project file trees and global search; adds a persistent desktop chat widget.
events.importance_reason_zh: 扩展跨项目、远端与后台 Agent 工作流。
events.importance_reason_en: Extends cross-project, remote and background agent workflows.

简介提及 spec-only 命令和 Hook 匹配改进，未提供完整操作细节。
key_points_en: Adds a feedback link for Workflows.
The excerpt mentions spec-only command and Hook matching improvements without full operational details.

events.title_zh: Pi 1.1.0：Haiku 5.5、图像分类与程序状态报告

events.summary_zh: Pi 接入 Claude Haiku 5.5，允许 GPT-6 Luna 经 Decisions API 进行图像分类，并向兼容终端报告运行状态。
events.summary_en: Pi adds Claude Haiku 5.5, enables GPT-6 Luna image classification through the Decisions API, and reports run status to compatible terminals.
key_points_zh: 原生支持 llama.cpp 0.6.0+ 的指定 decision models；这些模型只列为分类器。
修复 MCP OAuth 取消与超时、Bedrock 思考等级和长提示价格计量。
key_points_en: Adds native support for specified decision models on llama.cpp 0.6.0+; these models are listed only as classifiers.
Fixes MCP OAuth cancellation and timeouts, Bedrock reasoning levels and long-prompt cost accounting.

key_points_en: The bundled CLI updates from 7.8.1 to 7.8.8.

events.summary_en: GitHub announces general availability of Haiku 5.5 for Pro, Pro+, Max, Business and Enterprise, with a gradual rollout across clients.

events.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.293：Haiku 5.5 与后台唤醒变更

events.importance_reason_zh: 已核实负责人的 AI 一手表述，保留原帖的证据范围。
events.importance_reason_en: A first-party AI statement by a verified leader, preserving the post’s evidence scope.

events.title_zh: Copilot 本地沙箱正式可用，覆盖 CLI、桌面与 VS Code Agent Host
events.title_en: Copilot local sandboxing reaches general availability
events.summary_zh: Copilot 本地沙箱通过 MXC 将统一策略映射到 Windows、macOS 与 Linux 的系统控制，限制工具的文件、网络和凭据访问。
events.summary_en: Copilot local sandboxing uses MXC to map shared policies to Windows, macOS and Linux controls, restricting tool access to files, networks and credentials.
key_points_zh: 组织可强制执行开发者不能削弱的沙箱策略。
功能无额外费用；工具隔离独立于模型选择。
key_points_en: Organizations can enforce sandbox policies that developers cannot weaken.
The feature has no additional charge; tool isolation is independent of model selection.
events.importance_reason_zh: 为本地自主编码提供跨系统的执行边界。
events.importance_reason_en: Provides execution boundaries across operating systems for local agentic coding.

events.title_zh: Copilot CLI 可发现 Ollama 本地模型，无需重启会话
events.title_en: Copilot CLI discovers Ollama models without a session restart
events.summary_zh: 从 CLI 1.0.94-0 起，/model 可发现已运行 Ollama 的模型，用户确认提供商和端点后添加或切换。
events.summary_en: Starting in CLI 1.0.94-0, /model discovers models from running Ollama instances; users review the provider and endpoint before adding or switching.
key_points_zh: 模型需支持工具调用与流式响应；不会自动安装 Ollama 或下载模型。
本地模型选择不会自动启用离线模式；远程提供商仍可能接收代码和提示。
key_points_en: Models must support tool calling and streaming; the flow does not install Ollama or download models.
Selecting a local model does not enable offline mode automatically; remote providers may still receive code and prompts.
events.importance_reason_zh: 减少本地模型接入步骤并明确网络行为。
events.importance_reason_en: Reduces local-model setup steps and clarifies network behavior.

events.title_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.93：组织网络边界与长上下文配置
events.title_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.93 adds managed network boundaries and context fixes
events.summary_zh: Copilot CLI 加入企业 permissions.limitTo 网络域限制，支持回合间应用 MCP 配置，并正确读取启动时长上下文选项。
events.summary_en: Copilot CLI adds enterprise permissions.limitTo domain boundaries, applies MCP configuration between turns, and honors long-context options at startup.
key_points_zh: 用户设置仅从 ~/.copilot/settings.json 读取，config.json 的用户设置键将被忽略。
连接缺少 GitHub scope 时可就地更新授权；修复插件技能重载。
key_points_en: User settings are read only from ~/.copilot/settings.json; user-setting keys in config.json are ignored.
Connections missing GitHub scopes can update authorization in place; fixes plugin-skill reloads.
events.importance_reason_zh: 涉及组织策略及现有用户配置迁移。
events.importance_reason_en: Affects organizational policy and migration of existing user settings.

events.title_zh: OpenAI 预告 College Planner 与青少年学习工具
events.title_en: OpenAI previews College Planner and teen learning tools
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 预告面向美国四年制大学申请的 College Planner，整合申请要求、截止日期、任务与助学金步骤。
events.summary_en: OpenAI previews College Planner for U.S. four-year college applications, combining requirements, deadlines, tasks and financial-aid steps.
key_points_zh: 青少年体验自动应用于被识别为未满 18 岁的账号，默认开启保护。
公告同时提及闪卡、测验和青少年 AI 理事会；College Planner 尚待推出。
key_points_en: The teen experience applies automatically to accounts identified as under 18, with protections enabled by default.
The announcement also mentions flashcards, quizzes and a teen AI council; College Planner is still upcoming.
events.importance_reason_zh: 预告申请规划与学习功能，并明确适用人群。
events.importance_reason_en: Previews application-planning and study features with explicit target users.

events.title_zh: Kilo 7.8.8：隔离 MCP OAuth 凭据并支持置顶工作树
events.title_en: Kilo 7.8.8 isolates MCP OAuth credentials and pins worktrees
events.summary_zh: Kilo 将 OAuth 凭据绑定到签发的授权服务器，避免 MCP 服务更换服务器后获得旧凭据；VS Code Agent Manager 可置顶工作树。
events.summary_en: Kilo binds OAuth credentials to the issuing authorization server to prevent reuse after an MCP server changes issuers; VS Code Agent Manager can pin worktrees.
key_points_zh: 实验性 Integrated Browser 开启时聊天链接默认在应用内打开，可改回系统浏览器。
key_points_en: With experimental Integrated Browser enabled, chat links open in-app by default; users can select the system browser instead.
events.importance_reason_zh: 关键认证修复及多会话管理改进。
events.importance_reason_en: Includes a critical authentication fix and multi-session management improvements.

events.title_zh: Cline 4.1.23：修复自定义 Claude 端点并保留截断 MCP 输出
events.title_en: Cline 4.1.23 fixes custom Claude endpoints and preserves truncated MCP output
events.summary_zh: Cline 修复自定义 Anthropic 端点 400 错误、Kimi K3 不支持的思考等级和截断 MCP 输出不可继续读取的问题。
events.summary_en: Cline fixes HTTP 400 errors on custom Anthropic endpoints, unsupported reasoning levels for Kimi K3 and inaccessible truncated MCP output.
key_points_zh: 无法识别响应完成原因时继续一次，而非直接视为完成。
免费模型列表加入 Solar Mini 4，移除 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 与 space-bunny-alpha。
key_points_en: When a response has no recognized finish reason, Cline continues once instead of treating it as complete.
The free-model list adds Solar Mini 4 and removes DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and space-bunny-alpha.
events.importance_reason_zh: 修复模型接入与结果完整性问题。
events.importance_reason_en: Fixes model connectivity and result-completeness issues.

events.title_zh: Cline Desktop 0.0.44：恢复无 Key 本地模型与断线会话
events.title_en: Cline Desktop 0.0.44 restores keyless local models and reconnects sessions
events.summary_zh: 桌面版修复 LM Studio、Ollama、vLLM 等无需 API Key 的提供商每回合失败，并在 Hub 断线后自动重连最多一分钟。
events.summary_en: The desktop release fixes per-turn failures for providers such as LM Studio, Ollama and vLLM that need no API key, and reconnects Hub sessions for up to a minute.
key_points_zh: 聊天可交互显示 Mermaid；修复 Windows npx/uvx MCP 启动超时及自定义 Claude 端点。
key_points_en: Chat renders interactive Mermaid diagrams; fixes Windows npx/uvx MCP startup timeouts and custom Claude endpoints.
events.importance_reason_zh: 恢复本地推理能力并提高会话连续性。
events.importance_reason_en: Restores local inference and improves session continuity.

events.title_zh: 马斯克：Grok Bot 将按任务选用其他厂商模型
events.title_en: Musk says Grok Bot will choose other providers’ models by task

events.summary_en: Musk says SpaceX will choose backends for Grok Bot by task, including Claude Opus 5.5, MidJourney, Suno and other APIs; no rollout date or billing terms are given.
key_points_zh: 马斯克表示 SpaceX 将为 Grok Bot 按任务选择后端，包括 Claude Opus 5.5、MidJourney、Suno 等 API；未交代推出时间和计费条件。
key_points_en: Musk says SpaceX will choose backends for Grok Bot by task, including Claude Opus 5.5, MidJourney, Suno and other APIs; no rollout date or billing terms are given.

events.title_zh: Cline CLI 3.0.69：修复 Windows MCP 和自定义模型连接
events.title_en: Cline CLI 3.0.69 fixes Windows MCP and custom-model connections
events.summary_zh: CLI 将 stdio MCP 默认启动预算从 3 秒增至 10 秒，并修复自定义 Anthropic 端点与 Kimi K3 思考等级错误。
events.summary_en: The CLI raises the default stdio MCP startup budget from 3 to 10 seconds and fixes custom Anthropic endpoints and Kimi K3 reasoning-level errors.
key_points_zh: cline config --json 恢复输出 JSON；不明完成原因的响应继续一次。
key_points_en: cline config --json outputs JSON again; responses with unknown finish reasons continue once.
events.importance_reason_zh: 恢复受影响的 Windows 工具和模型集成。
events.importance_reason_en: Restores affected Windows tools and model integrations.

events.title_zh: Cline SDK 0.0.91：明确未完成响应，扩展可选 Key 提供商
events.title_en: Cline SDK 0.0.91 handles incomplete responses and optional API keys
events.summary_zh: SDK 将未知完成原因设为 unknown，保留部分响应后继续一次，再失败则结束；新增 apiKeyOptional 提供商标识。
events.summary_en: The SDK classifies unknown finish reasons as unknown, preserves partial responses and continues once before failing; it adds an apiKeyOptional provider flag.
key_points_zh: 修复 Windows MCP 初始化、非官方 Anthropic 端点参数及模型思考等级适配。
key_points_en: Fixes Windows MCP initialization, parameters for unofficial Anthropic endpoints and model reasoning-level adaptation.
events.importance_reason_zh: 影响基于 SDK 的应用响应可靠性与认证接入。
events.importance_reason_en: Affects response reliability and authentication for SDK-based applications.

events.title_zh: Tibo：社区投票后已完成用量重置

events.title_zh: Gemini CLI 10 月 7 日夜间版：保留恢复记录并校验 OAuth
events.title_en: Gemini CLI October 7 nightly preserves resumed history and validates OAuth
events.summary_zh: 夜间版修复恢复后迅速退出时删除会话记录、重复工具响应回合，并按 RFC 9207 元数据校验 OAuth 回调。
events.summary_en: The nightly fixes deletion of resumed history on quick exit and duplicate tool-response turns, and validates OAuth callbacks against RFC 9207 metadata.
key_points_zh: 不可信目录强制只读 workspace 设置。
key_points_en: Untrusted folders enforce read-only workspace settings.
events.importance_reason_zh: 预览会话保留与认证边界修复。
events.importance_reason_en: Previews fixes to session preservation and authentication boundaries.

events.title_zh: Kilo 7.8.7 预览：默认多项目管理与 MCP OAuth
events.title_en: Kilo 7.8.7 previews default multi-project management and MCP OAuth
events.summary_zh: 预览版默认启用多项目 Agent Manager，加入 MCP OAuth 和可选独立 memory_model，修复 Git 与 Markdown 相关安全问题。
events.summary_en: This preview enables multi-project Agent Manager by default, adds MCP OAuth and an optional separate memory_model, and fixes Git and Markdown security issues.
key_points_zh: CLI 可直接引导运行中的子 Agent，也可停止子 Agent 而保留父会话。
key_points_en: The CLI can steer a running subagent or stop it while keeping the parent session active.
events.importance_reason_zh: 预览跨项目和子 Agent 的主要工作流变化。
events.importance_reason_en: Previews major cross-project and subagent workflow changes.

events.title_zh: GPT-6 与 Intelligent UI 向所有 ChatGPT 用户逐步开放
events.title_en: GPT-6 and Intelligent UI roll out to all ChatGPT users
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布在全球 ChatGPT 逐步开放 GPT-6 和 Intelligent UI，以视觉内容和可交互工具呈现回答。
events.summary_en: OpenAI announces a global ChatGPT rollout of GPT-6 and Intelligent UI, presenting answers with visuals and interactive tools.
key_points_zh: 公告描述更快响应与现场可用的交互体验，未在 RSS 提供具体套餐额度或完整模型规格。
key_points_en: The announcement describes faster responses and interactive experiences, but the RSS provides no specific plan quotas or complete model specifications.
events.importance_reason_zh: 影响 ChatGPT 用户的模型和回答交互方式。
events.importance_reason_en: Changes model access and answer interaction for ChatGPT users.

events.title_zh: OpenRouter 接入 ElevenLabs：9 个 TTS 与 2 个 STT 模型
events.title_en: OpenRouter adds ElevenLabs with nine TTS and two STT models
events.summary_zh: 官方博客订阅宣布 ElevenLabs 上线 OpenRouter，涵盖文本转语音与语音转文本。
events.summary_en: The official blog feed announces ElevenLabs on OpenRouter, covering text-to-speech and speech-to-text.
key_points_zh: 列举 Eleven v4、v4 Turbo 和 Scribe v2；订阅未提供完整价格表。
key_points_en: Names Eleven v4, v4 Turbo and Scribe v2; the feed does not provide a complete pricing table.
events.importance_reason_zh: 扩展平台的语音模型与 API 选择。
events.importance_reason_en: Expands the platform’s speech-model and API options.

events.title_zh: Google Developer Knowledge 扩展 CLI、Agent skill 与客户端库
events.title_en: Google Developer Knowledge expands CLI, agent skill and client libraries
events.summary_zh: Google 公布 Developer Knowledge API 的 gcloud、Agent skill、API Explorer 与多语言客户端入口，为工具提供官方文档搜索、检索和有依据的问答。
events.summary_en: Google presents gcloud, agent skill, API Explorer and multi-language clients for the Developer Knowledge API, providing official-document search, retrieval and grounded answers.
key_points_zh: BatchGetDocuments 可一次取最多 20 篇文档；MCP 或 REST 接入仍需相应认证。
key_points_en: BatchGetDocuments retrieves up to 20 documents per call; MCP or REST access still requires the applicable authentication.
events.importance_reason_zh: 扩展编码 Agent 获取最新官方文档的工具链。
events.importance_reason_en: Expands tooling for coding agents to access current official documentation.

events.title_zh: Devin 新增通知收件箱，强化私钥脱敏与 Review 权限
events.title_en: Devin adds a notification inbox and strengthens key redaction and Review permissions
events.summary_zh: Devin 新增可配置通知收件箱；命令输出逐行脱敏已保存的私钥，并扩展企业 Review 权限与 Teams 群聊安全策略。
events.summary_en: Devin adds a configurable notification inbox, redacts saved private keys line by line in command output, and extends enterprise Review permissions and Teams group-chat policies.
key_points_zh: 组织 Review 规则编辑需 Manage review rules 权限；应用建议编辑或修改自动审查需 Review 权限。
key_points_en: Editing organization Review rules requires Manage review rules; applying suggested edits or changing automatic review requires Review permission.
events.importance_reason_zh: 新增任务通知入口，并加强凭据与组织控制。
events.importance_reason_en: Adds task notifications and strengthens credential and organizational controls.

events.title_zh: Copilot 修复 Agent 用量归因；缺失历史无法回补
events.title_en: Copilot fixes agent-usage attribution; missing history cannot be backfilled
events.summary_zh: GitHub 确认部分采用 Copilot SDK 的 IDE 未正确报告 Agent 活动，造成漏计或误计入 CLI；VS Code 1.139.0+ 已修复，其他 IDE 仍待发布。
events.summary_en: GitHub confirms that some IDEs using the Copilot SDK reported agent activity incorrectly, causing undercounts or misattribution to CLI; VS Code 1.139.0+ is fixed, while other IDE releases are pending.
key_points_zh: 问题不影响计费；受影响历史无法回补，需升级后恢复正确统计。
其他 IDE 修复预计在 2026 年 11 月前完成；CLI 用户不需为此升级。
key_points_en: Billing is unaffected; missing history cannot be backfilled, and accurate metrics resume after updating.
Other IDE fixes are expected to finish rolling out by November 2026; CLI users need no update for this issue.
events.importance_reason_zh: 不可回补的统计缺口影响组织对 Agent 使用情况的判断。
events.importance_reason_en: Irrecoverable metric gaps affect organizations’ assessment of agent usage.

events.title_zh: Tibo 征集第二天反馈：四项更新、重置或两者兼有
