events.title_zh: Gemini CLI 0.63.0：修复认证循环，支持非交互自主计划
events.title_en: Gemini CLI 0.63.0 fixes auth loops and supports autonomous headless plans
events.summary_zh: Gemini CLI 修复文件竞争、无界面 keyring 和 supervisor 状态造成的认证循环，并启用非交互模式的自主计划执行。
events.summary_en: Gemini CLI fixes authentication loops involving file contention, headless keyrings and supervisor state, and enables autonomous plan execution in non-interactive mode.
key_points_zh: 限制工具输出并优化长 Agent 循环的内存生命周期。
key_points_en: Bounds tool output and improves memory lifecycle in long agent loops.
events.importance_reason_zh: 改善无界面自动化和长任务可靠性。
events.importance_reason_en: Improves headless automation and long-task reliability.

events.title_zh: Gemini CLI 0.64.0 预览：原子文件操作与状态损坏恢复
events.title_en: Gemini CLI 0.64.0 previews atomic file operations and state recovery
events.summary_zh: 预览版序列化文件操作并原子写入，原子保存状态并在损坏时从备份恢复，同时修复代码中 @ 导致的 CPU 卡顿。
events.summary_en: This preview serializes file operations and writes atomically, persists state atomically with recovery from backup, and fixes CPU hangs triggered by @ in code.
key_points_zh: 修复非交互目录信任传递、Ctrl+C 紧急取消与 Windows 输入兼容性。
key_points_en: Fixes headless folder-trust propagation, emergency Ctrl+C cancellation and Windows input compatibility.
events.importance_reason_zh: 预览防止工作状态损坏的关键改进。
events.importance_reason_en: Previews critical improvements that prevent work-state corruption.

events.title_zh: OpenCode 1.18.35：xAI 工具结果可携带图像
events.title_en: OpenCode 1.18.35 passes images in xAI tool results
events.summary_zh: OpenCode 的 xAI 工具结果现在传递受支持的图像，跳过不支持的图像格式。
events.summary_en: OpenCode now passes supported images in xAI tool results and skips unsupported formats.
key_points_zh: 统计页面新增规范重定向及 Agent 可读 JSON、Markdown 格式。
key_points_en: Stats pages add canonical redirects and agent-readable JSON and Markdown formats.
events.importance_reason_zh: 修复多模态工具输出兼容性。
events.importance_reason_en: Fixes compatibility of multimodal tool output.

events.title_zh: Google 发布 EmbeddingGemma 2：740M 参数的端侧多模态嵌入模型
events.title_en: Google releases EmbeddingGemma 2, a 740M on-device multimodal embedder
events.summary_zh: EmbeddingGemma 2 基于 Gemma 4，采用 Apache 2.0 许可，将文本、代码、图像、视频和音频映射到同一向量空间。
events.summary_en: EmbeddingGemma 2 is based on Gemma 4 and released under Apache 2.0, mapping text, code, images, video and audio into one vector space.
key_points_zh: 文本模块 270M 参数，完整模型 740M；上下文为 8K tokens。
输出 768 维，可截断至 512、256 或 128 维；Google 宣称可降低端侧检索存储成本。
key_points_en: The text module has 270M parameters and the complete model 740M; context is 8K tokens.
Outputs 768 dimensions with truncation to 512, 256 or 128; Google says this lowers storage costs for on-device retrieval.
events.importance_reason_zh: 新增开放的端侧跨模态检索基础模型。
events.importance_reason_en: Adds an open foundation model for on-device cross-modal retrieval.

events.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.292：MCP 协议与插件执行接口更新
events.title_en: Claude Code 2.1.292 updates MCP negotiation and plugin interfaces
events.summary_zh: 当前官方订阅列出子 Agent effort 参数、Mods prompt caching 和本地 MCP 默认协议更新。
events.summary_en: Current official feed notes list subagent effort settings, Mods prompt caching and default local MCP protocol updates.
key_points_zh: Agent 工具可指定 effort，$.model.complete 支持分块 prompt caching。
本地 stdio MCP 默认协商 2026-07-28，包含 Bedrock、Vertex 与 Foundry；MCP_PROTOCOL_NEGOTIATION=legacy 可退出。
claude plugin test 的 hook expect 或被引擎拒绝的 stub 现在会使测试失败。
key_points_en: The Agent tool accepts effort and $.model.complete supports block-based prompt caching.
Local stdio MCP defaults to 2026-07-28, including Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry; MCP_PROTOCOL_NEGOTIATION=legacy opts out.
Hook expect failures or engine-rejected stubs now fail claude plugin test.
events.importance_reason_zh: 按当前官方订阅说明更新兼容性和后台执行行为。
events.importance_reason_en: Updates compatibility and background execution behavior from current official feed notes.

corrections.reason_zh: 官方 RSS 同一版本原文已变化，当前说明不再包含此前引用的修复条目；按现有证据调整，保留版本 ID 与首次发布日期。
corrections.reason_en: The official RSS text for this version changed and no longer includes the previously cited fixes; revised to current evidence while preserving the version ID and first publication date.

events.title_zh: Kilo 推出 Desktop：整合多模型、Notebook 和本地模型工作流
events.title_en: Kilo launches Desktop with multiple models, notebooks, and local-model workflows
events.summary_zh: Kilo 宣布 Desktop 已可下载，将代码开发和数据分析放进同一应用。官方称支持超过 500 个模型，并提供跨文件夹工作区、直接编辑 Notebook、Conda 环境管理及本地模型服务；用户也可接入自己的提供商和 API Key。
events.summary_en: Kilo announced that Desktop is available to download, bringing coding and data analysis into one app. The company says it supports more than 500 models, with multi-folder workspaces, direct notebook editing, conda environment management, and a local model server. Users can also connect their own providers and API keys.
key_points_zh: 工作区可组合多个本地文件夹，让 Agent 跨项目读取上下文。
提供 Code、Plan、Ask、Debug 四种 Agent；批准计划后，Code 可通过子 Agent 并行执行子任务。
支持直接编辑 Notebook、管理 Conda 环境以及连接本地或自备 API Key 的模型。
团队管理员可限制模型、提供商、地域、Agent 权限和可安装的技能。
key_points_en: Workspaces group multiple local folders so agents can read context across projects.
Four agents are included: Code, Plan, Ask, and Debug. After a plan is approved, Code can run subtasks in parallel through subagents.
Supports direct notebook editing, conda environment management, and local or bring-your-own-key models.
Team administrators can restrict models, providers, geographies, agent permissions, and installable skills.
events.importance_reason_zh: 扩展 Kilo 的桌面开发和数据分析入口，并提供多模型及本地推理的统一工作流。
events.importance_reason_en: Adds a desktop entry point for Kilo coding and data analysis with unified workflows for multiple models and local inference.

events.title_zh: OpenAI 公布内部前沿模型的数学研究结果
events.title_en: OpenAI publishes mathematical results from an internal frontier model
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 表示发布内部前沿模型对开放数学问题的新结果，并在 GitHub 分享 Lean 形式化证明与研究细节。
events.summary_en: OpenAI says it is releasing new results on open mathematical problems from an internal frontier model, with Lean formalizations and research details on GitHub.
key_points_zh: 官方称发布方式参考 IAS 数学与 AI 独立顾问组的建议；当前 RSS 未给出可独立评估的完整证明。
key_points_en: OpenAI says its release approach draws on advice from the IAS independent advisory group on mathematics and AI; the RSS does not provide complete proofs for independent assessment.
events.importance_reason_zh: 提供模型用于科学研究的新一手进展。
events.importance_reason_en: Provides first-party progress on using models for scientific research.

events.title_zh: Tibo：使用 ChatGPT 账号登录的用户可免费使用 Auto-review
events.title_en: Tibo says Auto-review is free for users signed in with ChatGPT
events.summary_zh: Tibo 表示，Auto-review 已向所有通过 ChatGPT 账号登录的用户免费开放，且不消耗套餐用量。该功能可在设置的权限选项中开启，由第二个 agent 审查主 agent 的操作，以拦截高风险或偏离用户意图的行为。
events.summary_en: Tibo says Auto-review is now free for all users signed in through a ChatGPT account and does not consume plan usage. It can be enabled in permission settings; a second agent reviews the primary agent’s actions to prevent high-risk actions or actions that diverge from user intent.
key_points_zh: 设置入口为 settings > permissions > auto-review。
据 Tibo 说明，审查功能免费且不占用套餐额度；这不意味着主任务的模型用量免费。
key_points_en: Enable it under settings > permissions > auto-review.
According to Tibo, the review feature is free and does not draw from plan usage; this does not make the primary task’s model usage free.
events.importance_reason_zh: 影响长任务的权限审查方式及审查功能的用量成本。
events.importance_reason_en: Changes permission review for long tasks and the usage cost of the review feature.

events.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.291：修复云会话权限答复丢失与退出时消息丢失
events.title_en: Claude Code 2.1.291 fixes lost permission answers and session messages
events.summary_zh: Claude Code 2.1.291 修复两项回归：2.1.290 的云会话可能丢弃权限提示答复，以及 2.1.288 中退出时会话最后的消息可能丢失。
events.summary_en: Claude Code 2.1.291 fixes two regressions: cloud sessions could drop permission-prompt answers in 2.1.290, and the last session messages could be lost on quitting in 2.1.288.
key_points_zh: 恢复云会话中权限提示答复的可靠传递。
修复退出时最后消息的保存问题。
key_points_en: Restores reliable delivery of permission-prompt answers in cloud sessions.
Fixes preservation of the final messages when quitting.
events.importance_reason_zh: 两项回归会影响授权流程和会话内容保存。
events.importance_reason_en: Both regressions affect authorization and preservation of session content.

events.title_zh: Cursor iOS 可远程查看和回复电脑上的本地 Agent
events.title_en: Cursor iOS remotely views and replies to local agents
events.summary_zh: 用户在桌面批准配对后，可从 iOS 查看并回复本地 Agent；任务继续在电脑上运行，电脑须保持开机联网。
events.summary_en: After desktop pairing approval, users can view and reply to local agents from iOS; tasks remain on the computer, which must stay powered and online.
key_points_zh: 除 Enterprise 组织外默认开启；企业管理员可在安全设置中启用。
不要求使用 Cloud Agents。
key_points_en: Enabled by default except for Enterprise organizations; enterprise administrators can enable it in security settings.
Does not require Cloud Agents.
events.importance_reason_zh: 扩展本地任务的移动端交互入口。
events.importance_reason_en: Adds mobile interaction with local tasks.

events.title_zh: Anthropic 扩展 Cyber Verification Program，分三级开放能力
events.title_en: Anthropic expands the Cyber Verification Program into three access tiers
events.summary_zh: Anthropic 将 CVP 与 Project Glasswing 整合为分级验证计划，为符合资格的安全人员开放更强网络安全能力与较少拦截。
events.summary_en: Anthropic combines CVP and Project Glasswing into a tiered verification program offering qualifying security professionals stronger cyber capabilities and reduced blocking.
key_points_zh: Defense Access 面向防御任务；Red Team Access 增加获授权的渗透测试，当前仅限组织。
Specialized Access 限少量深度核验组织；支持 Opus 5.5、Sonnet 5.5 与 Mythos 5.1 等模型。
key_points_en: Defense Access covers defensive tasks; Red Team Access adds authorized penetration testing and currently accepts organizations only.
Specialized Access is limited to a small set of deeply verified organizations; supported models include Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Mythos 5.1.
events.importance_reason_zh: 改变安全专业用户获取模型能力的资格与范围。
events.importance_reason_en: Changes eligibility and scope for professional access to cyber model capabilities.

events.title_zh: Google AI Edge 推出端侧媒体搜索与 Foresight Mac 实验应用
events.title_en: Google AI Edge introduces local media search and the Foresight Mac experiment
events.summary_zh: Google AI Edge Gallery 新增媒体语义搜索与视频时刻定位；Foresight Mac 使用本地模型协助会议记录及私有文件检索。
events.summary_en: Google AI Edge Gallery adds semantic media search and video-moment retrieval; Foresight for Mac uses local models to assist with meeting notes and private-file retrieval.
key_points_zh: 基于 EmbeddingGemma 2；MediaPipe Tasks 提供多模态嵌入、检索和决策接口。
Android ML Kit 服务与 NPU 加速将在未来数周提供，尚未作为当前发布能力。
key_points_en: Powered by EmbeddingGemma 2; MediaPipe Tasks provides multimodal embedding, retrieval and decision interfaces.
Android ML Kit service and NPU acceleration are planned for the coming weeks and are not presented as available now.
events.importance_reason_zh: 提供可体验的端侧多模态检索与会议工作流。
events.importance_reason_en: Provides usable on-device multimodal retrieval and meeting workflows.

events.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.290：强化权限检查，修复后台任务与长会话恢复
events.title_en: Claude Code 2.1.290 strengthens permission checks and background-task recovery
events.summary_zh: Claude Code 2.1.290 扩展 Mods 与插件 hook 信息，并修复多项权限规则、读取边界和组织插件检查问题。后台定时任务、长会话及代理网关兼容性也有修复；WebFetch 对超过 100,000 字符的正文会提示未读取部分并支持 offset 续读。
events.summary_en: Claude Code 2.1.290 expands information available to Mods and plugin hooks and fixes multiple permission-rule, read-boundary and organization-plugin checks. It also repairs background scheduling, long-session recovery and proxy/gateway compatibility; WebFetch reports unread text beyond 100,000 characters and supports continuing with an offset.
key_points_zh: 修复符号链接、图片读取和 PreToolUse 改写输入后部分权限检查未生效的问题。
修复定时任务在压缩或后台切换后未恢复，以及恢复、重启或 fork 时额外执行的问题；压缩恢复修复适用于本版起创建的压缩。
tool.check 增加 agentId，Mods hook 可读取组织要求的审批 ceiling；turn.step 提供 serverToolUses。
key_points_en: Fixes missed permission checks involving symlinks, image reads and inputs rewritten by PreToolUse.

Fixes scheduled tasks failing to recover after compaction or background handoff and extra runs on resume, respawn or fork; the compaction recovery fix covers compactions made from this version onward.
tool.check adds agentId, Mods hooks expose the organization’s approval ceiling, and turn.step exposes serverToolUses.
events.importance_reason_zh: 涉及权限边界、后台任务可靠性和插件兼容性的重要更新。
events.importance_reason_en: Affects permission boundaries, background-task reliability and plugin compatibility.

events.title_zh: Pi 1.0.4：工具通配符与单次禁用 MCP，修复图像与 OAuth 支持
events.title_en: Pi 1.0.4 adds tool patterns and per-run MCP disabling, fixes images and OAuth
events.summary_zh: Pi 1.0.4 让 --tools 与 --exclude-tools 支持 * 通配符，新增 --no-mcp 单次关闭 MCP，并修复 --tools 意外移除 MCP 工具的问题。Codemode 可通过 tools.read() 获取图像块；采用 OpenID Connect 客户端注册的 MCP 服务也有 OAuth 兼容修复。
events.summary_en: Pi 1.0.4 adds * patterns to --tools and --exclude-tools and --no-mcp to disable MCP for one run, while fixing --tools unexpectedly removing MCP tools. Codemode can obtain image blocks with tools.read(), and MCP OAuth compatibility is fixed for servers using OpenID Connect client registration.
key_points_zh: --tools 默认保留 MCP 工具，除非某个筛选项以 mcp__ 开头。
读取图片会返回可由 image() 展示的图像块。
MCP OAuth 注册改为原生客户端；修复连接尚未完成时退出导致 transport 残留的问题。
key_points_en: --tools retains MCP tools unless an entry starts with mcp__.
Reading an image returns an image block that image() can display.
MCP OAuth registers as a native client; shutdown fixes prevent transports remaining open while connection is still pending.
events.importance_reason_zh: 改善工具权限选择、图像处理和 MCP 身份认证兼容性。
events.importance_reason_en: Improves tool selection, image handling and MCP authentication compatibility.

events.title_zh: Tibo 谈 ChatGPT 协作 Space：正在每天快速改进
events.title_en: Tibo says collaborative Space in ChatGPT is improving rapidly each day
events.summary_zh: Tibo 表示 Sergio 正在改进 ChatGPT 中的协作 Space，并称其每天都在大幅进步。原帖没有列出具体功能、上线时间或套餐范围。
events.summary_en: Tibo says Sergio is improving collaborative Space inside ChatGPT and describes rapid progress each day. The post does not identify specific features, release timing or plan availability.
key_points_zh: 这是负责人对产品进展的直接表述。
原帖未提供可单独确认的新功能清单。
key_points_en: This is a product lead’s direct statement about product progress.
The post does not provide a list of independently confirmable new features.
events.importance_reason_zh: 保留已核实负责人对关注产品的一手进展说明。
events.importance_reason_en: Preserves first-hand product-progress commentary from a verified lead.

events.title_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.92：整合配置与环境选择，改善沙箱及长会话
events.title_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.92 brings configuration and environment selection, improves sandboxing
events.summary_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.92 的稳定版说明整合配置子命令、对话前本地／云环境选择及一系列沙箱、MCP 和长会话修复。后台 agent 可在运行中接收消息调整当前任务，Canvas action 也可向模型返回图像。
events.summary_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.92’s stable release notes combine configuration subcommands, local/cloud environment selection before a conversation, and sandbox, MCP and long-session fixes. Messages can steer a running background agent’s active turn, and Canvas actions can return images to the model.
key_points_zh: 新增 copilot config 的列出、读取、设置与删除操作，以及对话前 Ctrl+E 环境选择器。
沙箱 shell 默认不传递环境中的 GITHUB_TOKEN，除非显式配置；长上下文恢复保留最新请求。
修复 Entra MCP 静默续期、OAuth 重新认证后工具继续使用和远程会话恢复认证。
key_points_en: Adds copilot config operations to list, read, set and remove settings, plus a pre-conversation Ctrl+E environment picker.
Sandboxed shells withhold ambient GITHUB_TOKEN unless explicitly configured; context recovery retains the latest requests.
Fixes silent renewal for Entra MCP, continued tool use after OAuth reauthentication and authentication on remote-session resume.
events.importance_reason_zh: 稳定版确认重要权限、工作流与会话可靠性变化。
events.importance_reason_en: The stable release confirms significant permission, workflow and session-reliability changes.

events.title_zh: Codex 0.160.1：保留远程 Windows MCP 执行环境变量
events.title_en: Codex 0.160.1 preserves remote Windows MCP environment variables
events.summary_zh: Codex 0.160.1 修复 Unix 主机启动远程 stdio MCP 服务时的环境变量传递：即使显式配置远程环境变量，也会保留 Windows 执行器需要的 SYSTEMROOT、TEMP 和 TMP。
events.summary_en: Codex 0.160.1 fixes environment forwarding when Unix hosts launch remote stdio MCP servers: SYSTEMROOT, TEMP and TMP needed by the Windows executor are preserved even when remote environment variables are explicitly configured.
key_points_zh: 修复针对 Unix 主机与 Windows 远程执行器组合。
该变更回移植到 0.160 系列。
key_points_en: The fix targets Unix hosts paired with Windows remote executors.
The change is backported to the 0.160 series.
events.importance_reason_zh: 修复跨系统远程 MCP 启动所需的环境兼容性。
events.importance_reason_en: Fixes environment compatibility required for cross-platform remote MCP startup.

events.title_zh: Tibo：ChatGPT 订阅中的 Astra 与 GPT-6.1 Sol 默认速度提高约 50%
events.title_en: Tibo says Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol default speed increased about 50% on subscriptions
events.summary_zh: Tibo 表示，GPT-6 Astra 与 GPT-6.1 Sol 通过订阅使用时的默认速度已优化约 50%，覆盖 OpenAI 产品及使用 Sign in with ChatGPT 的合作产品，如 OpenCode、Pi、Amp 和 Devin。用户无需更改设置；他在原帖中预计两小时内可感受到变化。
events.summary_en: Tibo says default speed for GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol on subscriptions has been optimized by about 50%, across OpenAI products and partners using Sign in with ChatGPT, including OpenCode, Pi, Amp and Devin. Users need no setting changes; he expected the improvement to be felt within two hours of the post.
key_points_zh: 该表述针对订阅及 Sign in with ChatGPT 接入，没有说明 API Key 调用也获得相同提速。
约 50% 是 Tibo 的表述，原帖没有提供基准测试方法。
key_points_en: The statement covers subscription and Sign in with ChatGPT access, without confirming the same speedup for API-key calls.
About 50% is Tibo’s claim; the post provides no benchmark methodology.
events.importance_reason_zh: 负责人对实际模型服务速度和合作产品范围的一手说明。
events.importance_reason_en: First-hand information from a product lead about serving speed and partner coverage.

events.title_zh: OpenAI 扩展文本水印：API 可选开启，欧盟 ChatGPT 与 Codex 将逐步应用
events.title_en: OpenAI expands text watermarking: API opt-in now, EU ChatGPT and Codex to follow
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 表示将内容溯源扩展到文本。全球 API 客户可为部分模型开启文本水印；欧盟 ChatGPT 与 Codex 的适用文本将在未来几周逐步应用水印，以响应欧盟监管要求。官方同时强调当前文本水印技术存在明显局限。
events.summary_en: OpenAI says it is expanding content provenance to text. API customers worldwide can opt into text watermarking for select models today; eligible text in ChatGPT and Codex in the EU will start receiving watermarks over the coming weeks in response to EU regulatory requirements. OpenAI also acknowledges significant limitations of current text-watermarking technology.
key_points_zh: API 为部分模型提供可选水印；不表示所有模型或所有文本均支持。
欧盟 ChatGPT 与 Codex 的应用仍是未来几周的计划，不能视为已全部上线。
依据为官方 RSS 摘要与 X 公告，没有把水印描述为可靠识别所有 AI 文本的方法。
key_points_en: API watermarking is opt-in for select models, rather than covering every model or text.
EU ChatGPT and Codex deployment is planned for the coming weeks and is not described as fully live.
Evidence consists of the official RSS summary and X announcement; watermarking is not presented as reliable detection of all AI text.
events.importance_reason_zh: 涉及 API 选项及 ChatGPT、Codex 输出溯源的重要可用性变化。
events.importance_reason_en: A significant availability change for API options and output provenance in ChatGPT and Codex.

events.title_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.92-5：完善 Entra 账号选择、退出与 MCP 续期
events.title_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.92-5 improves Entra account selection, sign-out and MCP renewal
events.summary_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.92-5 改进 Microsoft Entra 登录后的账号选择，使 /logout 能退出相应 OAuth 会话，并修复仅持有 access token 的 Entra MCP 凭据静默续期。
events.summary_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.92-5 improves account selection after Microsoft Entra sign-in, lets /logout sign out those OAuth sessions, and fixes silent renewal of access-token-only credentials for Entra-protected MCP servers.
key_points_zh: 登录后可选择使用的 Microsoft Entra 账号。
/logout 覆盖对应 OAuth 会话；access-token-only MCP 凭据可静默续期。
key_points_en: Choose the Microsoft Entra account after sign-in.
/logout covers the corresponding OAuth sessions, and access-token-only MCP credentials can renew silently.
events.importance_reason_zh: 影响企业身份认证和 MCP 连接连续性。
events.importance_reason_en: Affects enterprise authentication and continuity of MCP connections.

events.title_zh: OpenAI 公告 ChatGPT 新视觉广告格式及测量工具扩展
events.title_en: OpenAI announces a new visual ad format and expanded measurement for ChatGPT
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 官方 RSS 摘要宣布 ChatGPT 的新视觉广告格式，并提到测量工具、归因合作和广告主品牌适配能力的扩展。当前取得的是摘要，未提供具体投放地域、价格或适用套餐。
events.summary_en: OpenAI’s official RSS summary announces a new visual ad format in ChatGPT and expanded measurement tools, attribution partnerships and brand suitability for advertisers. The available summary does not specify rollout regions, pricing or eligible plans.
key_points_zh: 新格式面向 ChatGPT 广告。
测量、归因合作与品牌适配是官方摘要明确列出的扩展方向。
key_points_en: The new format is for ads in ChatGPT.
Measurement, attribution partnerships and brand suitability are the expansion areas explicitly listed in the official summary.
events.importance_reason_zh: 涉及 ChatGPT 平台广告格式与广告工具能力的变化。
events.importance_reason_en: A change to ChatGPT’s advertising format and advertising-tool capabilities.

events.title_zh: Pi 1.0.3：接入 Azure Foundry Chat Completions，Azure 配置需迁移
events.title_en: Pi 1.0.3 adds Azure Foundry Chat Completions and requires Azure config migration
events.summary_zh: Pi 1.0.3 的 Azure provider 新增 Foundry Chat Completions 部署支持，首个模型为 azure/deepseek-v4-pro。provider 从 azure-openai-responses 更名为 azure，现有登录与模型配置需迁移；此外修复 OAuth 刷新期间取消请求导致订阅登录失效的问题。
events.summary_en: Pi 1.0.3 adds Foundry Chat Completions deployments to its Azure provider, starting with azure/deepseek-v4-pro. The provider is renamed from azure-openai-responses to azure, requiring migration of authentication and model settings. It also fixes subscription logins failing when a request is cancelled during OAuth refresh.
key_points_zh: 更新 auth.json、models.json 和 settings.json 中的 provider 名称，或重新执行 /login；AZURE_OPENAI_* 环境变量不变。
使用旧 provider 的会话恢复时会退回其他模型，且不会复用原 prompt cache。
Codemode image() 同时把图像写入临时文件并返回路径，生成文件仅当前用户可读。
key_points_en: Rename the provider in auth.json, models.json and settings.json, or run /login again; AZURE_OPENAI_* environment variables are unchanged.
Resumed sessions using the old provider fall back to another model without reusing their previous prompt cache.
Codemode image() also writes images to temporary files and returns their paths; generated output files are readable only by the user.
events.importance_reason_zh: 包含需要用户迁移配置的破坏性变更和新的模型部署接入。
events.importance_reason_en: Includes a breaking configuration migration and a new deployment integration.

events.title_zh: 马斯克：把超级智能传播到星际是一种成功条件

events.title_zh: Devin 工作区新增 Terminal 标签，并开放 Review 努力程度控制
events.title_en: Devin adds a workspace Terminal tab and Review effort controls
events.summary_zh: Devin 10 月 5 日更新在会话工作区新增 Terminal 标签，用于在 Devin 的机器上运行命令；Files 可在会话休眠时打开，打开 Files 或 Terminal 会唤醒 Devin。更新还允许触发动作设置 Review 努力程度，并新增读取单个代码扫描结果的 API/MCP 能力。
events.summary_en: Devin’s October 5 update adds a Terminal tab to the session workspace for running commands on Devin’s machine. Files can be opened while a session is asleep; opening Files or Terminal wakes Devin. Trigger actions can also set Review effort levels, and API/MCP users can fetch individual code scans.
key_points_zh: 工作区 Terminal 可运行命令，Files 和 Terminal 均可唤醒休眠会话。
Review 触发动作可指定努力程度，企业管理员可设置企业 Review 的默认值。
有仓库访问权但无 Review 执行权限的用户，可查看 PR、差异和已有发现，AI Review 动作对其隐藏。
GET /v3/organizations/{org_id}/code-scans/{scan_id} 可读取单个扫描及附件链接；MCP 对应提供 get_scan 动作。
key_points_en: The workspace Terminal runs commands; both Files and Terminal can wake sleeping sessions.
Review trigger actions can specify effort levels, and enterprise administrators can set an enterprise default.
Users with repository access but no permission to run Review can inspect PRs, diffs, and existing findings; AI Review actions are hidden.
GET /v3/organizations/{org_id}/code-scans/{scan_id} retrieves an individual scan and attachment URLs; MCP provides a corresponding get_scan action.
events.importance_reason_zh: 扩展会话内操作入口、审阅权限控制及代码扫描集成能力。
events.importance_reason_en: Expands in-session controls, review permissions, and code-scan integration.

events.summary_en: The official changelog feed says interactive Classic sessions can switch to 3.0 in the terminal, V3 Hooks can match tool categories, and long V3 sessions become more reliable.

Reset scope and implementation conditions are unspecified; this is a leader’s preview.

events.title_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.92-4：新增配置命令，强化沙箱凭据隔离与长会话恢复
events.summary_zh: 该版本新增 copilot config 子命令，并修复 MCP 连接、上下文压缩和沙箱执行问题。沙箱 shell 默认不再接收环境中的 GITHUB_TOKEN，除非显式配置。
key_points_zh: copilot config 可列出、读取、设置和删除配置；Canvas 动作可向模型返回图像。
旧 HTTP+SSE MCP 消息确认受服务器配置的超时限制，避免无限挂起；服务器指令变化后工具可在同一轮恢复。
超出上下文限额的压缩保留最新提示；过大的 Anthropic 请求缩小图像或移除附件后重试。
修复单步写入大文件后会话长时间变慢，并使 shell 的标准输出与错误输出可靠地实时显示。
events.importance_reason_zh: 包含沙箱凭据隔离、MCP 挂起和长会话稳定性的重要修复。
events.title_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.92-4 adds config commands and improves sandbox isolation and long-session recovery
events.summary_en: The release adds copilot config subcommands and fixes MCP connections, compaction and sandbox execution. Sandboxed shells now withhold ambient GITHUB_TOKEN unless explicitly configured.
key_points_en: copilot config lists, reads, sets and removes settings; Canvas actions can return images to the model.
Legacy HTTP+SSE MCP acknowledgements use the server-configured timeout to avoid indefinite hangs; tools recover in the same turn after server instructions change.
Compaction preserves the latest prompt when context limits are exceeded; oversized Anthropic requests retry with smaller images or removed attachments.
Fixes prolonged session slowdowns after a large single-step file write and reliably streams shell stdout and stderr.
events.importance_reason_en: Important fixes for sandbox credential isolation, MCP hangs and long-session reliability.

events.title_zh: DeepTutor 1.6.13：扩展沉浸阅读与题库练习，改进文档检索和语音配置
events.summary_zh: DeepTutor 1.6.13 增加自然朗读、带时间戳的观看笔记和题库练习入口。文档图像可使用独立视觉模型，聊天附件改存至所选工作区，并保留已有上传与链接。
key_points_zh: 支持从题库直接开始练习，选择多道已保存题目进行聊天；引导学习打乱选择题选项并避免泄露正确答案。
文档图像描述按工作区缓存；MinerU 云解析支持大 PDF 分片和恢复已完成部分，新增 deeptutor kb eval 本地检索评估。
语音合成超时可设为 5–600 秒，默认 60 秒；预览区分认证、权限、额度和网络等错误。
新增波兰语、Requesty、API Route、FutureInfra，以及 MiniMax 原生语音和 Xiaomi MiMo v2.5 预设语音支持。
events.importance_reason_zh: 学习流程、文档检索、工作区附件和语音兼容性均有实质更新。
events.title_en: DeepTutor 1.6.13 expands reading and question-bank practice, document retrieval and speech configuration
events.summary_en: DeepTutor 1.6.13 adds natural read-aloud audio, timestamped watching notes and question-bank practice. Document images can use a separate vision model, while chat attachments move into the selected workspace with existing uploads and URLs preserved.
key_points_en: Start practice directly from the question bank or select multiple saved questions for a chat; guided learning shuffles options and avoids revealing correct answers.
Workspace-cached image descriptions, resumable oversized-PDF slices in MinerU cloud parsing, and local retrieval evaluation with deeptutor kb eval.
Speech synthesis timeout supports 5–600 seconds, with a 60-second default; previews distinguish authentication, permissions, quota and network failures.
Adds Polish, Requesty, API Route and FutureInfra, plus native MiniMax speech and Xiaomi MiMo v2.5 preset speech support.
events.importance_reason_en: Substantial changes to learning workflows, retrieval, workspace attachments and speech compatibility.

events.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.289：修复权限规则绕过与插件会话崩溃
events.title_en: Claude Code 2.1.289 fixes permission-rule bypasses and plugin session crashes
events.summary_zh: Claude Code 修复受管机器上 mod 审批覆盖复合命令中的 deny/ask 规则、IDE 通过符号链接引用文件绕过 Read deny 规则，以及沙箱自动放行时 Bash 规则遗漏变量前缀命令等问题。也修复插件改写组织管理的 MCP 登录工具描述和多类插件界面导致会话终止的问题。
events.summary_en: Claude Code fixes mod approvals overriding deny/ask rules within compound commands on managed machines, Read deny rules being bypassed by IDE file references through symlinks, and Bash rules missing variable-prefixed commands under sandbox auto-allow. It also fixes plugins rewriting organization-managed MCP sign-in tool descriptions and several plugin UI failures that terminated sessions.
key_points_zh: 修复复合 shell 命令、变量前缀与符号链接场景中的权限规则。
阻止用户插件改写组织管理的 MCP 登录工具描述。
新增队友 agent.spawn，并修复插件渲染异常导致会话终止。
key_points_en: Fixes permission rules for compound shell commands, variable prefixes, and symlinks.
Prevents user plugins from rewriting organization-managed MCP sign-in tool descriptions.
Adds agent.spawn for teammates and fixes sessions ending on plugin-rendering failures.
events.importance_reason_zh: 修复权限边界和会话中断问题。
events.importance_reason_en: Repairs permission enforcement and session interruptions.

events.title_zh: Pi 1.0.1：项目级 MCP 覆盖与 OAuth 注册，修复运行稳定性
events.title_en: Pi 1.0.1 adds project MCP overrides and OAuth registration support
events.summary_zh: Pi 支持通过 .pi/mcp.json 和 /mcp 在项目内调整用户级 MCP 服务器，并增加 CIMD OAuth 客户端注册与 Nix 安装。该版本还修复模型容量错误结束会话、codemode 输出循环耗尽内存及部分提供商调用失败。
events.summary_en: Pi adds project overrides for user-level MCP servers through .pi/mcp.json and /mcp, CIMD OAuth client registration, and Nix installation. It also fixes turns ending on model-capacity errors, codemode output loops exhausting memory, and failures with several providers.
key_points_zh: 项目可覆盖 MCP 服务器的启用状态与工具暴露；CIMD 可按客户端文档 URL 识别客户端。
新增 Nix 安装方式和自定义工具渲染器。
修复容量错误重试、codemode 输出内存耗尽及 Bedrock Claude 签名错误。
key_points_en: Projects can override MCP server enablement and tool exposure; CIMD identifies clients by their metadata document URL.
Adds Nix installation and custom tool renderers.
Fixes capacity-error retries, codemode output memory exhaustion, and Bedrock Claude signature failures.
events.importance_reason_zh: 改进项目隔离、MCP 授权及 Agent 会话稳定性。
events.importance_reason_en: Improves project configuration, MCP authorization, and agent-session reliability.

events.title_zh: DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-alpha.1：试验 Claude Code Mods 兼容层，调整自动化与插件接口
events.summary_zh: DeepSeek Harness 发布 0.2.1-alpha.1 预览版，新增实验性 Claude Code Mods 兼容层，当前仅用于验证 API 能力对应关系，并不提供完整实用兼容。自动化任务改为 Web 内置能力；插件与扩展接口包含破坏性变更。该版本还修复任务反复停止后消息滞留队列，以及 Windows 保留端口导致桌面端无法启动等问题。
key_points_zh: Claude Code Mods 兼容层处于实验阶段，主要验证其 API 能力大致属于 Harness 插件能力的子集；不应理解为已实现完整兼容。
自动化任务成为 Web 内置能力，提醒工具供标准、创造和 PTC 模式使用；极简模式和子代理不可用。旧实验组合包选择会清理，已有任务保留。
Web 新增 --public-url，用于显示、打开并向模型提供对外访问地址，支持带路径前缀的反向代理入口。
移除运行时 invariant 插件及各包的 ./invariant 导出；依赖这些诊断入口的扩展与自定义 profile 需要调整。子路径插件不再读取独立 package.json；输入区统计扩展拆为 activity 与 usage，覆盖旧 stats 整行的插件需要更新注册 ID。
修复目标任务停止、恢复、再次停止后新消息滞留队列的问题；桌面端默认使用系统分配端口，规避 Windows 保留端口导致的启动失败。修复组合包依赖缺失与停用后的残留映射，替换已安装包版本仍需重启。
events.importance_reason_zh: 影响 Agent 自动化可用模式、跨生态插件试验和现有扩展兼容性；使用旧插件诊断入口或统计扩展的用户需要关注迁移要求。
events.title_en: DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-alpha.1: experimental Claude Code Mods compatibility and automation changes
events.summary_en: DeepSeek Harness releases the 0.2.1-alpha.1 preview with an experimental Claude Code Mods compatibility layer. It currently tests API capability mappings and does not provide complete, practical compatibility. Automation becomes built into the Web interface, with breaking changes to plugin and extension interfaces. The release also fixes messages stuck in the queue after repeated task stops and Windows desktop startup failures caused by reserved ports.
key_points_en: The experimental Claude Code Mods layer mainly tests whether its API capabilities roughly form a subset of Harness plugin capabilities; it does not establish full compatibility.

Automation becomes built into the Web interface. Reminder tools are available in standard, creative and PTC modes, but not in minimal mode or subagents. Old experimental bundle selections are cleared; existing tasks are retained.
Web adds --public-url to display, open and provide the external URL to the model, including reverse-proxy URLs with path prefixes.

Removes the runtime invariant plugin and ./invariant exports from packages. Extensions and custom profiles using these diagnostics must be updated. Subpath plugins no longer read a separate package.json. Input statistics extensions split into activity and usage; plugins overriding the old stats row need updated registration IDs.

Fixes new messages remaining queued after a target task is stopped, resumed and stopped again. Desktop uses a system-assigned port by default to avoid Windows reserved-port startup failures. Fixes missing bundle dependencies and mappings left after disabling bundles; replacing an installed bundle version still requires a restart.
events.importance_reason_en: Affects automation mode availability, cross-ecosystem plugin experiments and existing extension compatibility. Users of old plugin diagnostics or statistics extensions need to review migration requirements.

events.title_en: Claude Code 2.1.288: better long-session recovery and MCP authorization
events.summary_en: This stable release fixes context loss during timeouts, automatic compaction and session recovery, and allows MCP tools to request additional OAuth permissions when called.
key_points_en: Non-interactive sessions and subagents can continue from partial responses before a timeout; fixes automatic compaction being skipped when token usage is zero.
Session recovery preserves files and context just restored from compaction, and fixes truncated transcript loading.
MCP can reauthenticate when additional scopes are requested; permission checks prompt before BASHPID arithmetic assignments.
events.importance_reason_en: Directly affects continuity in long tasks and validation of tool permissions.

events.title_en: Gemini CLI October 2 nightly: atomic storage and corruption recovery
events.summary_en: This Gemini CLI nightly preview improves conversation recording, state backup recovery and interruption handling.
key_points_en: ChatRecordingService switches to append-only incremental patches and a bounded history window.
State persistence uses atomic writes and can recover corrupted state from backups.
Ctrl+C emergency abort reaches the handler during active operations; fixes input and scrolling issues.
events.importance_reason_en: Addresses record corruption recovery and emergency-stop reliability, but is not yet a stable release.

修复 Windows PowerShell 回退、长路径权限修复和后台控制台窗口问题。
重连后继续发送未发出的排队消息，同时避免重复发送；子 Agent 能保留仍在启动的环境。

events.title_en: Codex 0.160.0: sessions outside projects, permission recovery and Windows fixes
events.summary_en: This stable update improves session recovery, Windows sandboxing and subagent environment preparation, and adds opt-in Guardian review context.
key_points_en: When policy allows, sessions can start outside projects using workspace defaults; resuming a session restores saved permissions.
Fixes Windows PowerShell fallback, long-path permission repair and background console window issues.
Continues sending unsent queued messages after reconnection without duplicate delivery; subagents retain environments that are still starting up.
events.importance_reason_en: Affects session continuity and the stability of Windows development environments.

events.title_en: Pi 1.0.0: a full-screen interface by default and stricter MCP OAuth checks
events.summary_en: Pi’s stable 1.0 release enables a full-screen terminal interface by default and adds image generation in scripts, Radius login and stricter MCP OAuth verification.
key_points_en: The full-screen TUI becomes the default; the regular interface remains available.
Adds models.generateImages and support for Radius login and MCP.
MCP OAuth checks the issuer identifier defined in RFC 9207 and handles credentials and scopes according to server steps.
events.importance_reason_en: Changes the default interaction experience and strengthens authorization checks for third-party tools.

events.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.287：推出 Claude Mods，修复权限保护缺口
events.summary_zh: 新版本允许插件修改更深层行为，新增可选的辅助观察 mod，并修复危险删除命令及 MCP 工具权限上限的保护问题。

支持 MCP 2025-11-25 协议的 URL 提示；部分服务器可能需要 bareElicitationCapability 兼容配置。
修复重定向路径使危险 rm 命令丢失始终询问保护，以及名为 __proto__ 的 MCP 工具丢失组织权限上限的问题。
events.importance_reason_zh: 提供新的插件能力，同时修复实际权限控制缺口。
events.title_en: Claude Code 2.1.287: Claude Mods and permission protection fixes
events.summary_en: Plugins can now modify deeper behavior, with an optional observer mod, alongside fixes for protections around dangerous delete commands and MCP tool permission ceilings.
key_points_en: Introduces Claude Mods. The built-in You should know mod uses a side agent to point out omissions, limited to first-party sessions with telemetry enabled.
Supports URL elicitation in MCP protocol 2025-11-25; some servers may need bareElicitationCapability compatibility configuration.
Fixes redirected paths bypassing always-ask protection for dangerous rm commands, and MCP tools named __proto__ losing organization permission ceilings.
events.importance_reason_en: Adds plugin capabilities and fixes concrete permission-control gaps.

events.title_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.91：完善 Windows 沙箱与证书管理
events.summary_zh: 正式版本为沙箱 CA 增加检查、创建、信任、轮换与移除能力，同时调整 Windows 环境兼容性及执行证据审查。

可静态分析的完整只读命令管道进入执行证据审查；不完整的分析仍要求明确批准。
改善 node/npm 的 EACCES 网络绕行处理及沙箱行为。

events.title_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.91: Windows sandbox and certificate management improvements
events.summary_en: This stable release adds sandbox CA inspection, creation, trust, rotation and removal, while improving Windows compatibility and execution evidence review.
key_points_en: Adds copilot sandbox ca commands to check, create, trust, rotate and remove proxy CA trust, including unattended Windows setup; /sandbox ca install becomes create and trust.
Complete read-only command pipelines that can be statically analyzed enter execution evidence review; incomplete analysis still requires explicit approval.
Improves network bypass handling for node/npm EACCES errors and sandbox behavior.
events.importance_reason_en: Directly affects Windows usage, networked tools and permission decisions.
